The highly anticipated movie is slated to arrive in theaters on July 17, 2026. What do the new The Odyssey photos show? The first photo provides the audience with a first look at Academy Award winner Anne Hathaway ‘s portrayal of Penelope, the queen of Ithaca and the wife of Odysseus. Behind her is Frankenstein star Mia Goth , who is revealed to be playing the role of Melantho, one of Penelope’s maids. FIRST LOOK ? Christopher Nolan’s #TheOdyssey stars Anne Hathaway as Penelope, Odysseus’ wife awaiting his return in Ithaca. Alongside her is Mia Goth as Melantho, one of the maids in the palace. READ MORE: https://t.co/hzU5shdzCF pic.twitter.com/qyEBqFFWAm — Empire (@empiremagazine) November 14, 2025 As for the second photo, it features Marvel vet Tom Holland as he takes on the role of Telemachus, the son of Odysseus and Penelope. The Odyssey serves as Holland’s second high-profile movie for 2026, as he is also slated to reprise his role as Peter Parker/Spider-Man in Spider-Man: Brand New Day. Both movies will debut in July 2026. FIRST LOOK ? Tom Holland is Telemachus, Odysseus’ son, in Christopher Nolan’s #TheOdyssey . Read more: https://t.co/hzU5shdzCF pic.twitter.com/pkoc9vVt0P — Empire (@empiremagazine) November 14, 2025 Described as a mythic action epic, the film is written and directed by Nolan based on the Greek poet Homer’s classic poem of the same name. This project marks the Oscar-winning filmmaker’s latest collaboration with Universal Pictures following the commercial and critical success of Cillian Murphy’s Oppenheimer biopic. The film is produced by Nolan and Emma Thomas. The movie will be led by Matt Damon , who has been enlisted for the leading role of Greek hero Odysseus. The star-studded ensemble cast also includes Robert Pattinson , Tom Holland , Zendaya , Charlize Theron , Lupita Nyong’o , Jon Bernthal , Benny Safdie, Elliot Page, Mia Goth, Himesh Patel, Samantha Morton, Will Yun Lee, and more. In Homer’s original story, the character is introduced as the “king of Ithaca, who heads back home after the Trojan War. Presumed dead, Odysseus’ wife Penelope and son Telemachus contend with various suitors who compete for Penelope’s hand in Odysseus’ absence.” (Source: Empire ) Maggie Dela Paz Maggie Dela Paz has been writing about the movie and TV industry for more than seven years now. Besides being a fan of coming-of-age films and shows, she also enjoys watching K-Dramas and listening to her favorite K-Pop groups. Her current TV obsessions right now are FX’s The Bear and the popular anime My Hero Academia. text: Zoe Saldaña’s revenge thriller Colombiana finds new home on Starz US TODAY’S PAPER | November 27, 2025 | EPAPER ☰ Home Latest Pakistan Business World Sports Opinion Life & Style T-Magazine Blogs Tech Videos Cartoon Home Entertainment Zoe Saldaña’s revenge thriller Colombiana finds new home on Starz Zoe Saldaña’s 2011 action thriller Colombiana joins Starz’s November lineup alongside major blockbuster titles Pop Culture & Art November 03, 2025 1 min read facebook twitter whatsup linkded email -Reuters Zoe Saldaña’s 2011 revenge thriller Colombiana is making a streaming comeback, finding a new home on Starz as of November 1, 2025. The gritty action film, directed by Oliver Megaton (Transporter 3, Taken 2, Taken 3), joins a lineup of high-octane titles including Looper, Van Helsing, The Scorpion King, and the first five Mission: Impossible films. Colombiana follows Cataleya Restrepo, played by Saldaña, a young woman who becomes an assassin after witnessing the brutal murder of her parents in Bogotá. Leaving behind her signature orchid mark at every crime scene, Cataleya’s mission of vengeance made the film a cult favorite among fans of action thrillers, even if critics were divided upon its release. The film’s arrival on Starz marks a renewed interest in Saldaña’s earlier work, especially after the buzz surrounding her Oscar-nominated performance in Emilia Pérez. Despite the film’s polarizing reception, Saldaña has continued to cement her reputation as one of Hollywood’s most versatile stars — balancing action roles with prestige drama and blockbuster franchises. Looking ahead, Saldaña is set to reprise her role as Neytiri in James Cameron’s Avatar: Fire and Ash, one of the most anticipated films of 2025. Cameron has hinted that the sequel will take the Na’vi family into “more emotionally challenging places,” promising a darker, more personal continuation of the saga that began with The Way of Water. text: Zoe Saldaña reflects on ‘deep connection’ with husband Marco Perego Home Latest News World Sports Entertainment Science Royal Trending Health Videos Technology Home Latest News World Sports Entertainment Science Royal Trending Health Videos Technology King Charles Donald Trump 3I/ATLAS AI Cristiano Ronaldo Elon Musk Taylor Swift Hollywood Zoe Saldaña reflects on ‘deep connection’ with husband Marco Perego Zoe Saldaña reveals one life rule she and husband Marco Perego have By The News Digital November 24, 2025 Zoe Saldaña on relationship basis with husband Marco Perego Zoe Saldaña is sharing a rare look into the promise that has shaped her relationship with husband Marco Perego. In a new interview with Vogue México , the Emilia Pérez star talked about the balance she strives for in every part of her life, from her home to her career, and how that same intention carries into her marriage. She explained that she and Perego made a commitment early on, one that still guides them today. “With Marco, there’s a very deep connection. We made a promise: that whatever we did together, in art or in life, would have meaning, or we wouldn’t do it at all," she said. Saldaña, who shares three sons with Perego, 10-year-old twins Cy and Bowie and 8-year-old Zen, also opened up about allowing herself to be vulnerable in front of her children. She admitted that when they see her upset and ask why, she sometimes doesn’t know how to respond, realizing how long she has tried to appear strong. But she added, “there’s nothing more powerful than showing vulnerability.” The couple, who met on a flight to New York, married quietly in 2013 after a whirlwind romance. Over the years, Saldaña has spoken about how being with Perego helped her let her guard down. In a 2015 interview, she said that after they welcomed their boys, she looked at him and felt, “I was meant for you, and you were meant for me.” Their partnership, she has made clear, is built on mutual respect. Reflecting on their dynamic in 2018, Saldaña explained that neither directs the other but both are supportive and open. She said there’s a steady “give-and-take,” emphasizing that even though they follow their own instincts, they always take each other’s thoughts into consideration. For Saldaña, that blend of connection, purpose and vulnerability isn’t just the foundation of their marriage, it’s a guiding principle for their family and their lives together. text: Avatar: Fire and Ash Posters Ready James Cameron Fans for War Skip to content ComingSoon.net - Movie Trailers, TV & Streaming News, and More Open Close Menu Open menu Streaming Schedules Apple TV+ Disney+ Hulu Max Netflix Paramount+ Peacock Prime Video Open menu Movies Movie News Movie Features Movie Reviews Open menu TV TV News TV Features TV Reviews Open menu Games Video Game News Video Game Features Video Game Reviews Trailers Open menu Genres Anime Collectibles Comics Documentaries Family Horror Sci-Fi Wrestling Facebook Instagram Twitter Search Close Search Movies Avatar: Fire and Ash Posters Ready James Cameron Fans for War November 17, 2025 By Evolve Editors A new batch of Avatar 3 posters has dropped, teasing what to expect from 20th Century Studios’ highly anticipated threequel to the 2022 epic blockbuster Avatar: The Way of Water. The movie is scheduled to arrive in theaters on December 19. Avatar: Fire and Ash will debut in the same month as several high-profile movies such as The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants, Blumhouse’s Five Nights at Freddy’s 2, Netflix’s Wake Up Dead Man: A Knives Out Mystery, Sony Pictures’ Anaconda, and A24’s Marty Supreme. Who is in the new Avatar 3 posters? The posters hinted at another epic aerial fight involving Zoe Saldaña’s Neytiri, as she shows off her archery skills. Besides Neytiri, one poster features her and Jake’s son Lo’ak, who will also be stepping into battle to help his parents fight against new enemies. In addition, one of the posters also teases the introduction of the movie’s newest villain in the form of Varang, leader of the Ash People clan. In the upcoming sequel, while continuing to deal with the grief of losing one of their own, the Sully family will encounter new and familiar enemies threatening the Pandora. Avatar: Fire and Ash is once again directed by Cameron, who co-wrote the screenplay with Rick Jaffa and Amanda Silver. The ensemble cast includes returning stars Sam Worthington, Zoe Saldaña , Sigourney Weaver, Stephen Lang, Giovanni Ribisi, Kate Winslet, Cliff Curtis, Trinity Jo-Li Bliss, Jack Champion, Bailey Bass, Edie Falco, and more. Just like the 2022 movie, the third installment will also be over three hours long. Cameron previously said that the upcoming sequel will explore “different cultures from those I have already shown. The fire will be represented by the ‘Ash People.’ I want to show the Na’vi from another angle because, so far, I have only shown their good sides.” Originally reported by Maggie Dela Paz for SuperHeroHype . The next sequel in James Cameron's science-fiction franchise is set to make its theatrical debut on December 19, three years after the second movie, The Way of Water , came to theaters and went on to gross $2.3 billion at the worldwide box office. Now, Fire and Ash 's final trailer and first full clip have been released. The trailer begins with the new villain, Varang (Oona Chaplin), declaring that "Fire is the only pure thing in this world" as flames dance around her fingers. Soon after this, Kiri (Sigourney Weaver), insists to an elder Na'vi that something is being hidden from her. Varang is seen working with the Na'vi Miles Quaritch (Stephen Lang) and she orders to "Burn them all." Jake Sully (Sam Worthington) heroically insists that he won't let this happen. Neytiri (Zoe Saldaña) tells her children "to go as far and fast" as possible if she and Jake do not return. Before the final action-packed montage, Miles "Spider" Socorro (Jack Champion) confronts Quaritch and yells, "Do not test me!" Check out the trailer below: The first full clip features Varang and members of her Na'vi tribe, the Ash People, hunting Jake and Neytiri's children across the jungles of Pandora. When the Ash People catch sight of their prey, they make a shrieking noise and begin sprinting after them. Lo'ak (Britain Dalton) says, "They're coming" and descends into Pandora's waters, followed by Kiri, Tuktirey (Trinity Bliss), and Spider. Lo'ak encourages Kiri and Tuk that he has them as they swim and encourages them to say the family motto: "Sullys never quit." Click here to see the Avatar: Fire and Ash scene . The trailer and clip tease how Avatar: Fire and Ash 's story pits the Sullys and the Ash People against each other. Other than the Na'vi version of Quaritch in The Way of Water , the franchise's main antagonists have always been human, but that changes with Varang and the Ash People this time around. After the death of the eldest Sully child, Neteyam (Jamie Flatters), in The Way of Water , it has already been established that there are genuine life-or-death stakes for the young characters, and they are not safe simply because of their ages or for being part of the series' central family. Lo'ak, Kiri, Tuk, and Spider are not guaranteed to survive, even with two more Avatar movies on the way. In addition to dealing with the threat posed by the Ash People, many of the Sully children will be taking on larger roles in Fire and Ash . Lo'ak has been confirmed to be the new narrator after his father, Jake, filled this role in the previous films. Spider will be reconciling with his human heritage and his father being Quaritch. There have also been shots in the marketing of Spider breathing without a mask, a feat that should not be possible for a human on Pandora. Meanwhile, Kiri has a uniquely deep connection to Pandora and Eywa, which is poised to be further explored in the sequel as well. There has been speculation that Jake could die in Avatar: Fire and Ash , with earlier trailers showing that he is taken captive, and all while Lo'ak and the younger generation get larger roles. Audiences will have to wait until December to find out whether this becomes a reality, but regardless of what happens, Jake and Neytiri will do everything in their power to protect their children and Pandora. Perego, in a new interview with Vogue México The couple, who married in 2013, share three kids, sons Cy, Bowie and Zen Saldaña also opened up about the power in being vulnerable Zoe Saldaña and her husband, Marco Perego , made an important promise to each other that guides their lives. In a new interview with Vogue México , the Emilia Pérez star, 47, spoke about finding balance, and authenticity, in all aspects of her life, including her family, home and career. She explained that this also extends to Perego, 46, who is an artist. “With Marco, there’s a very deep connection. We made a promise: that whatever we did together — in art or in life — would have meaning, or we wouldn’t do it at all," she told the magazine. Frazer Harrison/WireImage Marco Perego and Zoe Saldaña at the 2025 Oscars Saldaña also opened up about learning to embrace vulnerability, even in front of her children. She and her husband share three sons, identical twins Cy and Bowie, 10, and Zen, 8. “When my children see me sad or frustrated, they ask me why. And sometimes I don’t know what to answer ... that’s when I realize that I’ve spent years trying to appear strong," she said. Added Saldaña: "But there’s nothing more powerful than showing vulnerability." Olivia Wong/Getty Marco Perego and Zoe Saldaña with their three sons in February 2025 Saldaña and Perego, who met on a flight to New York, quietly married in 2013 after just a few months of dating. In a 2015 interview with InStyle , the From Scratch actress shared how her husband has allowed her to feel more at peace. “Since I’ve been with Marco, I’ve been lowering my guard,” she said at the time. “Finally, when we had our boys, I looked at my husband and I realized: I was meant for you, and you were meant for me. I’ve always felt comfortable around men as long as they were friends. Now I finally feel comfortable with my lover. I don’t want to be separate. I want my church. I want to live inside the religion of our own little family.” In 2018, Saldaña spoke to PEOPLE about how she and Perego have a "give-and-take" dynamic in their relationship. Following the groundbreaking success of the original Avatar in 2009 and its sequel, Avatar: The Way of Water in 2023, this installment promises to elevate visual effects and motion capture to new heights. Advancements in 3D Technology for Avatar: Fire and Ash In a recent behind-the-scenes featurette, Cameron discussed the intricate visual effects and advanced motion capture technology utilized in this film. He emphasized that the technology has progressed significantly since the first Avatar film, enabling filmmakers to create a more immersive experience for audiences. Behind-the-Scenes Insights The featurette showcases Cameron on a large soundstage, directing actors like Zoe Saldaña, Kate Winslet, and Sigourney Weaver in their motion capture performances. All three actresses are seen wearing unitards with tracking markers, a requirement for capturing their movements accurately. Saldaña, reprising her role as Neytiri, stated that the upcoming film will be a unique and significant experience, exceeding the scale and impact of The Way of Water. Filmmaking Technology and Narrative Evolution Winslet highlighted how recent advancements in motion-capture technology empower Cameron to realize his creative vision. She noted that such innovations have transformed the filmmaking process, allowing for more detailed and engaging storytelling. Recent updates reveal that Avatar: Fire and Ash will be longer than its predecessor, The Way of Water, promising an expansive narrative filled with intense action and deep family themes. Cameron aims to take audiences on a fresh journey through the enchanting world of Pandora, further evolving the beloved franchise. The anticipation surrounding Avatar: Fire and Ash is palpable, with fans eagerly awaiting its arrival. All Rights Reserved It Sounds Like The Star Trek Kelvin Timeline Is Truly And Officially Dead NEWS MOVIES TV TRAILERS REVIEWS EXCLUSIVES FEATURES Newsletter Movies Science Fiction Movies It Sounds Like The Star Trek Kelvin Timeline Is Truly And Officially Dead By Jeremy Mathai Nov. 4, 2025 3:00 pm EST Paramount Pictures Despite a stacked cast of A-list talent, an entire trilogy that delivered solid box office returns, and no shortage of fervent demand among Trekkies, the inevitable seems to have just become official: The so-called Kelvin timeline "Star Trek" movies appear to be no more. Unfortunately, a report indicates that the newly-merged Paramount/Skydance studio has decided to call it quits on those attempts to bring back the cast led by Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto, Karl Urban, Zoe Saldaña, John Cho, and Simon Pegg. The disappointing news comes after years of stalled development ( and the occasional lukewarm "Star Trek 4" update ) since the last big-screen outing for the franchise came and went with 2016's "Star Trek Beyond." Variety buried this little nugget about the future of "Star Trek" amid a larger profile about CEO David Ellison's intentions for Paramount as a whole, revealing that those of us still holding out for at least a fourth theatrical film in the franchise can finally begin the process of going through the stages of grief. To be absolutely clear, the studio remains committed to more "Star Trek" in the years ahead — both on Paramount+ streaming and the big screen. However, those plans apparently won't include a reunion and possible swan song for the fan-favorite ensemble. According to the Variety article: The hope is to have a fresh 'Star Trek' movie, though the studio has moved on from the idea of bringing back Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto, and the rest of the ensemble from the J.J. Abrams reboot. The writing has been on the wall with the Star Trek cast for quite some time now Kimberley French/Paramount Pictures Don't cry because it might be over, smile because it happened ... or something like that. To be entirely fair, this "Star Trek" twist shouldn't come as a massive shock to those of us who've been following this story for nearly a decade now. As much as we wanted the Powers That Be to green light another installment of the movies, the relatively underwhelming box office performance of "Star Trek Beyond" caused Paramount to rethink its entire approach — to the extent that there hasn't been a single theatrical "Star Trek" release in the years since. (The last movie, the straight-to-streaming "Section 31," debuted earlier this year to dismal reviews.) Our last significant update regarding a fourth "Trek" movie came last year , suggesting that one last Kelvin Timeline film could act as a "final chapter" and allow the rebooted cast to sail into the sunset. That was simply not to be, as we now know, and we're left to scratch our heads over the future of the franchise. The Variety article doesn't mention the status of other projects previously known to be in development, such as the origin story film from "Andor" and "Black Mirror" director Toby Haynes . Could Paramount be interested in another reboot, replacing the last crew with an even younger cast of stars on the rise? Will the studio instead focus more on the television side of things, given the success various "Star Trek" shows have experienced for the last several years? Heck, will David Ellison ring up Quentin Tarantino and give him another shot at his own "Star Trek" pitch? Whatever happens, at least we have some closure on the movies that audiences seemed to love, bumps and all. Recommended

This highly anticipated sequel explores the dark narrative of the fire-wielding Ash People, propelling itself to potentially eclipse the monumental success of its predecessor. James Cameron ’s 'Avatar: Fire and Ash' is shaping up to be one of the biggest Hollywood releases India has ever seen. With the clock ticking down to the film's December release, Sacnilk reports that the film has already captured the attention of its Indian fanbased wth 1.2 million people already marking their interest across ticketing platforms. If the numbers hold ture, then the film could just become India’s first Hollywood title to cross the Rs 500 crore mark in India, a milestone even 'Avengers: Endgame' couldn’t touch. 'Fire and Ash' to become highest-grossing film Cameron’s previous instalment, 'Avatar: The Way of Water' (2022), became the highest-grossing Hollywood film of all time in India, raking in approximately Rs 478 crore. It surpassed the previous record holder, 'Avengers: Endgame', which at the time, collected an estimated Rs 437.8 crore. Ensemble cast returns This third chapter in the franchise takes Pandora into darker territory with the Ash People, a fire-wielding, warlike Na’vi clan led by the fierce Varang ( Oona Chaplin ). The film sees the return of the Avatar ensemble cast, including, Sam Worthington as Jake Sully, Zoe Saldaña as Neytiri, Sigourney Weaver , Stephen Lang, and Kate Winslet. 'Avatar 3' to his Rs 500 crore mark With interest for the film soaring past the million mark weeks before its big release, industry watchers believe 'Fire and Ash' could potentially deliver the biggest opening weekend ever for an international film in India. If it can keep up the hype and pace, the film's Rs 500-crore record may not be far-fetched. 'Fire and Ash' is slated for a December 19 release. text: The 1960s micro bob is trending! 17 retro haircut ideas and how to style the super short length Search Entertainment Beauty Love and Sex Fashion News and Politics Body Quizzes Lifestyle Work Horoscopes Videos Newsletter Subscribe Win Shop Events Follow Cookies Policy Other Editions Privacy Notice Terms Of Use Skip to Content Celebs Love Beauty Fashion Shopping Body Subscribe Newsletter 8 matte foundations How to wear brown Best protective hairstyles Black Friday Deals London's best bars Beauty Hair The 1960s micro bob is trending! 17 retro haircut ideas and how to style the super short length The 1960s micro bob is trending! 17 retro haircut ideas and how to style the super short length Tiny cut, huge impact By Lia Mappoura Updated: 24 November 2025 Ever contemplated, "How short can a bob actually get?" That is, before it enters bixie - pixie territory. Well, prepare to be surprised – because it can go micro short. That's right, we're talking cheek-grazing, jaw-baring, bone-structure-sculpting short. Move over, cloud bob , layered bob , shaggy bob and co. because we're all about the 1960s micro bob revival... A chop so sleek, it'll have you wondering if your neck has always been this elegant, the micro bob is not a style for the faint-hearted – the tiny cut is here to make a big statement. But before you go full Twiggy, first, a few questions answered. Specifically: "Will it suit me?" and "How is it best styled?" With the expertise of hairstylist and International Creative Director Mark Hayes of Vidal Sassoon Salon , we're here to help you navigate the world of micro bobs. Everyone's clicking on... What is a micro bob? As mentioned, the micro bob is not for the faint-hearted, but for those "who love sharp, modern precision," as Mark puts it. It's certainly "a power cut," he adds. As for the length, Mark says, "It sits just around the jawline – or even shorter – and is a sleeker, more pared-back version of the classic bob. The edges are typically blunt with minimal layering, which creates a sculpted, high-fashion silhouette." Depending on how it's styled, the micro bob is versatile. "It can be worn poker-straight for that glass-like shine, with a soft bend for Parisian ease, or tousled for a cooler, undone look," Mark says. When it comes to its origins, Mark notes that the micro bob is anything but a passing fad – it's a true, timeless classic. Of course, many other hair trends have dominated recently (hi, hello Bardot bangs and halo hair ), but we're officially crowning the micro bob as the standout style for the 2025/2026 winter season. "It traces back to the daring Flapper era of the 1920s and was catapulted into modern relevance by Vidal Sassoon in the 1960s. He redefined hair with precision cuts that were geometric, bold, and liberating – what we now call the micro bob is a direct evolution of that vision: short, sharp, and endlessly chic." In terms of inspiration, the cut owes as much to design and art as it does to fashion. "Sassoon was heavily influenced by the Bauhaus movement – form follows function," Mark explains. "That philosophy translated into hair through clean lines, minimalism, and timeless structure. You saw it embodied in icons like Louise Brooks in the 20s and later by Mary Quant and Nancy Kwan in the 60s. The micro bob became more than a hairstyle – it became a cultural statement." John Springer Collection // Getty Images Louise Brooks, 1920s Antonia Hille // Getty Images Mary Quant, 1960s Who is a micro bob best suited to? That all said, Mark is clear that the micro bob isn't one-size-fits-all. In terms of face shapes and hair types, Mark says, "It flatters oval and heart-shaped faces beautifully and works best on straight to slightly wavy hair, where the blunt line really holds its shape." Unfortunately, Mark explains that "very curly or coarse hair can lose that sharp definition, and rounder face shapes may find it emphasises width. But with expert tailoring, a skilled stylist can adapt the cut to suit a wide range of clients." So, with that in mind, we recommend consulting your hairstylist before committing to the cut! How to style a micro bob While it may look effortless, the micro bob does require some upkeep. "This is a cut that thrives on simplicity but needs attention," Mark says. He recommends using smoothing creams or shine sprays for a polished finish, or a lightweight texturising spray for a more relaxed, lived-in look. "A straightener can also help achieve that iconic Sassoon finish," Mark adds. "But trims every 4–6 weeks are non-negotiable – the cut has to stay sharp to look its best. Think of it like the little black dress of haircuts – minimalist, elegant, and always a statement." text: Star Trek 4 Starring Chris Pine & Zoe Saldaña Gets Terrible Update Skip to content Twitter Facebook Instagram Comic Book Movies and Superhero Movie News - SuperHeroHype Open Close Menu Movies TV Comics News Geek Culture Cosplay Videos Forums Search Close Search Credit: Paramount Pictures Movies Star Trek 4 Starring Chris Pine & Zoe Saldaña Gets Terrible Update November 5, 2025 By Dan Girolamo The latest Star Trek 4 update at Paramount will disappoint many fans who hoped the franchise could return for a fourth outing. What is the latest Star Trek 4 update? According to Variety , the new Paramount regime, led by David Ellison, hopes to make a new Star Trek movie. The movie will be a new Star Trek adventure, not a continuation of the J.J. Abrams movies with Chris Pine , Zoe Saldaña , and the rest of the reboot cast. “The hope is to have a fresh Star Trek movie, though the studio has moved on from the idea of bringing back Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto, and the rest of the ensemble from the J.J. Abrams reboot,” the Variety report reads. Star Trek 4 has been in development for nearly a decade. Following the release of 2016’s Star Trek Beyond, plans for a fourth Star Trek film began, with J. D. Payne and Patrick McKay penning the script. For the next few years, multiple directors, including S.J. Clarkson and Noah Hawley, joined and left the project. Quentin Tarantino even pitched and wrote a script for another Star Trek movie, but nothing ever came to fruition. In 2021, Matt Shakman signed on to direct Star Trek 4 for a planned 2023 release. In 2022, Paramount announced that Pine, Saldaña, Zachary Quinto, Simon Pegg, John Cho, and Karl Urban would return for Star Trek 4. Shakman eventually left the Star Trek project to direct The Fantastic Four: First Steps . Star Trek 4 has been in limbo ever since Shakman’s departure. The latest Star Trek 4 update came from Pegg, who expressed optimism that Ellison would resurrect the film. “I’m hoping now that David Ellison is now high up at Paramount,” Pegg said in August . “Now the merger’s happened, and David’s always been a big supporter of the Kelvin timeline. So who knows, maybe we’ll get to make another one.” If Variety’s report holds, the Kelvin timeline concludes with three films: 2009’s Star Trek, 2013’s Star Trek Into Darkness, and 2016’s Star Trek Beyond. Directed by James Cameron , the sci-fi fantasy sequel film once again sees Sam Worthington and Zoe Saldaña reprise their roles as Jake Sully and Neytiri. How much is Avatar 3 expected to make during its opening weekend? Per Deadline , Avatar: Fire and Ash is expected to make $110 million, or somewhere in the $100 million to $130 million range, during its opening weekend at the domestic box office. “It’s behind the first tracking first choice numbers of Avatar: The Way of Water , which opened to $134.1M, and that’s just fine,” the article notes. “Note, unlike most Marvel Studios movies, Avatar movies are appointment viewing. Audiences seek out the best 3D, IMAX, and premium large-format seats. There are no Easter Eggs going on a la a Marvel movie, which require immediate viewing by fans…When we’re talking about the opening for Avatar: Fire and Ash, consider Avatar: Way of Water‘s domestic start essentially the ceiling in regards to a first weekend comp.” The first Avatar movie, meanwhile, made around $77 million during its opening weekend. It ended up making $2.9 billion in total, making it the highest-grossing film of all time. Avatar: The Way of Water, which is the third-highest-grossing movie of all time, finished its box office run at $2.3 billion. As far as 2025 movies go, if Avatar: Fire and Ash makes $110 million opening weekend, this puts it behind the opening weekend for A Minecraft Movie ($162 million), Lilo & Stitch ($146 million), Superman ($125 million), The Fantastic Four: First Steps ($117 million), and Wicked: For Good ($147 million). Jurassic World Rebirth opened on a Wednesday and made $147.8 million over the five-day weekend, though its three-day Friday to Sunday total stands at $92 million. Avatar 3 will be released on December 19, 2025. Brandon Schreur Brandon Schreur has been writing about comics, movies, television shows, and all things pop culture for roughly five years. Craft Roundtables ‘Avatar: Fire and Ash’ Casting Director Margery Simkin Talks Importance of Great Actors in VFX-Heavy Work The casting director tells IndieWire, "If you don't care about the characters, you're not gonna care about the movie," while discussing her work on the visual effects-heavy 'Avatar' films. By Marcus Jones Plus icon Marcus Jones subject provided Marcus Jones More stories by Marcus ‘Sinners’ Only Needed One Weekend to Remind Everyone It’s a Major Awards Contender Read more Eddie Murphy to Receive AFI Life Achievement Award in 2026 Read more ‘Avatar: Fire and Ash’ Casting Director Margery Simkin Talks Importance of Great Actors in VFX-Heavy Work Read more November 20, 2025 6:00 pm Share Share on Facebook Post google Google Preferred Share on LinkedIn Show more sharing options Share to Flipboard Submit to Reddit Pin it Post to Tumblr Email Print This Page Share on WhatsApp From the outside looking in, the perception around making films like “ Avatar: Fire and Ash ” is that the visual effects come first, and the performances are secondary. But casting director Margery Simkin is happy to clarify that it is actually the other way around when working with Oscar-winning director James Cameron . “The thing that people don’t understand about Jim, because they think about all the technology, is he really cares about the acting and the performances. And he’s a really good director dealing with the actors. And you see it in the auditions,” said Simkin during IndieWire’s recent Crafts Roundtable discussion, presented in partnership with 20th Century Studios. Related Stories Laura Poitras Chased Investigative Journalist Seymour Hersh for 20 Years — and Finally Bagged Him for One of the Year’s Best Docs ‘The Secret Agent’ Review: Wagner Moura Tries to Leave History Behind in Kleber Mendonça Filho’s Beautifully Remembered Period Thriller All three “Avatar” films are a mix of live actors and motion capture performances — mostly those playing the Na’vi tribe of planet Pandora. Though those actors that fall into the latter, like stars Zoe Saldaña, Sam Worthington, and Oona Chaplin, do not have their likeness onscreen, Simkin, Cameron, and company all emphasize that they are providing very nuanced, human performances at the top of their craft. “People think of [Cameron] for all the visual effects, but he really gets that if you don’t care about the characters, you’re not gonna care about the movie. And to care about the characters, you have to have people that are right. So he’s really, really particular and incredibly collaborative,” said Simkin, who has also worked with directors like Tony Scott, Steven Soderbergh, and Guillermo del Toro. All that said, though finding actors for “Avatar” starts as the same any as movie (“You’re looking for great performances, you’re looking for great actors”), the casting director does add that “after we winnow it down, after we get to who we are really interested in having, then there’s the swimming test and all of those kinds of things.” Hence stories of Oscar winner Kate Winslet holding her breath for a record seven-minutes and 15 seconds while working on “Avatar: The Way of Water,” playing a leader of a seafaring Na’vi tribe. “But that stuff can be learned and being right for the part can’t be. So that takes precedent,” said Simkin. Read More: Avatar: Fire and Ash Awards Craft Roundtables Film Margery Simkin Video Daily Headlines Daily Headlines covering Film, TV and more. Movie Theater Collectibles and Novelties Are Ready To Take You to Pandora From Banshee popcorn buckets to themed drinkware, cinemas are bringing Pandora magic to the concession stand. by Reiley Selinger | Nov 17, 2025 2:40pm (Pacific) Tags: Movies , Disney Movies , Avatar , Avatar: Fire and Ash , AMC Theatres , Alamo Drafthouse Cinema , Cinemark Theatres , Regal Cinemas , Popcorn Bucket Avatar: Fire and Ash is bringing its signature wonder straight to movie theaters, and that includes some spectacular food and drink novelties! Tickets for the highly anticipated third installment of James Cameron’s epic franchise went on sale today , and fans can now plan not just their seats but also their themed snacks. AMC Theatres AMC Theatres will also feature a limited number of Banshee popcorn buckets, along with themed cups and toppers, including large drinks, popcorn tins with large popcorn, and a totem cup and lid combo with a large drink. The Adventure Combo bundles two drinks, snacks, and a popcorn. AMC will also serve Avatar-inspired beverages. Cinemark Theaters Cinemark theaters will offer the same Banshee collectible for $79.99, which includes XL popcorn with free same-day refills. Additional options include a 44 oz cup for $7.75, a 20 oz tumbler for $17.95, and a 130 oz popcorn tin for $15, all with same-day refills. Regal Cinemas Regal Cinemas is introducing the Banshee Popcorn Collectible, designed to resemble the iconic blue-winged ikran. The bucket features a faux woven basket on the Banshee’s back filled with popcorn, available at select locations while supplies last. Regal has not announced pricing for this item. Alamo Drafthouse Alamo Drafthouse fans can pre-order a limited edition 16 oz Avatar: Fire and Ash pint glass with their tickets, available for pickup within 30 days of their showtime. About Avatar: Fire and Ash : Avatar: Fire and Ash premieres in theaters on December 19, 2025, but the excitement begins early with the Avatar: Fire and Ash premiere tour kicking off on December 1 at the Dolby Theatre in Hollywood. The third installment continues the story of Pandora, written by James Cameron, Rick Jaffa, and Amanda Silver. The star-studded cast includes Sam Worthington, Zoe Saldaña, Sigourney Weaver, Stephen Lang, Oona Chaplin, Cliff Curtis, Britain Dalton, Trinity Bliss, Jack Champion, Bailey Bass, Kate Winslet, David Thewlis, and Michelle Yeoh. Plus, Miley Cyrus has recorded an original song for the film. Share Article Share Article Facebook X LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Email Copy Link Link copied Bookmark Comments By Bethany Whittingham , Senior Showbiz Reporter 17:32, Mon, Nov 17, 2025 Updated: 17:54, Mon, Nov 17, 2025 Pierce Brosnan is one of Britain's most beloved actors of both stage and screen, and he isn't ready to slow down yet. (Image: GQ) The name is Bond. James Bond. Arguably the most iconic actor to take on the role of the infamous fictional British spy, Pierce Brosnan has secured himself as a movie legend in the UK. The Irish actor boasts an illustrious career spanning five decades on both stage and screen, working with some of the biggest names in Hollywood . The 72-year-old actor has famously worked with Meryl Streep and Julie Walters in Mamma Mia, Robin Williams in the 1993 classic, Mrs Doubtfire, and Liam Neeson in the western favourite, Seraphim Falls, to name just a few. And that's before talking about his time as Ian Fleming’s 007! Let’s take a look inside his glittering career as the dad-of-five sets his sights on his next must-see movie. Born Pierce Brendan Brosnan on May 16, 1953, in Drogheda, County Lough, the budding actor showed a passion for acting at an early age. As the only child of May Brosnan and carpenter Thomas Brosnan, the star suffered a difficult upbringing on the east coast of Ireland. The actor was just an infant when his father left the family home, with his mother following suit a few years later, moving to London to work as a nurse when the star was just four years old. At 11 years old, Pierce reunited with his mother and her new husband, with the family making the move to Scotland before returning to the Big Smoke. After catching the acting bug, he followed his dreams and studied acting at the Drama Centre. He graduated from school in 1975 and began his acting career treading the boards. He made his acting debut in the play Wait Until Dark, before taking on a leading role in the British premiere of Tennessee Williams’ play, The Red Devil Battery Sign. After finding his feet on stage, he slowly started to merge into film and television shows, landing his first role in the United Stated with the miniseries, The Manions of America. But it was his portrayal of socialite Robert Gould Shaw II in the miniseries Nancy Astor which really catapulted the actor to new heights. The series depicted the life of the first woman to sit in Parliament and aired in 1982. But it wasn’t until 1985 when he was recognised for his role, when he earned his first Golden Globe nomination for Best Supporting actor in 1985. (Image: Redferns) Not long after Pierce graduated from the Drama Centre, he met Australian actress, Cassandra Harris. Sparks immediately flew between the two, with the couple tying the knot five years later in 1980 and welcoming their son, Sean, in September 1983. He also adopted Harris’ children from a prior marriage, Charlotte and Chris, following their father’s death. But things took an unexpected turn in 1987 when Harris was diagnosed with ovarian cancer. After a four-year battle with the deadly disease, she died on December 28, 1991. Brosnan told People in 1992 – just four months after his wife’s passing: “She has made me the man I am, the actor I am, the father I am. She’s forever embedded in every fibre of my being. She’s there with me every day. I was so blessed to have met someone like that.” (Image: Ron Galella Collection via Getty Images) Pierce’s breakout role came about in 1982 when he landed the role of the titular character in NBC’s romantic detective series, Remington Steele. Speaking to Route Magazine years later, Brosnan admitted that the role allowed him to cement a long-standing career in America and diversify the roles available to him. He told the outlet that prior to this role, he was “always being cast as the Irishman or the mid-Atlantic American” for roles across the pond in the UK. Pierce explained: “When I got to America, I felt like I could fly. I thought that I could play anything. I felt that I was accepted, and I didn’t feel such a stigma about my own musicality of voice. Remington Steele gave me wings to fly, and I held on with both hands.” (Image: BBC) For many people, Mrs Doubtfire is Pierce Brosnan’s most far-reaching film before he embodied James Bond in 1995. In the 1983 comedy-drama, he shared the screen with comedy legend Robin Williams and Sally Field as Stu Dunmeyer, the boyfriend of Field’s character, Miranda Hilard. In 2025, Brosnan rewatched some of the hilarious scenes he shot with the late Williams, who sadly passed away in 2014. In an interview with Vanity Fair , he reflected on what it was like to work with one of the biggest names in comedy. The doting dad confessed: “He really was quite colourful, because the children weren’t there, and it was just Robin and myself, and he knew he had me in the crosshairs with his humour. I loved the man.” (Image: Snap/REX/Shutterstock) Subscribe to Celebs Newsletter Invalid email We use your sign-up to provide content in ways you've consented to and to improve our understanding of you. text: Amanda Seyfried says Mamma Mia 3 is a "done deal" – and reveals her dream co-stars Search Latest News TV Movies Soaps All Videos Newsletter Forums Follow Cookies Policy Privacy Notice Terms Of Use Skip to Content TV Movies Soaps Tech News Forums Newsletter EastEnders spoilers Emmerdale spoilers Where to watch Wake Up Dead Man Black Friday best deals Stranger Things season 5 release date Movies Mamma Mia Amanda Seyfried says Mamma Mia 3 is a "done deal" – and reveals her dream co-stars Amanda Seyfried says Mamma Mia 3 is a "done deal" – and reveals her dream co-stars She wants two more Dancing Queens to join. By Stefania Sarrubba Published: 20 November 2025 Amanda Seyfried wants a third Mamma Mia! to happen just like the rest of us as she's put together her dream cast for the possible threequel. The Mean Girls star, next to be seen in Mona Fastvold's musical drama The Testament of Ann Lee , has confirmed that Mamma Mia 3 is not off the table. "Of course it's not off the table, it's searing a hole into the table," she said of a continuation of the Greece-set story for her character Sophie (via Entertainment Tonight ). What to Read Next "Maybe I should just be coy, or maybe I'm just naïve, but I'm pretty sure Mamma Mia 3 is a done deal," she continued Weighing in about where a third story could lead Sophie, Seyfried said she "would love" to see more of her protagonist with her children. Universal Pictures Related: Christine Baranski clears up Mamma Mia 3 update – and fans will be disappointed "I love portraying a mum, so I would love to see Sophie with her kids," she said. Released in 2008, Mamma Mia! centred on Sophie's wedding and search for her biological dad. Seyfried starred opposite Meryl Streep in the role of her mum Donna, the manager of a hotel on a fictional Greek island. Ten years after the OG, sequel Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again saw much of the cast returning for one more adventure, with singer Cher joining the cast. And it looks like Seyfried has just another singer in mind for the threequel as she explained she's "all for" more female artists to get on board. As to who she would like to see next to Sophie in Mamma Mia 3 , Seyfried called on a pop star and a fellow actor to join the cast of the musical. "Maybe [Sophie] has a cousin she hasn't seen in a while, that could be Sabrina Carpenter," she said. "And then Sydney Sweeney could show up... There's a bunch of girls that really want to be a part of it, and I'm all for it." Universal Pictures Despite Seyfried's enthusiasm, there hasn't been an official confirmation that the third film is a go so far. Earlier this year, co-star Christine Baranski, who plays Tanya in both films, clarified rumours of a third film happening after she said she met up with producer Judy Craymer. "No [developments], but the last time I said anything, it went viral, and it was only a speculation," she told RadioTimes in May. "But I'm friends with Judy Craymer, who's the producer and initiator of Mamma Mia! , and she very much wants to do number three." Stefania Sarrubba Reporter, Digital Spy Stefania is a freelance writer specialising in TV and movies. After graduating from City University, London, she covered LGBTQ+ news and pursued a career in entertainment journalism, with her work appearing in outlets including Little White Lies, The Skinny, Radio Times and Digital Spy . Her beats are horror films and period dramas, especially if fronted by queer women. She can argue why Scream is the best slasher in four languages (and a half). text: Deadline Print Article deadline-logo-svg Print Amanda Seyfried On How Sabrina Carpenter & Sydney Sweeney Can Join ‘Mamma Mia 3’ Cast: “Maybe She Has A Cousin” By Armando Tinoco Armando Tinoco Staff Writer @armietinoco More Stories By Armando NFL Thanksgiving Day Schedule: How To Watch All Football Game Livestreams Online & On TV Scott Foley, Amy Brenneman, Meta Golding & Sydney Taylor Lead Mark Rosman’s ‘Keep Coming Back’ Film Cast Food Network Star Guy Fieri Suffers Accident & Forces ‘Flavor Town Food Fight’ Producers To “Pivot” View All November 19, 2025 10:30am (L-R) Sabrina Carpenter, Amanda Seyfried and Sydney Sweeney Swan Gallet / Emma McIntyre / Amy Sussman / Getty Images Amanda Seyfried already has an idea of how to bring Sabrina Carpenter and Sydney Sweeney into the Mamma Mia 3 storyline. Although a sequel to the jukebox musical has not been officially greenlit, Seyfried is hopeful that it will happen and has proposed that Carpenter and Sweeney join the cast. “Maybe I’m just naive, but I’m pretty sure Mamma Mia 3 is a done deal,” Seyfried told Entertainment Tonight at the Governors Awards. Related Stories News Amanda Seyfried Says There’s “Fatigue With Sequels” That Are “Just For Money,” Though She’d Do ‘Mamma Mia! 3’ “In A Heartbeat” News Breaking Baz: As ‘Mamma Mia!’ Returns To Broadway, Sabrina Carpenter Eyed For Third Movie & TV Version Might Be Coming, Producer Judy Craymer Reveals Mamma Mia! was released in 2008, the film directed by Phyllida Lloyd and written by Catherine Johnson, is based on her book from the 1999 musical of the same name. A sequel to the movie released in 2018 was a prequel and Seyfried thinks the third film should focus on her character Sophie as a mother. “I love portraying a mom, so I would love to see Sophie with her kids,” Seyfried said. “Maybe she has a cousin she hasn’t seen in a while, and that could be Sabrina Carpenter. And then Sydney Sweeney could show up. There’s a bunch of girls that really want to be a part of it, and I’m all for it.” Seyfried noted that she just knew “the three dads are going to come back, and we still won’t know who the dad is because it doesn’t matter,” adding, “Meryl [Streep] is a ghost, obviously, so she’ll be around. And Julie [Walters] and Christine [Baranski] will be back singing and looking hot, and we’re all going to be somewhere tropical. And ABBA will be playing.” Seyfried has been keen on the idea of Carpenter joining her in the third Mamma Mia! film , after fans cast the “Please Please Please” singer as her daughter. “If Sabrina Carpenter wants to play my daughter, I’ll make it happen. It’s fine. I’m a big fan,” Seyfried told ABC News on October 2024. Photograph: David Levenson/Getty Images Adrian Mole David Nicholls to adapt The Secret Diary of Adrian Mole Aged 13¾ for BBC One Day author leading writing team bringing one of the best-known literary creations of the 1980s to life Lanre Bakare Arts and culture correspondent Mon 17 Nov 2025 13.20 EST Last modified on Wed 19 Nov 2025 04.45 EST Share A writing team led by the One Day author, David Nicholls, and that includes Caitlin Moran is bringing Sue Townsend’s The Secret Diary of Adrian Mole Aged 13¾ to the small screen in a 10-part BBC One adaptation of the classic tale of teenage life in British suburbia. Nicholls, who described the book as “a classic piece of comic writing and an incredible piece of ventriloquism on Sue Townsend’s part”, will adapt the book that produced one of the best-known literary creations of the 1980s. Known for Mole’s comically dramatic assessments of his life in a Midlands cul-de-sac – “I feel like a character in a Russian novel half the time” – the book sold 20m copies worldwide and was translated into 30 languages. Here We Go Again!.(Universal) Christine Baranski, Amanda Seyfried, and Julie Walters in Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again!.(Universal) Mamma Mia! star Amanda Seyfried has offered an update on the status of a third movie in the series, describing it as a “done deal”. The 2008 movie adaptation of the popular stage musical was a smash-hit and starred Seyfried alongside Meryl Streep , Pierce Brosnan, Christine Baranski, Julie Walters, Colin Firth, Stellan Skarsgård and Dominic Cooper. That was followed by 2018’s Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again! , which acted as both a prequel and a sequel to the first film, jumping back and forth between time periods. Despite its inconsistencies with the first film, Here We Go Again! was also a box office success, drawing in $402million worldwide. Amanda Seyfried has shared an update on Mamma Mia! 3. (Getty) Ever since there has been enthusiasm for the story to continue further with both Streep and Seyfried offering updates previously. Mamma Mia! producer, Judy Craymer, also said in 2023 a script for a third film was in the “earliest stages” and she hoped Streep would return. Speaking to Entertainment Tonight at the Governor Awards, Seyfried said she thought Mamma Mia! 3 was a “done deal”. Going further to outline what she’d like to see in a third film the actress said: “I love portraying a mum, so I would love to see Sophie with her kids.” Previously, Seyfried has supported the idea of Sabrina Carpenter playing Sophie’s daughter . At the end of Here We Go Again! Sophie gives birth to a baby boy, Donny. Maybe recognising this point, Seyfried told ET: “Maybe [Sophie] has a cousin she hasn’t seen in a while, and that could be Sabrina Carpenter . And then Sydney Sweeney could show up. There’s a bunch of girls that really want to be a part of it, and I’m all for it.” View this post on Instagram A post shared by Entertainment Tonight (@entertainmenttonight) You may like to watch The Mean Girls star also gave fans an idea of what would be highly likely, if not guaranteed, in another film. “I just know the three dads are going to come back, and we still won’t know who the dad is because it doesn’t matter. Meryl is a ghost, obviously, so she’ll be around. And Julie and Christine will be back singing and looking hot and we’re all going to be somewhere tropical. And ABBA will be playing,” she said. ‘Keep Sydney Sweeney out of Mamma Mia’ Sydney Sweeney. (Getty) The prospect of Sydney Sweeney being involved has dampened some fans’ enthusiasm following her recent controversies. On X, formerly Twitter, user @spicyroxxi shared a screenshot of a previous petition to “keep James Corden out of Wicked the movie”. They asked: “Can somebody start a petition like this to keep Sydney out of Mamma Mia?” And it appears many shared the view, with more than 79,000 users giving their approval with a like. Recently, as well as her Christy Martin biopic, Christy , flopping at the box office , Sweeney has faced backlash for her American Eagle jeans ad, which critics claimed featured undertones of racism and eugenics. Prior to Christy ‘s release, Sweeney was was asked about the reaction which she said “definitely was a surprise”. Rather than address it head-on, Sweeney replied: “When I have an issue that I want to speak about, people will hear.” Share your thoughts! The streaming platform underwent a major update over the weekend as November 1st brought dozens of TV shows and movies to Netflix . Among the list of new arrivals to hit Netflix at the start of the month was a charming sequel film with a near-perfect Rotten Tomatoes score, finally giving subscribers the chance to binge-watch the complete film series. Videos by ComicBook.com The movie in question is Paddington 2 , and it’s now streaming on Netflix as of November 1st alongside Paddington and Paddington in Peru . Directed by Paul King and written by King and Simon Farnaby, the movie centers around the marmalade-loving bear created by Michael Bond. The film hit theaters in 2017, just three years after the original movie, and sees Paddington settling into life with the Brown family. However, things get hairy when he is framed and imprisoned for a burglary that he did not commit. Ben Whishaw voiced the beloved bear, with Hugh Bonneville, Sally Hawkins, Brendan Gleeson, Julie Walters, Jim Broadbent, Peter Capaldi, and Hugh Grant also starring. Why You Should Watch Paddington 2 Play video If you liked Paddington , you’ll like Paddington 2 . The movie is a solid sequel and just as great as the first and is the perfect option for family movie night because it appeals to all ages. Paddington 2 immediately draws you in with a vibrant, storybook-like visual design and keeps you watching with a delightfully weird and charming story that explores kindness, courage, and friendship. The movie manages to find the perfect balance of witty wordplay and clever jokes for adults and kid-friendly gags and great performances from the cast, including Grant’s scene-stealing performance as a villain. Read Next Everything Coming to Netflix, HBO Max & Other Streaming Services in November 2025 The film at one point held the title of the highest-rated movie ever on Rotten Tomatoes before a single negative review dropped its “Certified Fresh” critic score from 100% to a still near-perfect 99%. With that score, Paddington 2 is still the highest-rated movie in the Paddington film series. The movie is also well-loved by the audience, with an 89% rating. Paddington 2 has even been described as the “ Citizen Kane of talking bear movies” due to its high ratings and lasting impact. Even eight years after its release, Paddington 2 is still buzzed about and remains a well-loved movie and a great follow-up to Paddington . What’s New on Netflix? Tons of new titles are now streaming in Netflix’s library following the wave of new arrivals on November 1st. Alongside Paddington 2, family-friendly streaming options now also include The LEGO Movie 2: The Second Part and Wonka . Other streaming titles include hits like Ace Ventura: Pet Detective , Back to the Future , Crazy Rich Asians , Elvis , The Hangover , Ocean’s 8 , and Tyler Perry’s A Madea Christmas . There's a manic screwball edge to the comedy and some witty one-liners but also present are some of the worst pitfalls of this genre. The Inbetweeners director, Ben Palmer, takes the reins in a film which dashes across famous London landmarks and the back roads of suburban England with verve. When Nancy (Lake Bell) is gifted a romantic self-help book by a woman on a train who’s due to meet a blind date at Waterloo station she becomes embroiled in a case of mistaken identity. She takes a chance, steals her blind date, a forty-something man named Jack (Simon Pegg) and ends up having a wonderful time. There's some Richard Curtis-style surface level humour in the supporting characters who fill the desperate weirdo quota That is, until he finds out she's not who she says she is and they wind up on an incredibly awkward double date with his ex. Morris and Palmer inject the first half of the date with a spontaneity that superbly captures the excitement of meeting a potential suitor who could end up to being the one. Morris also does a fantastic job of making her lead characters as fully rounded as possible within the constraints of the romantic comedy formula. Though there's some Richard Curtis-style surface level humour in the supporting characters who fill the desperate weirdo quota, her two leads are brilliantly sketched. Jack is suffering from a broken heart, his bitter ways and head-in-the-clouds attitude threatening to ruin his chances of finding a new partner. We first meet Nancy in a hotel psyching herself up to attend a wedding reception: she's working on her self-esteem and confidence via a handy to-do list which includes getting stronger thighs. Morris makes Nancy a wholly relatable character and nicely balances her cynicism with a healthy dose of sincere positivity. Olivia Williams appears as Jack’s soon to be ex-wife in a role that doesn't really offer much other than a stereotype. Considering Morris makes fun of the fact that Jack is initially set up with a 24-year-old it's a bit odd that he eventually finds a romantic connection with someone 10 years his junior and younger than his ex. Still, it's better than the alternative and backs up the idea within the film that there is no special recipe in the quest for a partner. It's all about the spark. Lake Bell’s British accent is spot on and her ability to switch between cracking jokes and emotionally wrought is impressive indeed. Simon Pegg is finely tuned to the everyman character and his performance recalls his endearing early work from Shaun of the Dead . They make for an amiable pairing in a hugely enjoyable and fast-paced comedy. The network granted Season 2 renewals to both freshman comedy series, HBO CEO Casey Bloys announced Thursday during a slate presentation to press in New York City. The news comes just over a month after “The Chair Company” debuted in October, and several weeks after the premiere of “I Love LA,” which has only released three episodes thus far. “We’re thrilled by the incredible response to ‘The Chair Company’ and ‘I Love LA’ debuts,” EVP of HBO programming and head of HBO and HBO Max comedy series Amy Gravitt said in a statement. “Both shows confidently carry on the HBO comedy tradition, in their own singular way. We couldn’t be happier to continue collaborating with Tim, Zach, Rachel and their exceptional teams.” Created by Robinson and Zach Kanin, “The Chair Company” follows a man (Robinson) who, after an embarrassing incident at work, finds himself investigating a far-reaching conspiracy, per the official logline. “The Chair Company,” which also stars Lake Bell, Sophia Lillis, Will Price and Joseph Tudisco, debuted to 1.4 million U.S. cross-platform viewers and is currently averaging 3.3 million viewers, according to live-plus-three-day figures, pacing as HBO’s top freshman comedy in platform history. “I Love LA,” which was created by and stars Sennott, centers on a group of twentysomethings navigating life and love in Los Angeles, played by Jordan Firstman, Josh Hutcherson, Odessa A’zion and True Whitaker. HBO touts “I Love LA” as the network’s second top freshman comedy in platform history, with the season averaging nearly 2 million U.S. cross-platform viewers thus far. Ahead of the show’s launch, Sennott told TheWrap she was aiming for “I Love LA” to run for several seasons, saying “I had so much fun making it and I want to do it again, because it is really just the most amazing group of people.” “The Chair Company” and “I Love LA” release new episodes on HBO and HBO Max. Sign in to your ScreenRant account Summary Generate a summary of this story follow Follow followed Followed Like Like Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap HBO's The Chair Company is taking cringe comedy to new heights, and there are a slew of hilarious movies to watch after enjoying the brilliant series. Co-created by Tim Robinson, the series is yet another triumph for the outsider comic. Exploring Robinson's absurd approach to humor on a larger scale, The Chair Company is the most original comedy in years. What the show does so well is introduce seemingly normal situations and push them to their most ridiculous limits, and each episode builds the cringe-inducing suspense. Though Robinson has perfected the style in shows like I Think You Should Leave , the ongoing narrative of The Chair Company is one of the things that makes it such a unique experience. Plenty of movies have done the same thing, and there are a host of standout films that match the tone of HBO's latest hit series. While the content might differ, there are some films that are filled with hilarious embarrassment and goofy shenanigans that will keep viewers laughing after they've caught up on episodes of The Chair Company . Drop Dead Gorgeous (1999) Despite middling reviews, Drop Dead Gorgeous is one of the best comedies of the 1990s . The mockumentary concerns the contestants of a regional beauty pageant, and the absurd lengths some will go to win. With a cast of young stars like Kirsten Dunst and Brittany Murphy, the movie is very of the moment. Though the approach is wildly different, Drop Dead Gorgeous captures the same embarrassing sincerity that The Chair Company does. Both the movie and show borrow from the playbook of a thriller film , but they do so with cringey laughs. The cult classic had a clear influence on future comedic projects. After Hours (1985) Griffin Dunne looks up in exasperation in After Hours Though Martin Scorsese is best known for his dramatic films, he's no stranger to comedy too. After Hours follows a bored workaholic who, through a series of unfortunate events, spends one crazy night in the city. Mixing farce and cringe , After Hours is a radical addition to the '80s comedy canon. Like The Chair Company , After Hours exploits relatively mundane situations for absurd comedy and huge laughs . Each moment builds upon the next in a rising series of unbelievable twists, and Scorsese is uniquely skilled at making the audience squirm in their seats. The fast-paced thrill-ride isn't just exhilarating, it's hilarious too. Brian And Charles (2022) Brian and Charles are interviewed on the couch in Brian and Charles Jim Archer's oddball buddy comedy film, Brian and Charles , largely went unnoticed, but it's well worth a revisit. A lonely man living in rural Wales builds a robot companion that opens him up to new life experiences. Keeping the cringe to a minimum, Brian and Charles gets laughs by being charming and goofy . There is a one-of-a-kind quality to Brian and Charles that will appeal to fans of The Chair Company . The humor comes from a different place, but both embrace the wild spirit of new comedy styles . The 2022 indie flick has a heartwarming vibe, yet it doesn't skip out on the funny moments. Shiva Baby (2020) Rachel Sennott holds a bagel in Shiva Baby Rachel Sennott should have won an Oscar for her comedic turn in Shiva Baby , and the movie deserves a lot more attention. While attending a funeral, a young woman finds herself in a series of awkward situations as her life converges on the event. Emma Seligman's understated comedy is hilarious in a subtle way , but very cringe-inducing. Taking a page from classic mumblecore movies from the Aughts, Shiva Baby thrives on its own awkwardness. It's quiet and contemplative when compared to The Chair Company , but just as awkward. There's also a lot of substance to the story, and it's an exploration of the foibles of young adulthood. The 40-Year-Old Virgin (2005) Steve Carell gets a pep talk from Jane Lynch in The 40 Year Old Virgin Helping to crown Judd Apatow as one of the kings of Aughts comedy, The 40-Year-Old Virgin remains an all-time classic. A worker at an electronic store is forced into the world of dating when it's revealed he's a 40-year-old virgin. Steve Carell gives the performance of a lifetime , and he excels at playing a likable underdog in a weird situation. The Chair Company is the opposite of The 40-Year-Old Virgin , where the main character is the oddball in a normal world, but the result is the same. The 2000s gem has plenty of cringe moments , but also has the slick production and accessible feel of an Aughts comedy. The 40-Year-Old Virgin is the best of both worlds. Lost In America (1985) Albert Brooks cheers Julie Hagerty on at the craps table in Lost in America Albert Brooks directed a handful of extremely underrated comedies throughout his career, and Lost in America was his best effort. A yuppie couple decide to cash out and go on the road, only to hit one speed bump after another. The '80s cult classic brilliantly skewers the decade's culture, and the Baby Boomer generation in general. By making the main characters so relatable, Lost in America is all the more hilarious when everything goes wrong for them. The cringe comes from a series of earnest, but poor decisions , which is reflective of the tone of The Chair Company . However, Brooks' approach to comedy is much more droll and understated. Death At A Funeral (2007) Two men talk in Death at a Funeral Frank Oz' Death at a Funeral was completely overlooked when it premiered in 2007, but it is now revered as a modern comedy classic. When one of the family members dies, a dysfunctional clan is brought back together and things fall apart immediately. With so much going on, Death at a Funeral never takes its foot off the gas. In classic farce fashion, every scene is packed with mishaps and embarrassing moments that give the viewer second-hand cringe. The bombastic comedy makes The Chair Company look tame by comparison, especially since every moment has a goofy and heightened sense of reality. It has no message, but the laughs are what matter most. Best In Show (2000) Two men talk while holding dogs in Best in Show Christopher Guest's ensemble comedies are deft at using cringe comedy in subtle ways, and Best in Show stands as his greatest effort thus far. The mockumentary follows various competitors in a dog show, and explores their hopes and dreams as the competition nears. Best in Show is so sincere that it feels like a real documentary at times. Though The Chair Company is more surreal and weird, the characters in Best in Show would fit right in with Tim Robinson's band of oddballs. Guest brilliantly uses the art of film to make gags that work on so many levels , and Best in Show isn't just a funny comedy, but a well-made movie as well. The King Of Comedy (1982) Pupkin performs his act on TV in The King of Comedy (1982) Robert De Niro and Martin Scorsese did their best work together, but The King of Comedy is often overlooked. Rupert Pupkin is an aspiring stand-up comic who kidnaps a talk show host in order to get his five minutes of fame. The thrilling story puts the dark in dark comedy , and is almost too bleak to be considered strictly humorous. Like The Chair Company , The King of Comedy borrows the thriller structure and infuses it with humor . However, Scorsese's hidden gem has a lot to say about celebrity culture and what it means to be a success or failure. The movie and show are cut from the same cloth, but The King of Comedy actually has a lot to say. Friendship (2025) Tim Robinson has already built an impressive resume, and Friendship was his debut as a leading man in the movies . Robinson plays a regular suburban dad who befriends a free-spirited neighbor and becomes obsessed with impressing him. Rudd and Robinson are a match made in comedy heaven, and Friendship is just cringey enough. Bouncing between awkward moments and downright surrealism, Friendship has all the same trademarks as The Chair Company . Since Tim Robinson is such a unique entertainer, it only makes sense that his first starring role would be the closest thing to The Chair Company in the realm of cinema. 10 /10 9 /10 The Chair Company 10 stars 9 stars 8 stars 7 stars 6 stars 5 stars 4 stars 3 stars 2 stars 1 star Like Follow Followed Comedy Release Date October 12, 2025 Network HBO Directors Andrew DeYoung Cast See All Tim Robinson William Ronald Trosper Lake Bell Barb Trosper Where to watch Close WHERE TO WATCH Streaming Genres Comedy Creator(s) Tim Robinson, Zach Kanin Powered by Expand Collapse Google is updating how content is shown. Exploring Robinson's absurd approach to humor on a larger scale, The Chair Company is the most original comedy in years. What the show does so well is introduce seemingly normal situations and push them to their most ridiculous limits, and each episode builds the cringe-inducing suspense. Though Robinson has perfected the style in shows like I Think You Should Leave , the ongoing narrative of The Chair Company is one of the things that makes it such a unique experience. Plenty of movies have done the same thing, and there are a host of standout films that match the tone of HBO's latest hit series. While the content might differ, there are some films that are filled with hilarious embarrassment and goofy shenanigans that will keep viewers laughing after they've caught up on episodes of The Chair Company. Drop Dead Gorgeous (1999) Despite middling reviews, Drop Dead Gorgeous is one of the best comedies of the 1990s. The mockumentary concerns the contestants of a regional beauty pageant, and the absurd lengths some will go to win. With a cast of young stars like Kirsten Dunst and Brittany Murphy, the movie is very of the moment. Though the approach is wildly different, Drop Dead Gorgeous captures the same embarrassing sincerity that The Chair Company does. Both the movie and show borrow from the playbook of a thriller film , but they do so with cringey laughs. The cult classic had a clear influence on future comedic projects. After Hours (1985) Griffin Dunne looks up in exasperation in After Hours Though Martin Scorsese is best known for his dramatic films, he's no stranger to comedy too. After Hours follows a bored workaholic who, through a series of unfortunate events, spends one crazy night in the city. Mixing farce and cringe , After Hours is a radical addition to the '80s comedy canon. Like The Chair Company , After Hours exploits relatively mundane situations for absurd comedy and huge laughs. Each moment builds upon the next in a rising series of unbelievable twists, and Scorsese is uniquely skilled at making the audience squirm in their seats. The fast-paced thrill-ride isn't just exhilarating, it's hilarious too. Brian And Charles (2022) Brian and Charles are interviewed on the couch in Brian and Charles Jim Archer's oddball buddy comedy film, Brian and Charles , largely went unnoticed, but it's well worth a revisit. A lonely man living in rural Wales builds a robot companion that opens him up to new life experiences. Keeping the cringe to a minimum, Brian and Charles gets laughs by being charming and goofy. There is a one-of-a-kind quality to Brian and Charles that will appeal to fans of The Chair Company. The humor comes from a different place, but both embrace the wild spirit of new comedy styles. The 2022 indie flick has a heartwarming vibe, yet it doesn't skip out on the funny moments. Shiva Baby (2020) Rachel Sennott holds a bagel in Shiva Baby Rachel Sennott should have won an Oscar for her comedic turn in Shiva Baby , and the movie deserves a lot more attention. While attending a funeral, a young woman finds herself in a series of awkward situations as her life converges on the event. Emma Seligman's understated comedy is hilarious in a subtle way , but very cringe-inducing. Taking a page from classic mumblecore movies from the Aughts, Shiva Baby thrives on its own awkwardness. It's quiet and contemplative when compared to The Chair Company , but just as awkward. There's also a lot of substance to the story, and it's an exploration of the foibles of young adulthood. The 40-Year-Old Virgin (2005) Steve Carell gets a pep talk from Jane Lynch in The 40 Year Old Virgin Helping to crown Judd Apatow as one of the kings of Aughts comedy, The 40-Year-Old Virgin remains an all-time classic. A worker at an electronic store is forced into the world of dating when it's revealed he's a 40-year-old virgin. Steve Carell gives the performance of a lifetime , and he excels at playing a likable underdog in a weird situation. The Chair Company is the opposite of The 40-Year-Old Virgin , where the main character is the oddball in a normal world, but the result is the same. The 2000s gem has plenty of cringe moments , but also has the slick production and accessible feel of an Aughts comedy. The 40-Year-Old Virgin is the best of both worlds. Lost In America (1985) Albert Brooks cheers Julie Hagerty on at the craps table in Lost in America Albert Brooks directed a handful of extremely underrated comedies throughout his career, and Lost in America was his best effort. A yuppie couple decide to cash out and go on the road, only to hit one speed bump after another. The '80s cult classic brilliantly skewers the decade's culture, and the Baby Boomer generation in general. By making the main characters so relatable, Lost in America is all the more hilarious when everything goes wrong for them. The cringe comes from a series of earnest, but poor decisions , which is reflective of the tone of The Chair Company. However, Brooks' approach to comedy is much more droll and understated. Death At A Funeral (2007) Two men talk in Death at a Funeral Frank Oz' Death at a Funeral was completely overlooked when it premiered in 2007, but it is now revered as a modern comedy classic. When one of the family members dies, a dysfunctional clan is brought back together and things fall apart immediately. With so much going on, Death at a Funeral never takes its foot off the gas. In classic farce fashion, every scene is packed with mishaps and embarrassing moments that give the viewer second-hand cringe. The bombastic comedy makes The Chair Company look tame by comparison, especially since every moment has a goofy and heightened sense of reality. It has no message, but the laughs are what matter most. Best In Show (2000) Two men talk while holding dogs in Best in Show Christopher Guest's ensemble comedies are deft at using cringe comedy in subtle ways, and Best in Show stands as his greatest effort thus far. The mockumentary follows various competitors in a dog show, and explores their hopes and dreams as the competition nears. Best in Show is so sincere that it feels like a real documentary at times. Though The Chair Company is more surreal and weird, the characters in Best in Show would fit right in with Tim Robinson's band of oddballs. Guest brilliantly uses the art of film to make gags that work on so many levels , and Best in Show isn't just a funny comedy, but a well-made movie as well. The King Of Comedy (1982) Pupkin performs his act on TV in The King of Comedy (1982) Robert De Niro and Martin Scorsese did their best work together, but The King of Comedy is often overlooked. Rupert Pupkin is an aspiring stand-up comic who kidnaps a talk show host in order to get his five minutes of fame. The thrilling story puts the dark in dark comedy , and is almost too bleak to be considered strictly humorous. Like The Chair Company , The King of Comedy borrows the thriller structure and infuses it with humor. However, Scorsese's hidden gem has a lot to say about celebrity culture and what it means to be a success or failure. The movie and show are cut from the same cloth, but The King of Comedy actually has a lot to say. Friendship (2025) Tim Robinson has already built an impressive resume, and Friendship was his debut as a leading man in the movies. Robinson plays a regular suburban dad who befriends a free-spirited neighbor and becomes obsessed with impressing him. Rudd and Robinson are a match made in comedy heaven, and Friendship is just cringey enough. Bouncing between awkward moments and downright surrealism, Friendship has all the same trademarks as The Chair Company. Four episodes in, and HBO’s critically acclaimed The Chair Company may just be the least predictable thing on the 2025 TV schedule and beyond. It’s impossible to properly describe in simple terms, and fans aren’t even completely sure how much to consider it a laugh-out-loud comedy and how much of it fits squarely in the psychological thriller/horror category. And while it seems as if the mysterious company Tecca is the most nefarious entity here, the latest episode puts the mental state of Tim Robinson’s Ron in a disturbing new light. As hinted at in earlier episodes, Ron and Barb’s marriage was previously tested on a grand scale due to his past efforts to turn his Jeep Tours business model into a legitimate company. Just seeing the storage box in the garage was enough to set off Barb’s anxiety, and now we seem to have a far clearer idea of why Jeeps are such a red flag in this family, thanks to the flashback-filled fourth installment. We don't actually know much about what he'd want people to see while driving around, just the sense that he idealized an out-of-the-way spot for people to just feel like themselves without everyday pressures. More On Tim Robinson Friendship Is My Most Uncomfortable Movie Of 2025 (So Far), But Now I'm Worried About Tim Robinson's New HBO Series Given that we haven't seen Barb calling Ron out for batshit insane ideas for the new business, I'm inferring that Ron's research and planning were logical and made sense. To the point where he attracted the attention of a potential investor, whom he took out to drive around the lot, and that's where things get extremely hazy for both Ron and audiences. As he confessed it to his wife, Ron started driving far faster than is safe for such vehicles in wooded areas, and bafflingly attempted to launch the car over a log, only to hit it, which almost efinitely gave the investor a major concussion, if not other injuries. After which, Ron says he drove the guy back to his hotel to sleep it off, make it seem like he's unaware that sleep is the worst thing for a concussion-sufferer to deal with. (Image credit: HBO) My Two Biggest Theories About Ron's Jeep Tours Accident Theory #1: The investor died, either in his hotel room or in Ron's car right after the accident. This would definitely be a dark twist for Ron and Co., although it could technically be true without any other characers being fully aware of it.
