As someone who still gets anxiety thinking about the itchy knits of yore that I had to wear as a child, I’m very picky in the comfort department, too, and always look for sweaters that won’t bother me (or cause sensory overload) the entire day, no matter where it takes me. Testing out Naadam’s The Original Cashmere Sweater in Tomato . WWD/Stacia Datskovska On a cooler NYC morning, I decided to put on my tomato-red Naadam sweater with white jeans and green platform Sambas from Adidas. Right away, I was blown away by just how feather-like its material was, having what felt like no weight at all as it draped on my body in an attractive and non-baggy way. While the sleeves ended at my wrists and were thus very true to size, I decided to roll them up as an extra step — something that only contributed to the piece’s overall chicness. As I commuted to work, something that usually turns me into a sweaty mess by the time I get to my desk, the sweater maintained optimal airflow and breathability. It’s totally something I envision putting a puffer vest on top of as the weather gets even cooler and can be worn either tucked (Naadam says it’s “the perfect length for a front tuck”) or in a more relaxed way. That crew neckline also lent itself well to a pearl necklace I chose to accessorize with — after the above picture was taken, alas — and accentuated the length of my neck. Call it the placebo effect, but I truly felt like my The Original Cashmere Sweater was responsible for creating a better, more graceful version of me. Testing out Naadam’s The Original Cashmere Sweater in Peacock Blue . WWD/Stacia Datskovska The very next day, I tried the Peacock Blue iteration of the same Naadam bestseller, and it’s safe to say the color was much darker than what I expected, while still retaining vibrancy. I matched it to a brown suede skirt but recommend going with bottoms that can aptly contrast the sweater’s jewel tone (for an even sharper look, resort to fashion ‘s “sandwich rule” by picking similarly hued shoes and a lighter-toned midi skirt , say). Since this item was identical to the one I wore just 24 hours prior, albeit in a different color, I had the exact same feelings about it. This time around, though, I tucked The Original Cashmere Sweater into my skirt — where it stayed the whole day without sliding out, which has happened to me in the past and led to a less-than-ideal, not-so-professional look. Whenever I felt like my forearms needed some extra breeziness, I simply slid up the sweater’s sleeves, which didn’t contribute to a baggier appearance in any way. And while I did experience a very slight itching sensation in the first hour of wear, it was nothing compared to that of a heavy Fair Isle cardigan knit by Grandma. All in all, the Naadam favorite was consistently smooth and agreeable against my skin. Both variations of the Naadam The Original Cashmere Sweater were able to take my autumnal ‘fits to a whole new level. I felt confident out on the streets and even managed to turn some heads. What more could a girl really want? WWD/Stacia Datskovska In case the kind of vivid red spotlighted on the fall runways of labels like Ferragamo and Calvin Klein isn’t your thing, and neither is the type of blue that pays homage to a peacock’s plumage, Naadam comes in clutch with 16 other colorways for the taking. The brand is so meticulous about keeping its range of offerings expansive that it even sells the product in a Cherry Red (just a touch more pink than its vegetable-inspired counterpart). You should carefully consider the hues that are speaking to you, as well as the ones that would go best with your new fall fashions. But don’t think too long, as multiple trending shades are already seeing dreaded “notify when available” notices. Naadam launched in 2013, immediately generating attention based on its mission of sourcing cashmere fibers directly from Mongolian herding communities — thereby cutting out the middlemen and paying suppliers more. Because of this, consumers also started benefiting, and people quickly realized that Naadam’s lower-than-average price tags on cashmere goods (it also sells loungewear, dresses, joggers, and more) didn’t translate to lower-than-average quality. Indeed, in the past decade-plus, Naadam has led the market when it comes to timeless designs, sustainable manufacturing practices, and fabrics that sit at a “not too thin, not too thick” Goldilocks equilibrium. Once the world learned that cashmere, thanks to Naadam, doesn’t have to be an inaccessible pipe dream making your wallet cry at the thought of it, even celebs got on board. Jamie Chung and Lea Michele are fans of the company, and they’re joined by countless TikTok influencers who are letting Naadam transform their personal style. Honestly, while wearing The Original Cashmere Sweater, I was also tempted to make a video or two about its magic (set to Conan Gray ‘s “Heather,” of course, because nothing about the closet staple is “just polyester”). The 16th edition of the award show took place on November 16 at Ovation Hollywood’s Ray Dolby Ballroom. 35-year-old Jennifer was joined by stars like Leonardo DiCaprio, Tom Cruise, Sydney Sweeney, Ariana Grande, Michael B. Jordan, Jennifer Lopez, Dakota Johnson, and more at the glitzy show. Highlights Jennifer Lawrence joined the biggest names in Hollywood for the 2025 Governors Awards. Her appearance in an off-the-shoulder cream gown by Dior caused a stir online. “It looks like she accidentally tucked her dress into her panti*s drunk bridesmaid style,” read one comment online. Stars like Leonardo DiCaprio, Tom Cruise, Sydney Sweeney, Ariana Grande, Michael B. Jordan, Jennifer Lopez, and Dakota Johnson also attended the ceremony. Image credits: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon ADVERTISEMENT The Governors Awards is an annual ceremony that recognizes lifetime achievements in cinema as well as remarkable contributions to the evolution of the motion picture arts and sciences. These honors are given by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences’ Board of Governors. This year, the honorary Oscar was given to Tom Cruise . It reminds me of a marble statue.” “She looks absolutely incredible. That dress is divine,” said another. ADVERTISEMENT “She looks beautiful, but I miss her old eyes, they gave her such a look. Obviously she can do whatever she wants and still looks great, she just looks more like an actress who looks like JLaw,” another said. Jennifer Lawrence wearing a white dress and bold earrings amid plastic surgery speculation and diaper dress mockery. Image credits: Dimitrios Kambouris/Getty Images /Steve Granitz/FilmMagic Jennifer Lawrence wearing a unique diaper style dress, sparking plastic surgery speculation and public mockery at an event. Speculation about the actress undergoing cosmetic surgery to change the appearance of her eyes has been rampant in recent years. “I think she had something done to widen her eyes, ” and “the eyelid surgery made her eyes look much bigger” were comments made by netizens in the past. However, the Oscar winner clarified that her makeup artist was behind the change in the look of her eyes. Jennifer Lawrence looking at her reflection while holding a lipstick, linked to plastic surgery speculation and diaper dress mockery. Image credits: vmagazine Text comment on screen by crumblycardiologist saying Yeah she's been yassified, relating to Jennifer Lawrence plastic surgery speculation. “It’s incredible what makeup can do because I work with Hung [Vanngo], who overlines the lip, and I call him a plastic surgeon, because everybody in the last few months since I’ve been working with him is convinced that I had eye surgery,” she told Kylie Jenner in a 2023 chat for Interview . The Hunger Games star recently had a candid conversation about cosmetic procedures, saying she has her eyes set on one procedure in particular. Jennifer Lawrence wearing black dresses in two different interviews amid plastic surgery speculation. Image credits: The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon While speaking to The New Yorker last month, she said she understands that injectables in her forehead could affect her facial movements, which in turn could affect her performance in front of the camera. She nevertheless said she gets Botox but not fillers . Despite rumors, the actress confirmed that she has never gotten a facelift. “But, believe me, I’m gonna!” she told the outlet. Jennifer Lawrence wearing a white dress resembling a diaper style, sparking plastic surgery speculation at an event. Image credits: THR The Silver Linings Playbook star said she also has plans to undergo breast augmentation . If she weren’t a world-famous star, Jennifer said she probably “wouldn’t be hustling to the appointment in the same way” for a cosmetic procedure. But even then, she would still consider altering her breasts, she said. I lost baby weight in my face, and my face changed because I’m aging,’” she told the beauty mogul. “Everybody thought I had a nose job, and I’m like, ‘I’ve had the exact same nose. In fact, the actress, 35, told The New Yorker that she is cautious to do press while promoting her projects due to how she acted in old interviews. Lawrence recalled telling Viola Davis, “Every time I do an interview, I think, ‘I can’t do this to myself again.’ I feel like I lose so much control over my craft when I have to do press for a movie.” “Oh, no,” she noted. “So hyper. I poop my pants every day!’ … I look at those interviews, and that person is annoying. I get why seeing that person everywhere would be annoying. Ariana Grande’s impression of me on ‘SNL’ was spot-on.” In 2016, the singer, 32, impersonated the actress in a “Celebrity Family Feud” sketch on the late-night show. 8 Jennifer Lawrence barefoot while on “The Late Show” in 2018. CBS via Getty Images Grande would blurt out lines like: “I’m just, like, a snackaholic. I mean, I love Pringles. If no one’s looking, I’ll eat, like, a whole can.” Lawrence admitted to the New Yorker that the public scrutiny was “uninhabitable. ” “I felt — I didn’t feel, I was, I think — rejected not for my movies, not for my politics, but for me, for my personality,” she shared. Lawrence rose to fame in 2010 after “Winter’s Bone.” Shortly after she starred in “The Hunger Games” franchise and “Silver Linings Playbook” — which earned her an Academy Award. 8 Jennifer Lawrence has shared a variety of hot takes on “WWHL.” NBCU Photo Bank/NBCUniversal via Getty Images The Oscar winner recalled to the outlet that during that time, paparazzi used to follow her while she drove through Los Angeles. Lawrence felt like she was overwhelmed doing press for too many films. The mom of two quipped that before her New Yorker interview, her mouth guard got stuck inside her mouth. “Can you imagine?” she confessed. “After ten years of being, like, ‘I used to be folksy, but everyone thought everything was a shtick,’ then I show up for my first day of this,” she said, mimicking someone wearing a mouth guard. “I was, like, I will do anything to prevent this from happening. It would be like if I tripped and fell on my way into the room.” Lawrence has previously spoken about taking a hiatus from Hollywood, where she married Cooke Maroney in 2019 and welcomed son Cy and a second son, whose name is rumored to be Louie. 8 Taran Killam as Quentin Tarantino, Kenan Thompson as Steve Harvey, and Ariana Grande as Jennifer Lawrence during the “Celebrity Family Feud” on “SNL” in 2016. NBCU Photo Bank/NBCUniversal via Getty Images The star told Vanity Fair in 2021: “I just think everybody had gotten sick of me. I’d gotten sick of me. It had just gotten to a point where I couldn’t do anything right. If I walked a red carpet, it was, ‘Why didn’t she run?’” “I was people-pleasing for the majority of my life. Working made me feel like nobody could be mad at me: ‘Okay, I said yes, we’re doing it. Nobody’s mad,’” Lawrence stated. “And then I felt like I reached a point where people were not pleased just by my existence. So that kind of shook me out of thinking that work or your career can bring any kind of peace to your soul.” While on “The Graham Norton Show,” Lawrence revealed she “was at peace” if she didn’t return to acting. She added that Hollywood “is a lot. … I think I would have been [okay], but also I would’ve been really upset. I don’t know.” 8 Jennifer Lawrence tripped and fell during the Oscars in 2013. Getty Images In 2013, Lawrence fell at the Oscars while trying to get up the steps to accept her award for Best Actress for “Silver Linings Playbook.” Some critics felt like the dramatic fall was staged. Then, while on “The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon,” Lawrence recalled the time when she was talking to who she thought was Elizabeth Taylor. 8 Jennifer Lawrence is interviewed at the “The Hunger Games: Catching Fire” Premiere during The 8th Rome Film Festival at Auditorium Parco Della Musica on November 14, 2013 in Rome, Italy. The actress also told Fallon that after she met director Francis Ford Coppola at a restaurant in Paris, “I went back to my table, and [I realized] my entire dress was unzipped, and my thong was out.” “So I’m barefoot, and my whole ass was out. text: RHOC's Tamra Judge Hits Back at Jennifer Lawrence After ‘Toxic’ Comments - Reality Tea Skip to content Reality Tea Open Close Menu News Features Recaps Shows Royal Tea Facebook Twitter Pinterest Search Close Search Photo Credit: Rich Polk/Bravo via Getty images Reality News RHOC’s Tamra Judge Hits Back at Jennifer Lawrence After ‘Toxic’ Comments November 18, 2025 By Amy DeVore Jennifer Lawrence poked the bear living inside Tamra Judge . Now, this Real Housewives of Orange County star is fighting back. To backtrack, two weeks ago, Jennifer labeled Tamra as “the most toxic of everybody.” She then apologized, saying, “Sorry, Tamra, but you are.” Cue Tamra at BravoCon this past weekend, releasing all of her opinions about this A-list celebrity. Tamra Judge was disappointed by Jennifer Lawrence’s comments @accesshollywood Call out Tamra Judge at your own peril ?? #BravoCon #RHOC ♬ original sound – Access Hollywood While walking down one of the many red carpets at BravoCon, the same Access Hollywood reporter who interviewed Jennifer caught up with Tamra. Did Tamra hear what Jennifer said? And if so, what were her thoughts, this interviewer asked. “I just think like, you don’t know me. I’m on a reality show and there’s a lot that you don’t know, and I’m sorry you feel that way,” Tamra said. She then noted that she is “ one of the most successful Housewives on my cast, so I’m doing something right, Jennifer Lawrence.” But then, the interviewer switched gears, praising Tamra for standing beside her friend, Teddi Mellencamp , as she battles stage 4 brain cancer. At this reminder of how kind she can be, Tamra quipped, “Tell Jennifer Lawrence that. Is that toxic, Jennifer Lawrence? You’re f*cking toxic.” Toxic is a hard sell for Jennifer, but she is a Bravo superfan. She has varied opinions about many reality television stars. So, for fun, should she appear at BravoCon next year to play a round of Squash That Beef with all of her opinion-haters? This writer says, YES. The Real Housewives of Orange County reunion continues on Thursdays at 8/7c on Bravo. It streams on Peacock. TELL US – ARE YOU SIDING WITH JENNIFER OR TAMRA HERE? BUT ALSO, WILL JENNIFER RESPOND? (Image credit: Mubi) Many fans of the Hunger Games and Twilight franchises are excited that Jennifer Lawrence and Robert Pattinson are starring together in a movie that just hit the 2025 movie calendar . However, before anyone starts expecting Katniss Everdeen and Edward Cullen fanfic , perhaps you should take a look at what critics are saying about Die My Love , because Lynne Ramsay’s newest project tackles some heavy material. Jennifer Lawrence and Robert Pattinson star in Die My Love as Grace and Jackson, who move from New York City to rural Montana and have a baby. Grace begins to struggle with loneliness and postpartum depression, leading to what looks like some intense and disturbing moments in the trailer . According to Sheila O’Malley of RogerEbert.com , Lynne Ramsay has created an “unrelenting fever dream” for us to experience what Lawrence’s character is going through. The critic rates the movie 3.5 out of 4 stars, writing: Lawrence is an unruly presence, and her impulsiveness here (which serves her so well as a comedienne) makes her seem dangerous and reckless. Die My Love, like its source material, is close first-person. We never get a break from Grace’s perspective. None of this is easy, and not much of it is fun. But Die My Love is a wild and worthwhile ride. Iana Murray of Empire gives Die My Love — a book-to-screen adaptation of Ariana Harwicz’s 2012 novel — 4 stars out of 5, saying it reaffirms Lynne Ramsay as one of our foremost observers of humanity. The film exudes a “feral energy,” Murray writes, elevated by Jennifer Lawrence’s no-holds-barred performance. The critic says: You may like Jennifer Lawrence Gets Real About People Slamming Her Movies: ‘The Experience Only Adds To The Dread’ How Does Jennifer Lawrence Feel When Her Movies Flop? She Has Two Memorable Words For It 'I'm Definitely Not Bothered By People That Are Bothered By Nudity.' Jennifer Lawrence On Her Choice To Go Naked Onscreen In No Hard Feelings And Other Films The actor takes on a carnal physicality unlike anything she’s embodied before, and it doesn’t feel as if she’s acting so much as allowing the character’s spirit to take hold of her. Pattinson, who’s no stranger to exploring the farthest extremes of himself on screen, is right there with her as Grace’s increasingly distant husband. But this film belongs to Lawrence, devoting every inch of her body to a bold, unrelenting and invigorating study of just how unforgiving motherhood can be. Alissa Wilkinson of the New York Times warns that Die My Love is polarizing and some will find it infuriating. This critic, however, loves it (moreso, even, on repeat viewings) and calls it “career-defining” for Jennifer Lawrence. To see an actor take such a big swing and connect, Wilkinson writes, is the reason she goes to the movies. She continues: Die My Love is linear yet allusive; sometimes you’re not sure how much time has passed, and sometimes it passes in a blink. Submerged in Grace’s overheated, claustrophobic, tedious, maddening reality, we are drowning, just like her. It is full-body immersion cinema. Its story may revolve around Grace, but Die My Love revolves around Jennifer Lawrence, for whom this feels like a career-defining role — not that she really required one. Peter Travers of The Travers Take rates it 3 out of 4 stars, noting that while Lynne Ramsay lives to push boundaries, this one may push audiences too far. Still, despite the angst and the noise, Travers says this is a movie that needs to be seen, as Jennifer Lawrence takes huge risks and achieves “hallucinatory brilliance.” In other words: Jennifer Lawrence doesn’t play it safe as an actress. And her gift for walking the highwire pays off big time in Die My Love, where you won’t know what hit you. And even if you feel wrung out like a rag at the end or the middle or, hell, right from the beginning, don’t discourage Lawrence. Risk becomes her. Not everybody is going to be on board with Die My Love , and NPR’s Aisha Harris falls in that category. She praises Jennifer Lawrence and Sissy Spacek — who other critics also complimented — but feels the movie doesn’t give the audience enough to hold onto and that other films have handled similar topics more successfully. In Harris’ words: Lawrence is a compelling presence and more than game to go through the pangs the part calls for, and she shares some strong scenes with Sissy Spacek, playing Jackson's empathetic mother Pam. But the storytelling is too abstract and at a remove to fully lock in emotionally, and as Grace's descent takes unsurprising turns, I was reminded of other, more successful works conveying this delicate subject matter. This movie definitely sounds intense, and more than one critic mentions 2017’s Mother! in describing how Jennifer Lawrence’s character is driven to psychosis. For being what critics described as “polarizing,” and not easy or fun, Die My Love is getting a mostly positive response from critics, earning a Certified Fresh score of 77% on Rotten Tomatoes . (Image credit: NBC/Columbia Records) With so much buzz surrounding Taylor Swift’s relationship with Travis Kelce these days — including why she hasn’t been shown at Chiefs games as much — sometimes it’s easy to forget that the “Out of the Woods” singer has kissed a lot of frogs. That honestly doesn’t seem so bad when those frogs included the likes of Harry Styles but, now that the former One Direction singer has leaped over to Swift’s longtime friend Zoë Kravitz, how does the Eras Tour star feel about it? It’s been over a decade since Taylor Swift’s short-but-intense romance with Harry Styles — who was the inspiration for "I Knew You Were Trouble" and likely several other songs from her 1989 era. So she allegedly “doesn’t have an issue” with Zoë Kravitz dating him now, according to a source for US Weekly , who said: Their relationship was so long ago. Harry has moved on, and so has Taylor. They’re friendly when they see each other, which isn’t often but does happen occasionally. It’s all in the past now. Rumors about a romance between Zoë Kravitz and the “Watermelon Sugar” singer started to circulate in August, and fans are pretty sure they’re still hanging out , as they’ve been photographed together as recently as mid-October. There’s even evidence to suggest these two might be more than casual — it seems the Blink Twice director has already introduced Harry Styles to her dad , Lenny Kravitz. They had been together for three years, and he has since moved on with Australian model Inka Williams . As for how Taylor Swift fits in the picture, she and Zoë Kravitz have been friends at least since 2016 — which was three years after her breakup with Harry Styles — and the two even quarantined together in London when Kravitz was shooting The Batman in 2020. More recently Kravitz and her mom Lisa Bonet stayed at Swift’s house (and ended up destroying her bathroom ) when they had to evacuate due to the L.A. wildfires. The two have supported each other’s careers over the years — Taylor Swift sneaking photos from inside her screening of The Batman and Zoë Kravitz giving a glowing six-word review to Swift’s most recent album The Life of a Showgirl — so it makes sense that there would be no bad blood between the two over one of Swift's former flames. Swifties have pieced together several clues over the years that point to the marathon-runner being the muse behind several of Taylor Swift’s songs from 1989 . “Style,” for instance, is practically the “As It Was” singer’s name and describes a “James Dean daydream” and “long hair, slicked back, white T-shirt” that seem to allude to her ex. The plans for the streaming release date of Caught Stealing, helmed by Darren Aronofsky, are beginning to take shape. Along with Butler, the project stars Zoë Kravitz. It debuted in theaters on August 29. The film is now set to reach Netflix in select regions under Sony’s current release framework. Caught Stealing’s streaming release date for Netflix revealed Netflix has listed November 29 as the streaming debut for Caught Stealing in the United States, as per What’s on Netflix . The date falls under the 2021 Netflix–Sony output agreement, which grants Netflix the first pay window after a title completes its theatrical and PVOD run. Many Sony films have previously landed on the service around 120 days after release, but the schedule varies. In this case, an earlier-than-usual digital arrival seems to have been confirmed. The title will reportedly stream only on the platform’s premium tiers because Sony’s pay-one films are not available on the ad-supported plan. Caught Stealing features an ensemble led by Austin Butler and Zoë Kravitz, with supporting roles from Regina King, Matt Smith, Vincent D’Onofrio, and Liev Schreiber. The film follows a former baseball player drawn into New York City’s criminal underworld in the 1990s. It earned a Certified Fresh badge on Rotten Tomatoes . Time Out called it “decently entertaining,” Los Angeles Times noted Butler’s performance positively, and The Washington Post stated, “There are pleasures here… but you have to have the patience for them.” Box office reporting recorded more than $32 million worldwide. After its Netflix U.S. run, the film will shift to Hulu and Disney+ following an 18-month window ending in late May 2027. International rollout might vary. India often receives Sony titles near the U.S. date, though timing is not guaranteed. Notably, the United Kingdom is expected to add the title in early to mid-2027. Sony Pictures Entertainment Caught Stealing , a crime caper starring Austin Butler and Zoë Kravitz from director Darren Aronofsky, is coming soon to streaming on Netflix. Rated R, Caught Stealing opened in theaters on Aug. 29 and made its debut on digital streaming via premium video on demand on Sept. 30. The official summary for Caught Stealing reads, “Hank Thompson ( Butler ) was a high-school baseball phenom who can’t play anymore, but everything else is going okay. He’s got a great girl ( Kravitz ), tends bar at a New York dive and his favorite team is making an underdog run at the pennant. Forbes When Is ‘Now You See Me: Now You Don’t’ Coming To Streaming? By Tim Lammers "When his punk-rock neighbor Russ (Matt Smith) asks him to take care of his cat for a few days, Hank suddenly finds himself caught in the middle of a motley crew of threatening gangsters. They all want a piece of him; the problem is, he has no idea why. As Hank attempts to evade their ever-tightening grip, he’s got to use all his hustle to stay alive long enough to find out …” Caught Stealing will make its streaming video on demand premiere on Netflix on Saturday, Nov. 29, according to a new listing on the platform. For viewers who don’t have a subscription to Netflix, the platform has an ad-based package that costs $7.99 per month for viewing on two supported devices and an ad-free package for $17.99 per month for viewing on two supported devices. Forbes Leonardo DiCaprio’s ‘One Battle After Another’ Is Now Streaming - How To Watch By Tim Lammers MORE FOR YOU In addition, the platform offers an ad-free package for $24.99 per month for four supported devices with 4K Ultra HD programming. How Did ‘Caught Stealing’ Perform At The Box Office? During its theatrical run, Caught Stealing made $19 million domestically and $9.3 million internationally for a worldwide box office tally of $28.3 million. Caught Stealing had a $40 million production budget before prints and advertising costs, according to Variety . Caught Stealing earned an 84% “fresh” score from Rotten Tomatoes based on 246 reviews. The RT Critics Consensus for the film reads, “A freewheeling throwback, Caught Stealing splendidly showcases Austin Butler's movie star charisma while marking a surprisingly lighthearted gearshift for director Darren Aronofsky.” Forbes When Is Glen Powell’s ‘The Running Man’ Coming To Streaming? By Tim Lammers Caught Stealing also earned an 83% “fresh” rating on RT’s Popcornmeter based on 1,000-plus verified user ratings. The RT audience summary for the movie reads, “A diverting, pulpy caper with ‘90s flair, Caught Stealing is a gritty, violent ride fueled by the charisma of Austin Butler and Zoë Kravitz.” Also starring Regina King, Liev Schreiber, Vincent D’Onofrio, Benito Martínez Ocasio (aka Bad Bunny), Griffin Dunne and Carol Kane, Caught Stealing will arrive on Netflix on Nov. 29. Directed by Darren Aronofsky. Starring Austin Butler, Regina King, Zoë Kravitz, Matt Smith, Liev Schreiber, Vincent D’Onofrio, Benito Martínez Ocasio, Griffin Dunne, and Carol Kane. SYNOPSIS: Darren Aronofky’s latest, Caught Stealing , arrives on 4K Ultra HD with a smattering of bonus features and a code for a digital copy. It’s a fun film that’s worth your time, with a cast of colorful characters and a scene-stealing cat. I admit I haven’t kept up with all of director Darren Aronofsky’s movies over the years. Pi was a great debut, but I’ve been off and on when checking out his films. Some, such as The Whale , didn’t interest me for personal reasons. However, Caught Stealing caught my attention because of its great cast and intriguing premise. The film goes through so many twists and turns that are densely packed with plot points, which left me unable to spend much time trying to guess ahead of the story. That’s the mark of a solid film, in my book, although this one has one particular head-scratching moment that left it short of the mark. Set in 1998, this movie stars Austin Butler as Henry “Hank” Thompson, a former highly-touted Major League Baseball prospect now working as a bartender in New York City’s Lower East Side. His girlfriend, Yvonne (Zoë Kravitz), does her best to support him while trying not to enable his drinking. When his mohawked neighbor Russ Miner (Matt Smith) abruptly asks Hank to watch his cat because he needs to go home to London, Hank ends up pulled into a conflict between Russian, Puerto Rican, and Jewish mobsters that tests his ability to survive by his wits. He tries to rely on police detective Elise Roman (Regina King) for help, but doing so only makes the situation worse for him. The cast of characters surrounding Hank are a lot of fun to watch chewing up the scenery, whether it’s the thuggish Russians or the Hasidic Drucker brothers (played by Liev Schreiber and Vincent D’Onofrio), who don’t want to run afoul of their beloved Bubbe (Carol Kane). Russ is an over-the-top punk rock Brit who’s the reason for Hank getting into such a mess but may also be able to help him get out of it when he returns from England. About that head-scratching moment: There’s a scene where Hank ends up in a basement room with a steel door, where he and his bar owner employer Paul (Griffin Dunne) have holed up, with adversaries on the other side. It was a great “How is he going to get out of this mess?” moment whose resolution felt like a cheat. (I’ll have to check out the novel this film is based on to see how it handles that situation). Sony has issued Caught Stealing on 4K Ultra HD with a code included for a digital copy. There’s no Blu-ray, but that’s okay since the bonus features found here don’t take up much room on the platter anyway. The extras run about 20 minutes total and consist of four featurettes: Aronofsky: The Real Deal , which features the director and Charlie Huston, the author of the Caught Stealing novel; Casting Criminals, Chaos, and a Cat , which looks at this great cast, including an adorable cat; I Don’t Drive , a reference to a line from Hank and an exploration of the stunt work; and A New York Story , an overview of a city that has changed a lot in the 27 years since 1998. Caught Stealing is Huston’s first novel in a series of books starring Hank Thompson, so it will be interesting to see if the others get a green light too. One of the most well-received and celebrated albums of the year, it’s a raw yet rollicking documentation of the breakdown of her marriage to Stranger Things actor David Harbour , emboldened by those Lily Allenisms: acerbic lyrics delivered in her sweet song-song and earworm melodies. And with each outing post-album drop, the British singer has amped up her revenge dress wardrobe. Read More “It Was A Way For Me To Process What Was Happening”: Lily Allen On Marriage, Motherhood And Her Music Comeback By Olivia Marks Last night, Allen attended the London premiere of The Hunger Games: On Stage . She opted for a sheer and clingy black knit Galliano-era Dior dress from 1999 with a high neck and long sleeves, wearing just a black thong underneath. She kept the rest of the look pretty simple, with platform black Louboutins and a selection of rings. Her hair was up in a gathered and layered bun with her signature bangs mussed up, and she wore glowy, minimal make-up. Photo: Getty Images Photo: Getty Images Last week, Allen made her first major punt at the revenge dress at the 2025 CFDA Fashion Awards , proving that the concept doesn’t actually have to involve a dress at all . Allen slipped into an itty-bitty cream bralet, exposing her abs, paired with a lace-detailed matching silk skirt by Colleen Allen . It felt classic and timeless, yet modern and sexy. And for Halloween, Allen’s signature cheekiness played out in her costume, as she dressed up as the children’s character Madeline – a sly nod to the lyrics about the other woman in her relationship. Lily Allen at the 2025 CFDA Fashion Awards. Photo: Getty Images The revenge dress was first defined by Princess Diana, who famously wore a show-stopping black off-the-shoulder dress by Christian Stambolian in 1994, after her then-husband and then-Prince Charles admitted to infidelity. In the years since, pop culture figures have embraced the power of the post-breakup fit: Mariah Carey’s thigh-exposing two-piece at the 1997 VMAs after her break-up from Tommy Mottola tipped a new and empowered fashion era for the star, while Bella Hadid opted for a mesh Alexander Wang catsuit on the Met Gala 2017 red carpet after splitting from The Weeknd. Zoë Kravitz donned a naked dress at the 2021 gala, just weeks after finalising her divorce, and wore her new partner Channing Tatum on her arm. What’s next for this West End Girl ? When it comes to outerwear, timeless, simple coats have dominated the runways in recent years and make a sensible choice. Think a black or navy wool longline coat, a belted trench and a buttery, leather overcoat–styles that will seamlessly layer over any of your winter outfits. Featured in this article Burberry’s Forever Trench Coat Burberry long Kensington trench coat Jump to review $4,450 BURBERRY Barbour’s Waxed Jacket Barbour Milda trench coat Jump to review $640 NET-A-PORTER Leset’s Lightweight Layers Leset Yuri coat Jump to review $720 NET-A-PORTER There are thousands of coats to choose from, however to narrow down your search we have listed the brands that have a celebrity following . While Burberry’s trench coats have a long list of loyal devotees, from the Duchess of Sussex to Emma Watson, The Row is a label that has defined celebrity style in recent years, as the likes of Jennifer Lawrence and Zoë Kravitz tend to be cloaked in minimalist staples from the brand. When it comes to outerwear, The Row’s aesthetic couldn’t be more Olsen, with oversized silhouettes that graze the floor, sloped shoulders and belted robes. While this list includes heritage heavyweights like Burberry and Bottega Veneta, an honourable mention must also go to The Frankie Shop and Toteme, brands that sit within the contemporary bracket and have spearheaded many coat trends . Katie Holmes is often spotted in New York wearing an ankle-length camel coat from The Frankie Shop named the Gaia, which has oversized shoulders and a boxy, double-breasted fit. Jennifer Lawrence, meanwhile, has been wearing a cashmere and wool wrap coat by Toteme since 2019, showing the benefits of investing in a beautifully-constructed classic coat that you can wear year after year. Here, Vogue highlights eight coat brands that the most fashion-forward celebrities rely on. Ricky Vigil M / Justin E Palmer Burberry Burberry’s classic trench coats have been a mainstay in popular culture for over 100 years–as Joy Montgomery previously wrote, “Its IMBD page would rival Michael Caine’s.” However its not just the gabardine creations that are worth your attention, as Alexa Chung shows in her cream coat. It keeps giving its heritage styles modern twists, thanks to collaborations with the likes of Ganni and Alexa Chung. Canceled DC Movie About Iconic Batman Character November 10, 2025 By Brandon Schreur A Catwoman movie was quietly canceled by Warner Bros. Discovery . Created by Bill Finger and Bob Kane, the Catwoman character first debuted in DC Comics in 1940’s Batman #1. She has since been the focus of many Batman and DC stories, having been portrayed in live-action by stars such as Michelle Pfeiffer, Halle Berry, Anne Hathaway, Zoë Kravitz, and more. What do we know about Warner Bros.’ canceled Catwoman movie? Per DC Film News , Swaybox Studios — the production company now working on the animated Dynamic Duo movie for DC Studios — was developing a Catwoman film that was canceled back in 2022. It would have focused on a younger Selina Kyle when she was a child. According to ComicBookMovie , Swaybox’s Arthur Mitnz said in a now-deleted 2025 interview with Biz New Orleans, “We were greenlit to make a project for HBO Max , a feature film based on Catwoman as a kid.” Three months into development, Warner Bros. Discovery’s David Zaslav wanted to slow down the amount of content that was being made for streaming and gave the Catwoman project the axe. “He canceled 42 projects, including ours,” Mintz said. That being said, there is some good news. The Batman director Matt Reeves saw some footage from the Catwoman movie and, after putting together a sizzle reel, showed it to Zaslav liked what he saw, but reportedly said that the project needed a “larger story.” Whether or not that means the project could ever be resurrected is unclear. The Dynamic Duo movie is also set to focus on young versions of Dick Grayson and Jason Todd; meaning, there’s a chance that Selina could show up in that film, and whatever was being developed for the Catwoman movie could be retooled to fit into Dynamic Duo. At this time, however, it doesn’t sound like audiences should be holding their breath to see Swaybox’s Catwoman prequel movie. Originally reported by Brandon Schreur at SuperHeroHype . Discovery . Created by Bill Finger and Bob Kane, the Catwoman character first debuted in DC Comics in 1940’s Batman #1. She has since been the focus of many Batman and DC stories, having been portrayed in live-action by stars such as Michelle Pfeiffer, Halle Berry, Anne Hathaway, Zoë Kravitz, and more. What do we know about the canceled Catwoman movie? Per DC Film News , Swaybox Studios — the production company now working on the animated Dynamic Duo movie for DC Studios — was developing a Catwoman film that was canceled back in 2022. It would have focused on a younger Selina Kyle when she was a child. According to ComicBookMovie , Swaybox’s Arthur Mitnz said in a now-deleted 2025 interview with Biz New Orleans, “We were greenlit to make a project for HBO Max , a feature film based on Catwoman as a kid.” Three months into development, Warner Bros. Discovery’s David Zaslav wanted to slow down the amount of content that was being made for streaming and gave the Catwoman project the axe. “He canceled 42 projects, including ours,” Mintz said. That being said, there is some good news. The Batman director Matt Reeves saw some footage from the Catwoman movie and, after putting together a sizzle reel, showed it to Zaslav liked what he saw, but reportedly said that the project needed a “larger story.” Whether or not that means the project could ever be resurrected is unclear. The Dynamic Duo movie is also set to focus on young versions of Dick Grayson and Jason Todd; meaning, there’s a chance that Selina could show up in that film, and whatever was being developed for the Catwoman movie could be retooled to fit into Dynamic Duo. At this time, however, it doesn’t sound like audiences should be holding their breath to see Swaybox’s Catwoman prequel movie. text: Austin Butler Responds To Emily Ratajkowski Dating Rumors MENU Celeb Couples Austin Butler Is Talking About Those Emily Ratajkowski Dating Rumors He's addressing the gossip head-on. by Dylan Kickham November 18, 2025 Edward Berthelot/Getty Images Entertainment/Getty Images Austin Butler has a new outlook on how to deal with the gossip around his love life . The actor, who’s previously kept silent about any rumored romances, is ready to be blunt about his current relationship status. Namely, he’s getting real about what’s going on between himself and Emily Ratajkowski . The pair sparked dating rumors about two and a half months ago when they were photographed cuddling up next to each other at a New York City bar on Sept. 5. This was a week after they were also spotted together at an afterparty for Butler’s movie Caught Stealing . However, Butler reminded everyone that just because one hot celeb grabs drinks with another hot celeb, it doesn’t always mean a love story. “The true answer is that I have a lot of friends, and we’re friends and we had dinner, and that we’re friends,” Butler said when asked about the Ratajkowski pics in his Nov. 18 Vanity Fair profile . He refrained from dispelling the rumors at first because when the chatter first began, his urge was to disengage. “I just wanted to hide,” Butler said. But he’s since changed how he wants to deal with these things: “I’m going to live a constricted small life because I’m afraid of what other people are going to say or what they’re going to think?” Gilbert Flores/Variety/Getty Images Butler confirmed in the profile that he is currently single. He dealt with a similar situation where fans believed he was dating a close friend shortly before the Ratajkowski pics, when unsubstantiated gossip arose that he was seeing his Caught Stealing co-star Zoë Kravitz . While he may not have a partner at the moment, Butler admitted that he does have marriage and even fatherhood on his mind these days. “You get one life,” he said, “so how can I allow that to hopefully make me a better friend and a better partner — and a better husband, one day, and a better father, one day, God willing?” Don't miss a thing Be the first to know what's trending, straight from Elite Daily Submit By subscribing to this BDG newsletter, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy Subscribe to our newsletter > Search Close Experiences Travel Wellness Tech Food College See All Astrology Compatibility Horoscopes Planet & Moon Events See All Dating Single Life Sex Relationships Sexual Health See All Entertainment TV Movies Celebrity Music Streaming See All Fashion Beauty Amplifying Our Voices Latest About Us Advertise Terms Privacy DMCA Newsletter Masthead © 2025 BDG Media, Inc. By Sophie Wang Published: Nov 25, 2025 3:03 PM EST Move over, lemon yellow, a new citrus shade has entered the building. Presenting a fresh alternative to the beloved hue—which has been seen throughout the year on the likes of Gigi Hadid , Hailey Bieber, and Zoë Kravitz — Lili Reinhart stepped out in an autumnal look full of lime-green accents. Sitting down for a SAG-AFTRA Foundation conversation focused on her new series, Hal & Harper , the actress kept things business-casual in a look from Tory Burch ’s Resort 2026 collection. Reinhart and stylist Ib Abdel Nassar layered a cozy gray V-neck sweater over a lime-green turtleneck, and tucked both into high-waisted dark-wash jeans with statement pattern cuffs. For outerwear, she added a deep brown textured coat with oversize lapels and a drop-waist accent. And for some extra green, she slipped into the cutest Marie Antoinette-inspired pumps—designed with ruffled satin and a sweet ballerina bow. Manny Carabel // Getty Images Manny Carabel // Getty Images Earlier in the day, Reinhart was seen leaving LIVE With Kelly and Mark in another Tory Burch look, playing with a darker green shade and winter florals. The knit polo was designed with long sleeves and delicate buttons; shoulder pads balanced softness with structure. The actor paired it with a high-waisted white midi skirt with a purple-and-green floral wallpaper print. She finished the look off with pointy heels in midnight blue. MediaPunch/Bauer-Griffin // Getty Images Starring Cooper Raiff and Mark Ruffalo alongside Reinhart, Hal & Harper first premiered back in January at the 2025 Sundance Film Festival. Following a single dad and his two children forced to grow up quickly, the comedy drama started releasing episodes on MUBI last month—with its finale premiering next week. Saturday and ends on Sunday. Aronofsky, known for Black Swan , Requiem for a Dream , and Mother! released a new action-packed thriller starring Austin Butler, Zoë Kravitz, Matt Smith, and Bad Bunny earlier this year. It's the kind of quiet-luxury classic that A-listers and FROW regulars go crazy for, with its supple black leather, diddy heel and, of course, that famous crinkle detail around the curved toe. You needn’t take our word for it. Look to eternal It-girls Hailey Bieber and Zoë Kravitz, who’ve both modelled the preppy style in recent months. And the hype has passed down to us mere mortals too, with global fashion platform Lyst naming it among the season’s hottest products, with a 66% month-on-month search increase. In other words, the £880 shoe is having a moment - albeit a very, very expensive one. Honestly, we don’t have a month’s rent to drop on a pair of loafers. But here’s the good news: M&S has dropped a dupe so convincing it deserves its own Lyst entry. The high-street store’s £56 Leather Loafer is sleek, shiny and even has the same signature slit detail across the shoe’s tongue as the Saint Laurent original. The crinkled finish mimics Saint Laurent’s signature polish, while the structured toe and low heel give it that smart, borrowed-from-the-boys charm. M&S Leather Loafers £56 Shop M&S’s plain black leather is truest to the original, but for an AW25 twist, we’re huge fans of the suede incarnation too. There’s a stylish deep navy, but our undeniable favourite is the luxe chocolate suede - a great way to dip your toe (pun intended) into the season’s hottest colour. Both the leather and suede versions have racked up hundreds of five-star reviews, with reviewers raving about the Insolia Flex technology, which is basically a special insole that makes sure your foot is supported while you walk. Sexy? Not particularly. But trust us: after wearing slip-on loafers all day, your trotters will be very thankful. As far as we’re concerned, these loafers are the best of both worlds: investment look, non-investment price. Pair with calf-skimming socks for the perfect AW25 combination (don’t worry, cover the socks with jeans so you just get the occasional flash). Honestly, they’ll look so good that no one will notice if it's YSL or M&S on the label. Darren Aronofsky’s action thriller carried a strong pulse from the moment it opened, powered by Austin Butler, Zoë Kravitz , Matt Smith, and Bad Bunny. Yet, it slipped at the box office despite glowing reactions from those who watched it. The film cost $40 million to make and closed at a little over $32.6 million (per Box Office Mojo ), creating a gap that it never managed to cover in cinemas. Still, the story inside the film kept finding new supporters, hinting that its life was far from over. Caught Stealing OTT Release Date Revealed The film will be available on Netflix in the US starting November 29, providing it with a new path and a wider audience, allowing more people to access it with ease. However, what begins as a simple favor spirals into a gritty run through New York, packed with action and sharp tension. The thriller earned fresh recognition through its R rating and its confident pacing, drawing praise from critics who called it entertaining and full of joy, surprises, strong performances, and even a touch of heartbreak. Austin Butler Upcoming Projects Austin Butler ’s work in Caught Stealing adds to a growing list that already includes Elvis, Once Upon a Time in Hollywood, Dune Part Two, and The Carrie Diaries. Now, as Caught Stealing reaches streaming, it enters a space where word of mouth travels quickly and where films often receive the second life they deserve. By Richard Fink Published Nov 1, 2025 Richard Fink is a contributing writer in Los Angeles, California. Born in Phoenix, Arizona, Richard holds a Bachelor's Degree in Film and Media Production from ASU and has been writing professional about film and television since 2021. Movies have always been his passion, and he has a passion for history, comics, and cooking. Contact him at richardf@movieweb.com Sign in to your MovieWeb account Summary Generate a summary of this story follow Follow followed Followed Like Like Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap One of the key creatives behind Andor is joining The Batman - Part II . This new development makes a lot of creative sense, given that The Batman and Andor have both earned praise for injecting established franchises with a grounded aesthetic and emotional maturity. According to The Hollywood Reporter , Matt Reeves has hired Andor production designer Luke Hull for The Batman - Part II . Aside from Andor , Hull's recent projects include his Emmy-winning work on Chernobyl , so it'd be an understatement to say he comes highly recommended. Filming on the much-delayed Batman - Part II is expected to begin in late April or early May 2026 at Warner Bros. Studios Leavesden in England, with a release date currently set for Oct. 1, 2027. A New Spin on Gotham City Batman (Robert Pattinson) and Catwoman (Zoë Kravitz) in a scene from The Batman Warner Bros. Pictures Hull takes over for James Chinlund, who worked on The Batman , and while some fans might be concerned about The Batman - Part II featuring a different production designer, as they want to maintain a strict sense of visual continuity, a new production designer could give Gotham City richer detail. We've seen this happen before: Anton Furst's incredible production design for 1989's Batman refined the modern image of Gotham City onscreen, but he passed away in 1991 and was unable to return for Batman Returns . Bo Welch stepped in, and not only built on what Furst had done with the previous film, but also put his own unique spin on Gotham, making the city feel more lived-in. Casting announcements and story details around The Batman - Part II are expected to emerge in the coming months as production continues to ramp up. The big question on many people's minds is who the villain(s) will be . The Court of Owls has been the popular fan theory, though some speculation points to Dr. Simon Hurt. Rumors are circulating that Zoe Kravitz isn't expected to return as Selina Kyle / Catwoman, while Colin Farrell has hinted that his role as Oz Cobb / The Penguin will be minor. There's also the question of Barry Keogan as the Joker, teased at the end of The Batman . Given how Hull's work on Andor fleshed out the Star Wars galaxy, it's exciting to imagine him playing in the DC sandbox. News By JoshWilding - Nov 01, 2025 04:11 PM EST Filed Under: The Batman Daniela Melchior joined the DCEU in 2021's The Suicide Squad , where she played Task Force X member Ratcatcher II. Filmmaker James Gunn established an origin for the character, revealing that Cleo Cazo had inherited the mantle from her father, following his death. We still don't know whether Ratcatcher II will return in DC Studios' DCU, even with Gunn bringing back Team Peacemaker (a group that features several characters who were in The Suicide Squad ). It's also possible that Melchior could play a different, far more prominent character. Time will tell on that front, but how about Catwoman? For this year's Halloween, Melchior suited up as Zoë Kravitz's Selina Kyle from 2022's The Batman and the result was certainly pretty eye-catching! Kravitz isn't expected to reprise the role in The Batman Part II (which arrives in theaters on October 1, 2027), though The Penguin did seem to hint that she'll eventually return to Gotham City to meet her half-sister, Sofia Falcone. Earlier this year, Melchior was asked about possibly joining the DCU, either as someone new or reprising Ratcatcher II. "I’m open to exploring another [DC] character, but I’m also open to exploring more Ratcatcher II background or even her future," she mused. "I’ve been saying that Ratcatcher II is taking a nap right now, but I can’t wait to wake her up." Of course, for us to get another Catwoman on screen, Gunn will need to get cameras rolling on The Brave and the Bold . The DCU movie appears no closer to happening, though he did recently suggest that the plan is to move on from the planned Damian Wayne storyline. In August 2024, it was announced that Anya Taylor-Joy is leading Netflix's adaptation of Bella Mackie's 2021 novel, which follows the murderous Grace Bernard, the daughter of a ruthless billionaire who seeks revenge on her family after a devastating betrayal. According to Deadline , StudioCanal has resolved a copyright dispute in which the studio had sought an injunction against Netflix's How to Kill Your Family . StudioCanal filed a lawsuit earlier this year against author Bella Mackie, whose novel serves as the basis for the series, claiming that the book infringed on the copyright of their own 1949 film, Kind Hearts and Coronets . Kind Hearts And Coronets (1949) Alec Guinness played eight members of the D'Ascoyne family The 1949 film, starring Alec Guinness , follows the distant relative of a Duke who plots to murder eight heirs ahead of him to claim the title for himself. Mackie has never publicly acknowledged Kind Hearts and Coronets as an influence , though critics have frequently drawn comparisons between her 2021 novel and the 1949 film, whose plot is loosely based on the 1907 novel Israel Rank: The Autobiography of a Criminal by Roy Horniman. In its High Court filing, StudioCanal alleged that How to Kill Your Family copied " a substantial part " of Kind Hearts and Coronets without permission. The studio sought unspecified monetary damages and an injunction preventing Mackie from further " reproducing " her work, with the complaint specifically referencing the upcoming Netflix adaptation . The dispute has since been resolved, though the terms of the settlement remain confidential. StudioCanal declined to provide further comment but confirmed that the issue has been settled, and production on the Netflix series is expected to begin next year . Anya Taylor-Joy as Beth looking serious in The Queen's Gambit With the copyright lawsuit resolved, How to Kill Your Family will mark Anya Taylor-Joy's first Netflix series since The Queen's Gambit in 2020, which earned her international recognition, a Golden Globe, a SAG Award, and an Emmy nomination. Anya Taylor-Joy also stars in the upcoming Apple TV+ series Lucky , which wrapped filming in July 2025. Sign in to your Collider account Summary Generate a summary of this story follow Follow followed Followed Like Like Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Anya Taylor-Joy is no stranger to horror, and one might even consider it her particular forte — given her star-making role in The Witch and subsequent appearances in movies like Split and The Menu — but one of her most stylish horror movies is also one of her most underrated: Edgar Wright ’s Last Night in Soho . The time-twisting mystery is closer to a psychological thriller than straight horror, but it is also a rare scary movie from the director of Shaun of the Dead that lacks the sort of knowing wink that Wright is known for. Even better: You can stream it for free on Prime Video with ads. The movie was met with mostly positive reviews, ending up at 75% on Rotten Tomatoes , but it was very much a flop at the box office . That’s likely because it came out in 2021, which was a rough box office year in general, but the movie deserved better either way. In addition to Taylor-Joy, it starred Thomasin McKenzie , Matt Smith , and Terence Stamp , and it was the final performance of both Margaret Nolan and Diana Rigg . Why is ‘Last Night in Soho’ Underrated? Matt Smith as Jack kissing Anya Taylor Joy as Sandie's hand in Last Night in Soho. Image via Focus Features Anya Taylor-Joy has very distinct features, and a lot of movies use her in order to make an immediately striking impression , like her five-second performance in Dune: Part Two , where Denis Villeneuve simply used her as shorthand for "this character will be important later" (she'll be back in the next one, for anyone who hasn't read Dune Messiah ). Last Night in Soho does the same, except she also makes an immediately striking impression on the film’s hero, a young fashion student named Ellie (McKenzie). While struggling with her assignments and her new life in London, Ellie starts having supernaturally vivid dreams about a woman named Sandie (Taylor-Joy) who lived in London in the ‘60s. As the shy and anxious Ellie becomes more and more drawn to the outgoing and fashionable Sandie, things from the dreams start bleeding into her real life and a mysterious man who seems to know Sandie starts following her. It’s a very fun hook, but it wouldn’t work as well as it does without someone like Taylor-Joy as the ghost-like spirit that is haunting Ellie. She plays Sandie as someone who is mostly unknowable, so the reveal that she’s a real person and not some kind of dream entity makes it all nicely unnerving. And, again, Wright pulls it all off (depending on how you feel about the ending ) very well, proving that his expertise with genre films doesn’t just extend to making thorough satires of them . Of course, he actually hasn’t done that in a long time and has been making more “normal” movies like The Running Man since The World’s End in 2013, but that’s still the kind of movie that made him a big deal. It’s worth noting that he can do other things and that he is also good at those. Last Night In Soho is streaming for free on Prime Video with ads. text: Anya Taylor Joy and Jenna Ortega step into a surprising new role together US TODAY’S PAPER | November 27, 2025 | EPAPER ☰ Home Latest Pakistan Business World Sports Opinion Life & Style T-Magazine Blogs Tech Videos Cartoon Home Entertainment Anya Taylor Joy and Jenna Ortega step into a surprising new role together Anya Taylor Joy and Jenna Ortega join the Marrakech jury as global attention intensifies around the festival Pop Culture & Art November 19, 2025 2 min read facebook twitter whatsup linkded email Anya Taylor Joy and Jenna Ortega have stepped into an influential new chapter as they join the jury of the Marrakech International Film Festival, a role that places both stars at the centre of one of cinema’s most closely watched events. The festival is set to run from late November to early December, attracting filmmakers from around the world who hope to earn recognition for fresh creative work. Their participation has instantly gained global attention, fuelled by the steady rise of both actresses and their growing presence across film and television. Anya Taylor Joy continues to be recognised for dramatic performances that have shaped modern cinema, with credits that include The Queen’s Gambit , Furiosa A Mad Max Saga and Dune Part Two . Jenna Ortega has become a defining face of contemporary genre storytelling through Wednesday and Beetlejuice Beetlejuice . Their growing influence in both critical and commercial spaces has made the announcement particularly notable for fans and industry watchers who follow the shifting power of female performers within international film culture. They will sit alongside an accomplished group that includes Celine Song, Julia Ducournau, Karim Ainouz, Hakim Belabbes and Payman Maadi. Their collective task is to judge fourteen first and second feature films that have been selected for official competition. These films represent new voices from different regions, and the festival has positioned this edition as a moment to highlight talent that may shape the future of global cinema. Bong Joon Ho, already announced as jury president, brings further weight to the event after the cultural impact of his film Parasite . Each jury member brings a distinct perspective shaped by personal craft and history. The range of experience among them is expected to create thoughtful discussion around the selected films. There is considerable anticipation surrounding the choices they will make by the closing ceremony, when the award winners will be announced in early December. Online reactions have already spread across social media platforms, with fans celebrating the combined presence of Taylor Joy and Ortega. Their names trended shortly after the announcement, as users shared clips, edits and enthusiastic comments about seeing the two actresses collaborate in such a prominent setting. The festival appears set for heightened publicity as audiences follow each step leading to its conclusion. The ceremony will mark the end of the competitive process and give the world its first glimpse of the filmmakers the jury believes deserve recognition. The involvement of Taylor Joy and Ortega has already added momentum to the event, and the reactions suggest that interest will continue to grow until the winners are revealed. facebook twitter whatsup linkded email COMMENTS Replying to X Saved ! Fashion Culture Anya Taylor-Joy's sheer Governor's Awards dress is a bride-to-be's dream The Queen's Gambit actress gave a Maison Margiela dress a demure spin for Sunday night's red carpet © Variety via Getty Images Lauren Ramsay Deputy Digital Editor November 17, 2025 Nov 17, 2025, 3:01 PM GMT Share this: The only subject on fashion lovers' lips right now (other than Kim Kardashian's All's Fair wardrobe ) is the 16th Governors Awards , which took place in Los Angeles on Sunday evening. The prestigious ceremony, which happens near the beginning of the awards season period, gave us plenty of food for thought when it comes to sartorial styles and silhouettes to have on our radars this autumn/winter. Spearheading the bridal trends on the red carpet was Anya Taylor-Joy , who gave this season's biggest trend the perfect spin for cool girl brides to be. The Queen's Gambit actress graced the red carpet in a stunning white dress from Maison Margiela's FW25 Couture collection paired with Tiffany & Co. jewellery. The dress featured a high neck, sleeveless silhouette, which hugged her frame, and swathes of etheral chiffon flowed from the waist downwards, creating a dreamy, etheral design. You may also like Daring bustier dresses was the Governors Awards 2025 trend nobody expected Jennifer Lawrence’s off-the-shoulder draped red carpet gown is the ultimate wedding dress for cool-girl brides-to-be Margiela is also a firm favourite brand of experimental dressing muse Kim Kardashian. Whilst the reality TV star often leans into the avant-garde designs , including total face coverings, Anya opted to eschew the face mask and added a nude bra underneath, giving the fearless look a demure edge. © Variety via Getty Images Anya Taylor-Joy wore Maison Margiela to the 16th Governors Awards ceremony The brand's website explains the 2025 collection named 'Artisinal': The verticality and volumes of silhouettes reflect the structures of towers, contrasted with the corsetry, draping and optical illusions that accentuate the anatomy and sculpturalise the physique. Burnished plastic, hand-painted wallpapers and nature morte paintings are collaged and cut into three-dimensional forms, turning the body into canvas." © Launchmetrics Her look was originally from the brand's FW25 couture collection Sheer clothing (be that mildly or completely) has been 2025's most prominent trend, and Anya's sensual white number puts a modest spin on the naked trend. Whilst we may have expected to see a wave of see-through dresses on Sunday's red carpet, it was another, totally unexpected trend that dominated the red carpet ... It all started off as a typically polished and sophisticated look straight from the Anya Taylor-Joy style playbook. The Dune actor wore an oversized white wool coat with a tie-waist and rounded lapels, her collar elegantly popped. Whether on the streets of New York or on the red carpet for a premiere, trust that you’ll see her in elegant silhouettes and louche tailoring via The Row and Dior. She’s come to match her sartorial sensibilities with her glam. Photographed yesterday (November 1) at the New York premiere of Die My Love , Lawrence wore a perfectly lined scarlet red lip. Her makeup, by Georgie Eisdell , centered on the witchy red tone, with a flawless base and soft bronze cheek contour, a delicate smoky brown eye and black mascara. Lawrence’s blonde hair, by Gregory Russell , was swept into a sleek side parting and kept long down her back, straight, and glossy. Eisdell, Lawrence’s go-to makeup artist and who counts clients including Anya Taylor-Joy and Dakota Johnson, is known for creating timeless visages: soft and blurred lips, radiant complexions, diaphanous smoky eyes. Jennifer Lawrence at the New York premiere of Die My Love . Photo: Getty Images The vampy glam—propeled by a makeup bag full of Dior Beauty—was in a bewitching rhythm with her sculptural black Dior gown, a gold, platinum, enamel, and diamond ‘Hot Dog’ necklace by David Webb, and the perfect pair of Manolo Blahnik black pumps with a delicate cold ankle chain. Over the years, the Jennifer Lawrence glam team has established some polished beauty routine signatures: her Birkin bangs , a soft eyeliner flick, and when requiring max impact, a statement red lip. It’s a classic beauty move that makes sense for a star who favors understated style with elevated details. On some of her earliest red carpet appearances (think Hunger Games era) Lawrence paired more juicy red lips with lashings of mascara and punky eyeshadow combos to match a then-more edgy style. A face of Dior Beauty’s Addict lipstick since 2015, Lawrence has had over a decade to play with the house’s lippie range, testing out fawn pinks, gothic plums, and brick reds. Jennifer Lawrence at the Passengers premiere, 2016. Photo: Splash News Jennifer Lawrence attends the Red Sparrow New York premiere in 2018. Photo: Getty Images Jennifer Lawrence at the 2018 BAFTAs. Photo: Getty Images As she’s matured into her contemporary, elegant sense of style—growing out her pixie cut and letting down the top knots, smudging less eyeliner, and finding The Row—she’s come to roll out a sumptuous red lip against a more parred back, timeless visage. Instagram content This evening’s lip in question errs on the witchier shade of reds for Lawrence, veering into Cabernet territory, moisture sealed in with a touch of hydrating gloss. Against her dramatic Dior gown and the screening of her already Oscar-rumored movie, Jennifer Lawrence knows the true power of the expertly employed red lip. Curiously, Yoshi doesn’t make an appearance here. But given the last film’s post credits sequence, we can probably expect to see the shoe-wearing dinosaur as we get closer to The Super Mario Galaxy Movie ’s April 3rd, 2026 premiere date. Back in February, as a Valentine's Day offering, Apple TV debuted his genre mash-up The Gorge . The film passed a remarkable streaming milestone this week, cementing itself as one of Apple's biggest-ever original hits. The Gorge follows two snipers positioned at opposite ends of a mysterious gorge, tasked with guarding it for exactly one year. They eventually end up making contact with each other, hitting it off, and promptly falling into the gorge to fend off whatever it has in store for them. Anya Taylor-Joy and Miles Teller played the lead pair, who are put through a gamut of genres over the course of the film. What begins as a romantic drama turns into a conspiracy thriller , a science-fiction spectacle, and then, a survival movie . The Gorge earned mostly positive reviews , and is now sitting at a 62% score on the aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes, where the critics' consensus reads, "Mixing multiple genres, The Gorge makes for a surprisingly endearing romance until its action-thriller obligations steer proceedings back onto a more predictable path." In her review , Collider's Therese Lacson described it as " a silly, popcorn movie that is reminiscent of the mid-budget movies of the '00s ." Despite the mixed critical reception, The Gorge was embraced by audiences, which is the primary reason behind its stupendous success. According to FlixPatrol, the movie has completed 250 days in Apple's domestic top 10 , making it one of the platform's biggest hits ever, alongside titles such as Greyhound and The Family Plan . Derrickson's Black Phone 2 earned superior reviews from critics, and is sitting at a 72% on RT. That film made over $100 million globally and is now available to stream at home. Both Anya Taylor-Joy and Miles Teller Have Major Movies Coming Up Taylor-Joy had a difficult 2024, with her massively-mounted tent pole, Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga , flopping at the box office despite positive reviews. The movie made just around $175 million globally, against a reported budget of around $170 million. She'll next star alongside Chris Evans and Salma Hayek in Sacrifice , director Romain Gavras ' follow-up to the criminally underrated action masterpiece Athena . More prominently, she will play a major role in the upcoming Dune: Part Three . Teller, on the other hand, will play a supporting role in Antoine Fuqua 's upcoming Michael Jackson biopic . You can watch The Gorge at home, and stay tuned to Collider for more updates. These Hotels Come With Centuries-Old Churches By Nicole Kliest November 25, 2025 Facebook X Pinterest Save Story Photo: Courtesy of Mandarin Oriental, Canouan Save Story Save this story Save Story Save this story Planning a wedding requires a myriad of pressing decisions—chief among them the destination. A ceremony’s venue helps set the tone for the entire event, whether it’s saying “I do” beneath a canopy of pine trees, or on a sandy beach beneath the setting sun. For couples who appreciate a storied atmosphere, exchanging vows inside a historic chapel can feel especially romantic. Religion aside, these centuries-old structures showcase original architecture and artwork, which imbue the occasion with even more significance. If such a setting is in line with your vision, take note of the nine exquisite hotels below. At each of these properties (which can be bought out for wedding weekends), a centuries-old church offers a dreamy focal point for the big day. If an international getaway is the marching order, consider the Peruvian Andes or the French Riviera . Or, if domestic locales are preferred for ease of travel, a 19th-century, celebrity-approved church in New Orleans is also on the roster. Continue below for a design-forward dose of matrimonial inspiration. Pieve Aldina (Tuscany, Italy) Photo: Yacine Sadik This 22-key hotel in the heart of Chianti epitomizes the Tuscan countryside. The drive to reach the Fontenille Collection property is like entering a painting; meandering hillsides dotted with vines and cypress trees slowly reveal Pieve Aldina ’s verdant entrance. This was once the summer residence for the Bishops of Siena in the 15th and 16th century, so if historical significance is on your ceremonial checklist, consider that box checked. An aura of romance permeates the estate, from the wood-fired kitchen to the olive groves (where guests are encouraged to wander). But the most magnificent slice of the past is the property’s well-preserved Romanesque church of Santa Maria Novella, which dates to the 10th century and still has frescoes from the 1500s. It’s one of the oldest churches of its kind in the Florentine heritage, and available for privatization for intimate nuptials. Book Now Monasterio, A Belmond Hotel (Cusco, Peru) Photo: Monasterio, A Belmond Hotel, Cusco High in the Peruvian Andes, Cusco enchants travelers with its winding cobbled streets and Inca ruins. Naturally, the landscape makes a breathtaking backdrop for wedding ceremonies, particularly those held within Monasterio, A Belmond Hotel . This former monastery and national monument dates back to 1595 and includes a grand Baroque chapel adorned with large-scale original paintings and luminous gold leaf interiors. The cloistered courtyard adjacent to the chapel possesses a 300-year-old cedar tree, further adding to the historical affect of the setting. Book Now Hotel Peter & Paul (New Orleans, Louisiana) Photo: Hotel Peter & Paul New Orleans is a favored destination for couples tying the knot thanks to the celebratory atmosphere and historic architecture. At Hotel Peter + Paul (located in the Marigny), a former Catholic church from the 19th century serves as the setting, including the adjacent brick church built by architect Henry Howard. Inside, stained glass windows, cypress wood moldings, and restored murals steal the scene, as do the soaring ceilings and grand columns. The original bell remains in the bell tower, and the monastic light all swirls together to create a magical environment for nuptials (including Anya Taylor-Joy, who held her private ceremony here in 2022). Book Now Botanic Sanctuary (Antwerp, Belgium) Photo: Hugo Thomassen Photography For those with a flair for the dramatic, the towering gothic chapel at Botanic Sanctuary Antwerp awaits. This 108-room hotel occupies a former 13th-century monastery and lies beside the city’s botanical garden. Those saying “I do” within the 1400-era chapel can begin their wedding day at the property’s soothing spa, which sprawls across three floors and one thousand square meters. After the ceremony, drift outside to the Monastery Garden for atmospheric canapés, and conclude the event in the hotel’s plush bridal suite. Guests traveling for the big day will be well positioned for exploration: discover over 2,000 species at the neighboring botanic garden, and immerse in the city’s fashion legacy with a day of shopping the greats. Book Now Mandarin Oriental, Canouan (St. Vincent & Grenadines) Photo: Courtesy of Mandarin Oriental, Canouan Ticking off the boxes for both a historic chapel and tropical climate, Canouan Estate's ’s church offers a unique spin on tying the knot. The original structure was built in 17th-century England, later dismantled, then transferred to the island and reconstructed stone by stone in the early 1800s. The non-denominational chapel now sits among lush, leafy palms and holds between 50 to 80 guests. Up until recently, the island has long been considered a best-kept secret , but has quickly become a Caribbean favorite thanks to its convenient location, unobstructed mountainsides, and luxurious accommodations and wellness facilities (don’t miss the overwater spas at the Mandarin Oriental Canouan). By Marci Robin November 13, 2025 Photo: Getty Images Save Story Save this story Save Story Save this story A big chunk of the country is shaking off snow from an early wave of super-cold weather, but it seems it might have left a lasting impression on Anya Taylor-Joy . At the Tiffany & Co. Celebrates the Holidays event in New York City last night, she went full ice queen, right down—and especially—to her fingertips. The actor and Tiffany & Co. ambassador was, of course, decked out in the iconic brand's jewelry, which complemented the white, asymmetrical, corseted Dilara Findikoğlu halter dress that, despite being mini, gives very wintry vibes. (Even more wintry: the big, white coat she was also spotted in.) Always ethereal, Taylor-Joy wore her platinum blonde hair in a taut, sleek updo that culminated in a smooth bun that leaves the ends out. With her hair off her face, it was no problem getting a good look at her glowing skin, lush lashes, and glossy berry lip. Photo: Getty Images But perhaps the most impressive element of her beauty look is her manicure, which all but announced that she is so very ready for winter. Photo: Getty Images Each extra-long nail extended far past her fingertips to end in a sharp point. A frosty white extends unevenly to the middle of each nail, giving way to a gradient effect with a clear, textured finish through the rest of the length. The resulting look is undeniably icicle-inspired. Photo: Getty Images We know it's not even Thanksgiving yet, but you have to admit, it's tempting to skip the go-to burnt oranges and burgundies of the season and skip right to icy inspo for your next manicure, no? Now, this spicy little morsel of a delicious film is set to land on free streaming next month, giving viewers a chance to taste its wares for the low, low cost of nothing. If the culinary metaphors above didn't give it away, we're talking about The Menu , director Mark Mylod's fantastic 2022 horror movie that was as much a satirical take on food culture and elitism as it was a dark comedy that explored the depths of fandom. Hitting theaters on November 18, 2022, The Menu managed to gross $79.6 million at the box office against a $30 million budget, making it a successful hit that only helped bolster Taylor-Joy's star power following movies like Last Night in Soho and The Northman , as well as a starring role in the Netflix juggernaut, The Queen's Gambit . Also starring Ralph Fiennes, Nicholas Hoult, Hong Chau, Janet McTeer, Judith Light, and John Leguizamo, The Menu is making its way to Tubi on December 1, 2025, meaning it will be free to stream for all those who have yet to see it. If you haven't, you're missing out on a real treat, because it's one of those movies that feels like a breath of fresh air thanks to the mere fact that you never know what's going to happen next. Holding a Certified Fresh rating of 88% on Rotten Tomatoes , it's been called everything from "brilliant" to "intense." Fiennes portrayal of celebrity chef Julian Slowik is an absolute blast to watch, as is Hoult's performance as the guest who worships the ground he walks on. Check out the full synopsis for The Menu below: "A young couple (Taylor-Joy & Hoult) travels to an exclusive island restaurant run by the legendary Chef Slowik (Fiennes), where each meticulously crafted course reveals disturbing surprises. As the night unfolds, the elite guests realize they're part of a twisted, carefully planned menu that forces them to confront their secrets, their privilege, and the price of their indulgence." What's Next for Anya Taylor-Joy? Ralph Fiennes and Anya Taylor-Joy in The Menu Searchlight Pictures Following a fairly low-key 2025 that saw her appear in Apple TV+'s The Gorge , and the TIFF indie hit, Sacrifice , Taylor-Joy is set to make 2026 a big year thanks to two, highly anticipated sequels. First up is the animated adventure comedy, The Super Mario Galaxy Movie , which serves as a follow-up to The Super Mario Bros. Movie . If you'll recall, that one was a huge smash that shattered all sorts of records in 2023, and ultimately earned more than $1.3 billion at the box office. Can lightning strike twice for Taylor-Joy, who's reprising her role as Princess Peach? We'll find out when it opens on April 3, 2026. After that, the star will once again brave the desert sands of Arrakis as she makes her triumphant return to Denis Villeneuve's Dune saga, where she'll reprise her role of Alia Atreides in the third and final movie. That one is slated to hit theaters on December 18, 2026. As we await more news on what the future holds for Taylor-Joy, don't sleep on her phenomenal performance in The Menu , which will stream for free on Tubi beginning Dec. 1.
