Got it Normal text size Larger text size Very large text size Advertisement Rebel Wilson has denied she is a liar and a bully and said the multiple defamation suits launched against her by the producers and star of her film The Deb were the result of people “trying to sling mud at me”. “There is zero evidence of any kind of … bullying or anything,” said Wilson. “And these lawsuits, these allegations, these things are just people who, you know, are trying to sling mud at me … This is a situation where I was a whistleblower. I stood up when it was important to stand up and say something.” Rebel Wilson on 60 Minutes. The actor and director has denied being a liar and a bully on her film The Deb. Wilson made the comments on *Nine’s flagship current affairs program 60 Minutes on Sunday night, in which she addressed the legal issues surrounding The Deb , which include multiple lawsuits , allegations of sexual harassment, false imprisonment, financial irregularities and the creation of a smear campaign against one of the film’s producers. Speaking to reporter Tara Brown, Wilson said it was “absolutely untrue” that she had asked her publicist to “register and publish a series of malicious websites” about one of the film’s producers, Amanda Ghost. Loading Wilson also denied directing her 11 million Instagram followers to those websites, which described Ghost as “the Indian Ghislaine Maxwell”. “I don’t have any memory of doing that,” replied Wilson. Wilson first met Brown on the set of the musical in Carcoar, in central-west NSW, in October 2023 for what was ostensibly a feel-good story about Wilson’s directorial debut. The film is the story of two teenagers – farm girl Taylah (Natalie Abbott) and her city cousin Maeve (Charlotte MacInnes) – attending a debutant ball in a small country town. It is adapted from a stage show of the same name written by Hannah Reilly, with music by Megan Washington. Wilson also stars in the film and has a writing credit. Advertisement On 60 Minutes , Wilson described the legal situation surrounding The Deb as “like your worst nightmare”. “I can’t remember the last $20 million movie that’s resulted in three lawsuits,” said Wilson. Rebel Wilson with 60 Minutes reporter Tara Brown on the set of The Deb in Carcoar in October 2023. Wilson is being sued in the Federal Court by MacInnes, who claims Wilson defamed her on Instagram, posting that MacInnes changed her story about being sexually harassed by producer Amanda Ghost. Wilson is also being sued for defamation in the Los Angeles Superior Court by the film’s British producers, Ghost and Gregor Cameron, and its Australian executive producer Vince Holden, after Wilson claimed on Instagram that the trio was blocking the film’s premiere at the 2024 Toronto International Film Festival. Appearing in a video post in July 2024, Wilson accused them of “inappropriate behaviour towards the lead actress” and “embezzling funds from the film’s budget”. Separately, Holden’s company A.I. Films filed a case in the NSW Supreme Court in September, alleging Wilson blocked The Deb ’s release with legal threats and had falsely outed MacInnes as a victim of sexual misconduct. “When you’re getting this opportunity to direct a movie, and it’s something you’ve spent years of work on,” she said. “It came out of left field, these, these issues, and yeah, it was horrible to deal with, and I had to try to navigate it professionally.” The Deb team at the Cannes Film Festival in 2023: (from left) Natalie Abbott, Rebel Wilson, Charlotte MacInnes and Stevie Jean. Photo: Darren England/AAP PHOTOS The production firms behind Rebel Wilson's directorial debut have made a vigorous legal attack against the A-lister seeking to shut down legal claims over the conflict-beset film. Subscribe now for unlimited access . Login or signup to continue reading All articles from our website The digital version of Today's Paper All other regional websites in your area Continue The Deb, a musical comedy filmed in rural NSW, premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival in September 2024 but has yet to see a wider release amid ongoing disputes between Wilson and her co-producers. Those producers Amanda Ghost, Gregor Cameron and Vince Holden have sued the high-profile actor in California over allegedly defamatory claims she made publicly about them. Her accusations include embezzlement, sexual harassment of the film's lead actor Charlotte MacInnes, bullying over the sexual misconduct claims and obstruction of the film's release. AI Film Productions, Dunburn Debutantes Commissioning Company and Dunburn Debutantes - companies behind The Deb headed by the three producers - have sued Wilson and her firm Camp Sugar in the NSW Supreme Court. They are seeking damages and compensation for lost revenue over the actor's alleged breaches of contract, injurious falsehoods and misleading statements. On Thursday, the production companies made their NSW Supreme Court bid to shut down claims brought by the A-lister in California through what's known as an anti-suit injunction. In the US, Wilson is seeking damages, payment of an allegedly outstanding producer's fee, reimbursement of development costs and the revocation of several contracts she says she signed under duress. Barrister Sue Chrysanthou SC, representing the three production companies, said an anti-suit injunction was necessary because contracts signed by Wilson mostly required legal disputes to be determined under NSW law. The ongoing spat also had no connection with California because the three producers were based in the UK and the disputed contracts were signed in Australia, the barrister argued. Even Wilson, who says she has resided in Los Angeles since 2009, listed her place of residence as Sydney's inner-west when making preparations to film The Deb, Ms Chrysanthou said. Allowing the Californian case to continue would raise the risk of a US judge coming to different, inconsistent findings to a NSW judge despite similar claims being raised, she told Justice Elisabeth Peden. Rebel Wilson has been paid over $1 million for her roles as actor, director and producer of The Deb. (Lukas Coch/AAP PHOTOS) Wilson and her company Camp Sugar signed her first written agreement in February 2023 with UK-based firm AI Film Productions over the filming of The Deb, the court heard, and entered into a number of separate contracts over the next eight months. She has been paid over $1 million for her roles as actor, director and producer. In California, AI Films has asked the court to quash the case against it while Ms Ghost, Mr Cameron and Mr Holden have all attacked Wilson's pleadings. MacInnes has also been deposed to give evidence in the US. In arguing to shut down Wilson's claims, Ms Chrysanthou said all these steps would be extremely expensive, prejudicing her clients because they could not recover legal costs under Californian law. Renée Enbom KC, representing Wilson and her company, defended the Californian claims as completely orthodox. She argued that any anti-suit injunction should not be granted. The claims were connected to the defamation lawsuit filed by the three producers in California which was where Wilson resided anyway, Ms Enbom said. The three production firms could have brought their case in the US instead of filing new proceedings in the NSW Supreme Court, the barrister argued. Rebel Wilson has also been sued for defamation by the film's lead actor. (Steven Markham/AAP PHOTOS) Furthermore, after a meeting at Bel-Air Hotel in Los Angeles between Wilson and Ms Ghost, an oral agreement was made to co-produce The Deb creating another link with the US state, the court heard. Justice Peden has retired to consider her final decision. Wilson has also been sued for defamation by MacInnes in the Federal Court over social media posts which claimed the actor revealed she was subjected to sexual harassment. MacInnes' denials that any sexual misconduct took place have not deterred Wilson who has stood by the claims. Share ADVERTISEMENT Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after her latest public appearance seemed to hint at “unresolved tensions.” The 23-year-old actress attended Netflix’s FYC (For Your Consideration) event for her hit series Wednesday on Sunday, November 10, in Los Angeles, alongside some of her co-stars. “She promoting the show through emotional damage now,” expressed one worried user after Ortega appeared distant and emotionally vulnerable. Highlights Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after appearing emotionally withdrawn during a recent Netflix FYC event for Wednesday. The panel was reportedly a paid appearance organized by the showrunners to promote the second season of the series ahead of the upcoming awards season. Fans pointed out her “lost” body language, with some speculating tension between Jenna and the showrunners in attendance. RELATED: The Wednesday star was joined by her on-screen parents, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán, along with the showrunners Jenna Ortega with serious expression and dark wavy hair, showing concern at Wednesday cast event. ADVERTISEMENT Part of Netflix’s FYC campaign, the event aimed to promote the show further for the upcoming awards season. During the session, the stars participated in exclusive Q&A segments, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and reflecting on their filming experiences. Jenna Ortega holding a microphone with a serious expression, showing silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. She then abruptly shook her head, wiped her nose, and straightened up in her chair, though she appeared zoned out and disengaged from the ongoing discussion. Jenna Ortega portraying Wednesday with intense expression and braided hair at a Wednesday cast event outdoors. Image credits: Netflix ADVERTISEMENT Tweet expressing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence at Wednesday cast event and show promotion. Image credits: zstronz78 At one point, she rested her chin on her hand and stared at the floor for nearly 10-12 seconds. Even as others around her broke into applause in her honor, Jenna remained expressionless. Sharing the video, user KatrineZstronz expressed her own concern, writing, “I’ve never seen Jenna acting like this at any event. It’s so sad.” The 23-year-old’s “lost” gestures left many netizens “confused,” with some questioning why she was acting that way Jenna Ortega sitting with a concerned expression at a Wednesday cast event, holding a microphone. Image credits: Apse__mtlb Referring to a major plotline in the second season where Jenna and Emma Myers’ characters reportedly switch bodies, they added, “They’ve been very unprofessional towards Emma by informing her of the body switch just weeks before the episode… and other stuff.” ADVERTISEMENT Another fan echoed the sentiment, claiming, “Jenna was NOT happy about how spontaneous the body swap script came… it literally put her into a bit of a panic and fearful…” “The silence in her eyes is louder than the promo budget,” one user remarked Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Viewers also pointed out a moment where the actress appeared to get “lost” mid-answer while discussing her bond with co-star Emma. Share ADVERTISEMENT Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after her latest public appearance seemed to hint at “unresolved tensions.” The 23-year-old actress attended Netflix’s FYC (For Your Consideration) event for her hit series Wednesday on Sunday, November 10, in Los Angeles, alongside some of her co-stars. “She promoting the show through emotional damage now,” expressed one worried user after Ortega appeared distant and emotionally vulnerable. Highlights Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after appearing emotionally withdrawn during a recent Netflix FYC event for Wednesday. The panel was reportedly a paid appearance organized by the showrunners to promote the second season of the series ahead of the upcoming awards season. Fans pointed out her “lost” body language, with some speculating tension between Jenna and the showrunners in attendance. RELATED: The Wednesday star was joined by her on-screen parents, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán, along with the showrunners Jenna Ortega with serious expression and dark wavy hair, showing concern at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: JC Olivera/Variety The panel featured Jenna Ortega, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán representing the cast, where they discussed the cultural impact of the series, its Emmy nominations, and the massive fandom it has built over time. ADVERTISEMENT Part of Netflix’s FYC campaign, the event aimed to promote the show further for the upcoming awards season. During the session, the stars participated in exclusive Q&A segments, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and reflecting on their filming experiences. Jenna Ortega holding a microphone with a serious expression, showing silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: goldderby Dressed in an all-black pinstriped suit from the Ann Demeulemeester FW25 collection, Ortega raised concerns among fans with her noticeably tense “body language.” One user named KatrineZstronz on X reposted a clip from the panel, sparking widespread online discussion. Jenna Ortega had received an Emmy nomination for Lead Actress in a Comedy Series ahead of Wednesday’s Season 2 premiere in September Jenna Ortega sitting with a downcast gaze, wearing a striped vest and cross necklace at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Tweet by user @cairobow stating her body language is louder than any words, relating to concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: cairobow ADVERTISEMENT The now-viral clip was captioned, “Her body language is louder than any words.” In the video, Jenna was seen holding a microphone while resting her head on her free hand for several seconds, eyes closed. She then abruptly shook her head, wiped her nose, and straightened up in her chair, though she appeared zoned out and disengaged from the ongoing discussion. Jenna Ortega portraying Wednesday with intense expression and braided hair at a Wednesday cast event outdoors. Image credits: Netflix ADVERTISEMENT Tweet expressing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence at Wednesday cast event and show promotion. Even as others around her broke into applause in her honor, Jenna remained expressionless. Sharing the video, user KatrineZstronz expressed her own concern, writing, “I’ve never seen Jenna acting like this at any event. Share ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after her latest public appearance seemed to hint at “unresolved tensions.” The 23-year-old actress attended Netflix’s FYC (For Your Consideration) event for her hit series Wednesday on Sunday, November 10, in Los Angeles, alongside some of her co-stars. “She promoting the show through emotional damage now,” expressed one worried user after Ortega appeared distant and emotionally vulnerable. Highlights Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after appearing emotionally withdrawn during a recent Netflix FYC event for Wednesday. The panel was reportedly a paid appearance organized by the showrunners to promote the second season of the series ahead of the upcoming awards season. Fans pointed out her “lost” body language, with some speculating tension between Jenna and the showrunners in attendance. RELATED: The Wednesday star was joined by her on-screen parents, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán, along with the showrunners Jenna Ortega with serious expression and dark wavy hair, showing concern at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: JC Olivera/Variety The panel featured Jenna Ortega, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán representing the cast, where they discussed the cultural impact of the series, its Emmy nominations, and the massive fandom it has built over time. ADVERTISEMENT Part of Netflix’s FYC campaign, the event aimed to promote the show further for the upcoming awards season. During the session, the stars participated in exclusive Q&A segments, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and reflecting on their filming experiences. Jenna Ortega holding a microphone with a serious expression, showing silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: goldderby Dressed in an all-black pinstriped suit from the Ann Demeulemeester FW25 collection, Ortega raised concerns among fans with her noticeably tense “body language.” One user named KatrineZstronz on X reposted a clip from the panel, sparking widespread online discussion. Jenna Ortega had received an Emmy nomination for Lead Actress in a Comedy Series ahead of Wednesday’s Season 2 premiere in September Jenna Ortega sitting with a downcast gaze, wearing a striped vest and cross necklace at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Tweet by user @cairobow stating her body language is louder than any words, relating to concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: cairobow The now-viral clip was captioned, “Her body language is louder than any words.” In the video, Jenna was seen holding a microphone while resting her head on her free hand for several seconds, eyes closed. She then abruptly shook her head, wiped her nose, and straightened up in her chair, though she appeared zoned out and disengaged from the ongoing discussion. Jenna Ortega portraying Wednesday with intense expression and braided hair at a Wednesday cast event outdoors. Image credits: Netflix ADVERTISEMENT Tweet expressing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence at Wednesday cast event and show promotion. Image credits: zstronz78 At one point, she rested her chin on her hand and stared at the floor for nearly 10-12 seconds. Even as others around her broke into applause in her honor, Jenna remained expressionless. Sharing the video, user KatrineZstronz expressed her own concern, writing, “I’ve never seen Jenna acting like this at any event. It’s so sad.” The 23-year-old’s “lost” gestures left many netizens “confused,” with some questioning why she was acting that way Jenna Ortega sitting with a concerned expression at a Wednesday cast event, holding a microphone. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT Tweet discussing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: OrtegasDimples “I guess people have their answer on why she didn’t promote the show so much on her socials .” The same user doubled down in the replies, speculating on what might have caused the Miller’s Girl star’s demeanor at the event. “The showrunners. They’ve been having different views since forever, one of them doesn’t even follow Jenna on ig.” Jenna Ortega looking pensive and silent at Wednesday cast event, sparking concern over her behavior and silence in her eyes. Image credits: Rama’s Screen Tweet discussing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: Apse__mtlb Referring to a major plotline in the second season where Jenna and Emma Myers’ characters reportedly switch bodies, they added, “They’ve been very unprofessional towards Emma by informing her of the body switch just weeks before the episode… and other stuff.” Another fan echoed the sentiment, claiming, “Jenna was NOT happy about how spontaneous the body swap script came… it literally put her into a bit of a panic and fearful…” “The silence in her eyes is louder than the promo budget,” one user remarked Image credits: Rama’s Screen Viewers also pointed out a moment where the actress appeared to get “lost” mid-answer while discussing her bond with co-star Emma. The fan noted, “The concept of jenna getting lost in complimenting emma that she had to ask what was the question AGAIN.” Another concerned user commented, “Nah she looks visibly over it like you can tell she already mentally quit halfway through that promo run.” Jenna Ortega at Wednesday cast event, wearing dark striped outfit with serious expression, graveyard-themed backdrop. Image credits: Steve Granitz/FilmMagic “You could tell she was annoyed and over it, she kept avoiding eye contact. Honestly, I just hope season 3 ends it, so she can finally work on something where everyone involved is genuinely valued.” This isn’t the first time Jenna has faced online scrutiny over her body language. Jenna was previously criticized online amid rumors of a feud with her co-star Emma Myers Image credits: Still Watching Netflix A few months back, Ortega and Myers were heavily rumored by fans to be dating in real life following their red carpet appearances during the Netflix show’s premiere. Many at the time even alleged that Jenna was “ pushing herself ” onto Emma, who appeared distant from the actress during later press tours. Share ADVERTISEMENT Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after her latest public appearance seemed to hint at “unresolved tensions.” The 23-year-old actress attended Netflix’s FYC (For Your Consideration) event for her hit series Wednesday on Sunday, November 10, in Los Angeles, alongside some of her co-stars. “She promoting the show through emotional damage now,” expressed one worried user after Ortega appeared distant and emotionally vulnerable. Highlights Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after appearing emotionally withdrawn during a recent Netflix FYC event for Wednesday. The panel was reportedly a paid appearance organized by the showrunners to promote the second season of the series ahead of the upcoming awards season. Fans pointed out her “lost” body language, with some speculating tension between Jenna and the showrunners in attendance. RELATED: The Wednesday star was joined by her on-screen parents, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán, along with the showrunners Jenna Ortega with serious expression and dark wavy hair, showing concern at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: JC Olivera/Variety The panel featured Jenna Ortega, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán representing the cast, where they discussed the cultural impact of the series, its Emmy nominations, and the massive fandom it has built over time. ADVERTISEMENT Part of Netflix’s FYC campaign, the event aimed to promote the show further for the upcoming awards season. During the session, the stars participated in exclusive Q&A segments, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and reflecting on their filming experiences. Jenna Ortega holding a microphone with a serious expression, showing silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: goldderby Dressed in an all-black pinstriped suit from the Ann Demeulemeester FW25 collection, Ortega raised concerns among fans with her noticeably tense “body language.” One user named KatrineZstronz on X reposted a clip from the panel, sparking widespread online discussion. Jenna Ortega had received an Emmy nomination for Lead Actress in a Comedy Series ahead of Wednesday’s Season 2 premiere in September Jenna Ortega sitting with a downcast gaze, wearing a striped vest and cross necklace at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Tweet by user @cairobow stating her body language is louder than any words, relating to concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: cairobow ADVERTISEMENT The now-viral clip was captioned, “Her body language is louder than any words.” In the video, Jenna was seen holding a microphone while resting her head on her free hand for several seconds, eyes closed. She then abruptly shook her head, wiped her nose, and straightened up in her chair, though she appeared zoned out and disengaged from the ongoing discussion. Jenna Ortega portraying Wednesday with intense expression and braided hair at a Wednesday cast event outdoors. Image credits: Netflix ADVERTISEMENT Tweet expressing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence at Wednesday cast event and show promotion. Image credits: zstronz78 At one point, she rested her chin on her hand and stared at the floor for nearly 10-12 seconds. Even as others around her broke into applause in her honor, Jenna remained expressionless. Sharing the video, user KatrineZstronz expressed her own concern, writing, “I’ve never seen Jenna acting like this at any event. It’s so sad.” The 23-year-old’s “lost” gestures left many netizens “confused,” with some questioning why she was acting that way Jenna Ortega sitting with a concerned expression at a Wednesday cast event, holding a microphone. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT Tweet discussing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: OrtegasDimples “I guess people have their answer on why she didn’t promote the show so much on her socials .” The same user doubled down in the replies, speculating on what might have caused the Miller’s Girl star’s demeanor at the event. “The showrunners. They’ve been having different views since forever, one of them doesn’t even follow Jenna on ig.” Jenna Ortega looking pensive and silent at Wednesday cast event, sparking concern over her behavior and silence in her eyes. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Tweet discussing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: Apse__mtlb Referring to a major plotline in the second season where Jenna and Emma Myers’ characters reportedly switch bodies, they added, “They’ve been very unprofessional towards Emma by informing her of the body switch just weeks before the episode… and other stuff.” ADVERTISEMENT Another fan echoed the sentiment, claiming, “Jenna was NOT happy about how spontaneous the body swap script came… it literally put her into a bit of a panic and fearful…” “The silence in her eyes is louder than the promo budget,” one user remarked Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Viewers also pointed out a moment where the actress appeared to get “lost” mid-answer while discussing her bond with co-star Emma. The fan noted, “The concept of jenna getting lost in complimenting emma that she had to ask what was the question AGAIN.” Another concerned user commented, “Nah she looks visibly over it like you can tell she already mentally quit halfway through that promo run.” Jenna Ortega at Wednesday cast event, wearing dark striped outfit with serious expression, graveyard-themed backdrop. Image credits: Steve Granitz/FilmMagic “You could tell she was annoyed and over it, she kept avoiding eye contact. Honestly, I just hope season 3 ends it, so she can finally work on something where everyone involved is genuinely valued.” This isn’t the first time Jenna has faced online scrutiny over her body language. Jenna was previously criticized online amid rumors of a feud with her co-star Emma Myers ADVERTISEMENT Image credits: Still Watching Netflix ADVERTISEMENT A few months back, Ortega and Myers were heavily rumored by fans to be dating in real life following their red carpet appearances during the Netflix show’s premiere. Many at the time even alleged that Jenna was “ pushing herself ” onto Emma, who appeared distant from the actress during later press tours. Share ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after her latest public appearance seemed to hint at “unresolved tensions.” The 23-year-old actress attended Netflix’s FYC (For Your Consideration) event for her hit series Wednesday on Sunday, November 10, in Los Angeles, alongside some of her co-stars. “She promoting the show through emotional damage now,” expressed one worried user after Ortega appeared distant and emotionally vulnerable. Highlights Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after appearing emotionally withdrawn during a recent Netflix FYC event for Wednesday. The panel was reportedly a paid appearance organized by the showrunners to promote the second season of the series ahead of the upcoming awards season. Fans pointed out her “lost” body language, with some speculating tension between Jenna and the showrunners in attendance. RELATED: The Wednesday star was joined by her on-screen parents, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán, along with the showrunners Jenna Ortega with serious expression and dark wavy hair, showing concern at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: JC Olivera/Variety The panel featured Jenna Ortega, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán representing the cast, where they discussed the cultural impact of the series, its Emmy nominations, and the massive fandom it has built over time. ADVERTISEMENT Part of Netflix’s FYC campaign, the event aimed to promote the show further for the upcoming awards season. During the session, the stars participated in exclusive Q&A segments, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and reflecting on their filming experiences. Jenna Ortega holding a microphone with a serious expression, showing silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: goldderby Dressed in an all-black pinstriped suit from the Ann Demeulemeester FW25 collection, Ortega raised concerns among fans with her noticeably tense “body language.” One user named KatrineZstronz on X reposted a clip from the panel, sparking widespread online discussion. Jenna Ortega had received an Emmy nomination for Lead Actress in a Comedy Series ahead of Wednesday’s Season 2 premiere in September Jenna Ortega sitting with a downcast gaze, wearing a striped vest and cross necklace at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Tweet by user @cairobow stating her body language is louder than any words, relating to concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: cairobow The now-viral clip was captioned, “Her body language is louder than any words.” In the video, Jenna was seen holding a microphone while resting her head on her free hand for several seconds, eyes closed. She then abruptly shook her head, wiped her nose, and straightened up in her chair, though she appeared zoned out and disengaged from the ongoing discussion. Jenna Ortega portraying Wednesday with intense expression and braided hair at a Wednesday cast event outdoors. Image credits: Netflix ADVERTISEMENT Tweet expressing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence at Wednesday cast event and show promotion. Image credits: zstronz78 At one point, she rested her chin on her hand and stared at the floor for nearly 10-12 seconds. Even as others around her broke into applause in her honor, Jenna remained expressionless. Sharing the video, user KatrineZstronz expressed her own concern, writing, “I’ve never seen Jenna acting like this at any event. It’s so sad.” The 23-year-old’s “lost” gestures left many netizens “confused,” with some questioning why she was acting that way Jenna Ortega sitting with a concerned expression at a Wednesday cast event, holding a microphone. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT Tweet discussing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: OrtegasDimples “I guess people have their answer on why she didn’t promote the show so much on her socials .” The same user doubled down in the replies, speculating on what might have caused the Miller’s Girl star’s demeanor at the event. “The showrunners. They’ve been having different views since forever, one of them doesn’t even follow Jenna on ig.” Jenna Ortega looking pensive and silent at Wednesday cast event, sparking concern over her behavior and silence in her eyes. Image credits: Rama’s Screen Tweet discussing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: Apse__mtlb Referring to a major plotline in the second season where Jenna and Emma Myers’ characters reportedly switch bodies, they added, “They’ve been very unprofessional towards Emma by informing her of the body switch just weeks before the episode… and other stuff.” Another fan echoed the sentiment, claiming, “Jenna was NOT happy about how spontaneous the body swap script came… it literally put her into a bit of a panic and fearful…” “The silence in her eyes is louder than the promo budget,” one user remarked Image credits: Rama’s Screen Viewers also pointed out a moment where the actress appeared to get “lost” mid-answer while discussing her bond with co-star Emma. The fan noted, “The concept of jenna getting lost in complimenting emma that she had to ask what was the question AGAIN.” Another concerned user commented, “Nah she looks visibly over it like you can tell she already mentally quit halfway through that promo run.” Jenna Ortega at Wednesday cast event, wearing dark striped outfit with serious expression, graveyard-themed backdrop. Image credits: Steve Granitz/FilmMagic “You could tell she was annoyed and over it, she kept avoiding eye contact. Honestly, I just hope season 3 ends it, so she can finally work on something where everyone involved is genuinely valued.” This isn’t the first time Jenna has faced online scrutiny over her body language. Jenna was previously criticized online amid rumors of a feud with her co-star Emma Myers Image credits: Still Watching Netflix A few months back, Ortega and Myers were heavily rumored by fans to be dating in real life following their red carpet appearances during the Netflix show’s premiere. Many at the time even alleged that Jenna was “ pushing herself ” onto Emma, who appeared distant from the actress during later press tours. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Gold Derby (@goldderby) While the two stars never addressed those speculations, some people have attributed Jenna’s latest behavior to that. “100% media training because of the queerbaiting accusations I bet.” However, while the interview failed to impress her fans, her fashion choice certainly didn’t. Share ADVERTISEMENT Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after her latest public appearance seemed to hint at “unresolved tensions.” The 23-year-old actress attended Netflix’s FYC (For Your Consideration) event for her hit series Wednesday on Sunday, November 10, in Los Angeles, alongside some of her co-stars. “She promoting the show through emotional damage now,” expressed one worried user after Ortega appeared distant and emotionally vulnerable. Highlights Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after appearing emotionally withdrawn during a recent Netflix FYC event for Wednesday. The panel was reportedly a paid appearance organized by the showrunners to promote the second season of the series ahead of the upcoming awards season. Fans pointed out her “lost” body language, with some speculating tension between Jenna and the showrunners in attendance. RELATED: The Wednesday star was joined by her on-screen parents, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán, along with the showrunners Jenna Ortega with serious expression and dark wavy hair, showing concern at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: JC Olivera/Variety The panel featured Jenna Ortega, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán representing the cast, where they discussed the cultural impact of the series, its Emmy nominations, and the massive fandom it has built over time. ADVERTISEMENT Part of Netflix’s FYC campaign, the event aimed to promote the show further for the upcoming awards season. During the session, the stars participated in exclusive Q&A segments, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and reflecting on their filming experiences. Jenna Ortega holding a microphone with a serious expression, showing silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: goldderby Dressed in an all-black pinstriped suit from the Ann Demeulemeester FW25 collection, Ortega raised concerns among fans with her noticeably tense “body language.” One user named KatrineZstronz on X reposted a clip from the panel, sparking widespread online discussion. Jenna Ortega had received an Emmy nomination for Lead Actress in a Comedy Series ahead of Wednesday’s Season 2 premiere in September Jenna Ortega sitting with a downcast gaze, wearing a striped vest and cross necklace at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Tweet by user @cairobow stating her body language is louder than any words, relating to concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: cairobow ADVERTISEMENT The now-viral clip was captioned, “Her body language is louder than any words.” In the video, Jenna was seen holding a microphone while resting her head on her free hand for several seconds, eyes closed. She then abruptly shook her head, wiped her nose, and straightened up in her chair, though she appeared zoned out and disengaged from the ongoing discussion. Jenna Ortega portraying Wednesday with intense expression and braided hair at a Wednesday cast event outdoors. Image credits: Netflix ADVERTISEMENT Tweet expressing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence at Wednesday cast event and show promotion. Image credits: zstronz78 At one point, she rested her chin on her hand and stared at the floor for nearly 10-12 seconds. Even as others around her broke into applause in her honor, Jenna remained expressionless. Sharing the video, user KatrineZstronz expressed her own concern, writing, “I’ve never seen Jenna acting like this at any event. It’s so sad.” The 23-year-old’s “lost” gestures left many netizens “confused,” with some questioning why she was acting that way Jenna Ortega sitting with a concerned expression at a Wednesday cast event, holding a microphone. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT Tweet discussing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: OrtegasDimples “I guess people have their answer on why she didn’t promote the show so much on her socials .” The same user doubled down in the replies, speculating on what might have caused the Miller’s Girl star’s demeanor at the event. “The showrunners. They’ve been having different views since forever, one of them doesn’t even follow Jenna on ig.” Jenna Ortega looking pensive and silent at Wednesday cast event, sparking concern over her behavior and silence in her eyes. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Tweet discussing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: Apse__mtlb Referring to a major plotline in the second season where Jenna and Emma Myers’ characters reportedly switch bodies, they added, “They’ve been very unprofessional towards Emma by informing her of the body switch just weeks before the episode… and other stuff.” ADVERTISEMENT Another fan echoed the sentiment, claiming, “Jenna was NOT happy about how spontaneous the body swap script came… it literally put her into a bit of a panic and fearful…” “The silence in her eyes is louder than the promo budget,” one user remarked Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Viewers also pointed out a moment where the actress appeared to get “lost” mid-answer while discussing her bond with co-star Emma. The fan noted, “The concept of jenna getting lost in complimenting emma that she had to ask what was the question AGAIN.” Another concerned user commented, “Nah she looks visibly over it like you can tell she already mentally quit halfway through that promo run.” Jenna Ortega at Wednesday cast event, wearing dark striped outfit with serious expression, graveyard-themed backdrop. Image credits: Steve Granitz/FilmMagic “You could tell she was annoyed and over it, she kept avoiding eye contact. Honestly, I just hope season 3 ends it, so she can finally work on something where everyone involved is genuinely valued.” This isn’t the first time Jenna has faced online scrutiny over her body language. Jenna was previously criticized online amid rumors of a feud with her co-star Emma Myers ADVERTISEMENT Image credits: Still Watching Netflix ADVERTISEMENT A few months back, Ortega and Myers were heavily rumored by fans to be dating in real life following their red carpet appearances during the Netflix show’s premiere. Many at the time even alleged that Jenna was “ pushing herself ” onto Emma, who appeared distant from the actress during later press tours. Share ADVERTISEMENT Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after her latest public appearance seemed to hint at “unresolved tensions.” The 23-year-old actress attended Netflix’s FYC (For Your Consideration) event for her hit series Wednesday on Sunday, November 10, in Los Angeles, alongside some of her co-stars. “She promoting the show through emotional damage now,” expressed one worried user after Ortega appeared distant and emotionally vulnerable. Highlights Jenna Ortega sparked concern among fans after appearing emotionally withdrawn during a recent Netflix FYC event for Wednesday. The panel was reportedly a paid appearance organized by the showrunners to promote the second season of the series ahead of the upcoming awards season. Fans pointed out her “lost” body language, with some speculating tension between Jenna and the showrunners in attendance. RELATED: The Wednesday star was joined by her on-screen parents, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán, along with the showrunners Jenna Ortega with serious expression and dark wavy hair, showing concern at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: JC Olivera/Variety The panel featured Jenna Ortega, Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán representing the cast, where they discussed the cultural impact of the series, its Emmy nominations, and the massive fandom it has built over time. ADVERTISEMENT Part of Netflix’s FYC campaign, the event aimed to promote the show further for the upcoming awards season. During the session, the stars participated in exclusive Q&A segments, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and reflecting on their filming experiences. Jenna Ortega holding a microphone with a serious expression, showing silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: goldderby Dressed in an all-black pinstriped suit from the Ann Demeulemeester FW25 collection, Ortega raised concerns among fans with her noticeably tense “body language.” One user named KatrineZstronz on X reposted a clip from the panel, sparking widespread online discussion. Jenna Ortega had received an Emmy nomination for Lead Actress in a Comedy Series ahead of Wednesday’s Season 2 premiere in September Jenna Ortega sitting with a downcast gaze, wearing a striped vest and cross necklace at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Tweet by user @cairobow stating her body language is louder than any words, relating to concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: cairobow ADVERTISEMENT The now-viral clip was captioned, “Her body language is louder than any words.” In the video, Jenna was seen holding a microphone while resting her head on her free hand for several seconds, eyes closed. She then abruptly shook her head, wiped her nose, and straightened up in her chair, though she appeared zoned out and disengaged from the ongoing discussion. Jenna Ortega portraying Wednesday with intense expression and braided hair at a Wednesday cast event outdoors. Image credits: Netflix ADVERTISEMENT Tweet expressing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence at Wednesday cast event and show promotion. Image credits: zstronz78 At one point, she rested her chin on her hand and stared at the floor for nearly 10-12 seconds. Even as others around her broke into applause in her honor, Jenna remained expressionless. Sharing the video, user KatrineZstronz expressed her own concern, writing, “I’ve never seen Jenna acting like this at any event. It’s so sad.” The 23-year-old’s “lost” gestures left many netizens “confused,” with some questioning why she was acting that way Jenna Ortega sitting with a concerned expression at a Wednesday cast event, holding a microphone. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT Tweet discussing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: OrtegasDimples “I guess people have their answer on why she didn’t promote the show so much on her socials .” The same user doubled down in the replies, speculating on what might have caused the Miller’s Girl star’s demeanor at the event. “The showrunners. They’ve been having different views since forever, one of them doesn’t even follow Jenna on ig.” Jenna Ortega looking pensive and silent at Wednesday cast event, sparking concern over her behavior and silence in her eyes. Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Tweet discussing concern over Jenna Ortega’s behavior and silence in her eyes at Wednesday cast event. Image credits: Apse__mtlb Referring to a major plotline in the second season where Jenna and Emma Myers’ characters reportedly switch bodies, they added, “They’ve been very unprofessional towards Emma by informing her of the body switch just weeks before the episode… and other stuff.” ADVERTISEMENT Another fan echoed the sentiment, claiming, “Jenna was NOT happy about how spontaneous the body swap script came… it literally put her into a bit of a panic and fearful…” “The silence in her eyes is louder than the promo budget,” one user remarked Image credits: Rama’s Screen ADVERTISEMENT Viewers also pointed out a moment where the actress appeared to get “lost” mid-answer while discussing her bond with co-star Emma. The fan noted, “The concept of jenna getting lost in complimenting emma that she had to ask what was the question AGAIN.” Another concerned user commented, “Nah she looks visibly over it like you can tell she already mentally quit halfway through that promo run.” Jenna Ortega at Wednesday cast event, wearing dark striped outfit with serious expression, graveyard-themed backdrop. Image credits: Steve Granitz/FilmMagic “You could tell she was annoyed and over it, she kept avoiding eye contact. Honestly, I just hope season 3 ends it, so she can finally work on something where everyone involved is genuinely valued.” This isn’t the first time Jenna has faced online scrutiny over her body language. Jenna was previously criticized online amid rumors of a feud with her co-star Emma Myers ADVERTISEMENT Image credits: Still Watching Netflix ADVERTISEMENT A few months back, Ortega and Myers were heavily rumored by fans to be dating in real life following their red carpet appearances during the Netflix show’s premiere. Many at the time even alleged that Jenna was “ pushing herself ” onto Emma, who appeared distant from the actress during later press tours. text: Anya Taylor Joy and Jenna Ortega step into a surprising new role together US TODAY’S PAPER | November 27, 2025 | EPAPER ☰ Home Latest Pakistan Business World Sports Opinion Life & Style T-Magazine Blogs Tech Videos Cartoon Home Entertainment Anya Taylor Joy and Jenna Ortega step into a surprising new role together Anya Taylor Joy and Jenna Ortega join the Marrakech jury as global attention intensifies around the festival Pop Culture & Art November 19, 2025 2 min read facebook twitter whatsup linkded email Anya Taylor Joy and Jenna Ortega have stepped into an influential new chapter as they join the jury of the Marrakech International Film Festival, a role that places both stars at the centre of one of cinema’s most closely watched events. The festival is set to run from late November to early December, attracting filmmakers from around the world who hope to earn recognition for fresh creative work. Their participation has instantly gained global attention, fuelled by the steady rise of both actresses and their growing presence across film and television. Anya Taylor Joy continues to be recognised for dramatic performances that have shaped modern cinema, with credits that include The Queen’s Gambit , Furiosa A Mad Max Saga and Dune Part Two . Jenna Ortega has become a defining face of contemporary genre storytelling through Wednesday and Beetlejuice Beetlejuice . Their growing influence in both critical and commercial spaces has made the announcement particularly notable for fans and industry watchers who follow the shifting power of female performers within international film culture. They will sit alongside an accomplished group that includes Celine Song, Julia Ducournau, Karim Ainouz, Hakim Belabbes and Payman Maadi. Their collective task is to judge fourteen first and second feature films that have been selected for official competition. These films represent new voices from different regions, and the festival has positioned this edition as a moment to highlight talent that may shape the future of global cinema. Bong Joon Ho, already announced as jury president, brings further weight to the event after the cultural impact of his film Parasite . Each jury member brings a distinct perspective shaped by personal craft and history. The range of experience among them is expected to create thoughtful discussion around the selected films. There is considerable anticipation surrounding the choices they will make by the closing ceremony, when the award winners will be announced in early December. Online reactions have already spread across social media platforms, with fans celebrating the combined presence of Taylor Joy and Ortega. Their names trended shortly after the announcement, as users shared clips, edits and enthusiastic comments about seeing the two actresses collaborate in such a prominent setting. The festival appears set for heightened publicity as audiences follow each step leading to its conclusion. The ceremony will mark the end of the competitive process and give the world its first glimpse of the filmmakers the jury believes deserve recognition. The involvement of Taylor Joy and Ortega has already added momentum to the event, and the reactions suggest that interest will continue to grow until the winners are revealed. facebook twitter whatsup linkded email COMMENTS Replying to X Saved ! By Thea Felicity Published 16 November 2025, 3:31 PM GMT Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share on Reddit Share on Flipboard Share on Pocket Emma Stone / Bugonia Wikimedia Commons Emma Stone has been named the most beautiful woman in the world, according to a new study that applied the ancient Greek Golden Ratio of Beauty. The mathematical formula measuring facial symmetry and proportion gave the Oscar-winning actress a score of 94.72%. Researchers used computerised facial mapping to assess features including the eyes, lips, jawline, and forehead. Stone narrowly beats Zendaya, who scored 94.37%, and Beyoncé, who came tenth with 92.4%. For faces, it examines ratios such as the distance from the hairline to the eyes, eyes to the bottom of the nose, and nose to chin. The closer the measurements approach the ideal ratio of 1.618, the more 'perfect' the face is considered. Stone excelled in all key facial areas, receiving 97% for her jawline, 95.6% for her lips, and 94.2% for her eyebrows. According to The Daily Mail , Dr. De Silva explained that her consistency across all measures, rather than having a single standout feature, distinguished her from other contenders. Zendaya scored 94.37% with particularly high marks for her lips at 99.5% and forehead at 98%. Dr. De Silva noted her near-uniform excellence in most categories, explaining that the minor differences in measurements accounted for Stone edging ahead. Da Vinci combined art and science to illustrate this concept, showing how a perfectly proportioned human figure could fit within both a circle and a square. In his drawing, he demonstrated that the body's symmetry, ratios, and balance mirrored nature's order. Applying this principle to faces allows researchers to measure symmetry and proportions in unprecedented precision. As we head to even colder days, now is the perfect time for a new hue and a fresh new cut. The soft fringe frames her face perfectly and highlights her signature sharp cheekbones. It’s giving off that French-girl vibe but with a rock n' roll twist. © Gamma-Rapho via Getty Images Keira Knightley at the World Premiere of "King Arthur" in 2003 with her chic black bangs. Keira was way ahead of the trends as experts predict that 2026 will be all about the deep-hued bangs. Elliot Bute, Stylist at Hershesons Fitzrovia, tells H! Fashion: "In 2026, hair is making a statement. We’ll see sharp, structured cuts like bobs and strong bangs returning, but also a huge embrace of natural texture. Sure, she attended Jonathan Anderson’s Dior debut in an itty bitty denim skirt, but it’s rare to see the Wednesday actor in a pair of classic blue jeans, with her gothic glam press tour wardrobe prioritizing lots of leather and lace. Last night, Ortega attended a Netflix event in New York City, where temperatures are in freefall as the autumnal season sets in. Stepping out into the chilly streets, Ortega wrapped up in a Seroya charcoal gray wool coat with big lapels that cinched at the waist. (Cozy cool outerwear is a must right now, see Jennifer Lawrence for ref). Underneath, she wore a slate colored turtleneck and cuffed, dark blue denim jeans that she had cuffed extra long. For shoes and accessories, Ortega opted for black leather gloves and sky-high black platform heels. Her hair was in an on-trend, emo-ish side part . Photo: Getty Images Photo: Getty Images Given that Jenna Ortega is a petite 5’1, the noughties cuffed denim trend is a smart choice for looking stylish without being swallowed up—one that the actor might have rediscovered from attending Givenchy’s spring 2026 show at Paris Fashion Week , where Sarah Burton sent a pair down the runway. Denim also played a huge part in the Dior and Ann Demuelemeester shows that Ortega also would have been taking in. An over-the-told fold comes petite-girl approved (best worn with gargantuan platform shoes like Ortega), but everyone from Anne Hathaway to Bella Hadid has shown their love for this denim style. It feels fall-ready too, avoiding the terror of rain-splashed and roughed-up hems. Givenchy spring 2026. Photo: Courtesy of Givenchy It’s quite the week for more nostalgic styles from Ortega; just yesterday, she rolled it back to 2007 in a pinstripe vest a la Fergie and Avril. As elevated as ever, though, as this was a Ann Demeulemeester fall 2025 tailored waistcoat and matching wide-legged, floor-skimming trousers. Photo: Getty Images Often styled by Enrique Melendez, Ortega has established a sensual, darkly romantic style across the last year: a shredded dress via GapStudio , a reptilian skin-like Ashi Studio gown , mall goth boots on the beach . Ortega has stayed committed to the fashions of the night and the doorways of Hot Topic. While cuffed jeans in their original iteration leaned more boho, Jenna Ortega proves the style can shift sexy and sophisticated, and be something to consider adding to your own fall denim rotation. By The News Digital November 22, 2025 Jenna Ortega’s new jury role sparks speculation about her next chapter Jenna Ortega has added another milestone to her fast-rising career. The 23-year-old actor has officially been named to the jury of the 22nd Marrakech International Film Festival, marking what is widely considered her first time serving as a judge at a major festival. The appointment reflects Ortega’s growing international influence. Born in California to Mexican and Puerto Rican parents, she has often spoken about how her heritage shapes both her identity and her ambitions in the industry. The Wednesday famed star began acting at 9, persuading her mother to record her monologues and post them online — clips that ultimately helped her secure early representation and auditions in Los Angeles. Her early work included roles in Rob, CSI: NY, Rake, Richie Rich, and a recurring part as young Jane in Jane the Virgin. Her breakthrough came with Disney Channel’s Stuck in the Middle, where she led the series as Harley Diaz. The You alum then shifted into more mature and diverse roles, earning praise for the indie drama The Fallout and becoming a modern horror standout with Scream, Scream VI, and Ti West’s X. Her global profile changed dramatically in 2022 with Netflix’s Wednesday . The show turned her into a cultural phenomenon, boosted by her viral dance sequence and a wave of critical recognition. She went on to earn nominations from the Emmys, Golden Globes, and SAG Awards, becoming the youngest Latina nominated for Best Lead Actress in a comedy at the Emmys. Ortega has continued expanding her filmography with Death of a Unicorn, Finestkind, Miller’s Girl , and Hurry Up Tomorrow, and reunited with Tim Burton for Beetlejuice Beetlejuice . The second season of Wednesday , released this summer, became one of the year’s most talked-about series. (Image credit: Bernard Walsh/Netflix) When it comes to highly aniticipated upcoming Netflix shows , there's no doubt Stranger Things Season 5 will keep everyone's minds flayed until the 2026 TV schedule kicks off. But when that's all done, fans can start fully looking foward to the Season 3 return of another disaster-thwarting horror-friendly teen: Wednesday Addams . For all that audiences have hopes and dreams about what's to come, star Jenna Ortega has her own narrative-based desires to follow up on Season 2's wild ending . I Like Jenna Ortega's Wednesday And All, But I Think I Want The Show's LEGO Sets Even More Than Season 3 One of the most binge-worthy shows on Netflix , Wednesday was renewed for Season 3 back in July, with the caveat that viewers. will likely be waiting ages for it to arrive, given how long it takes to put these episodes together. The glass-half-full perspective there is that co-creators Alfred Gough and Miles Millar presumably have enough time and wherewithal to give Jenna Ortega's suggestion a proper amount of consideration, because I fully agree with her take. Ortega spoke with the good folks at GamesRadar+ and shared her biggest hopes for the new season, saying: You may like That Time A Young Jenna Ortega Outed Herself As A Great Candidate For Wednesday Addams When She Was Still In Her Disney Fame Years That Time Jenna Ortega Absolutely Could Not Get Over Netflix's Marketing For Wednesday: 'Let's Be Honest' Jenna Ortega Discusses The Kind Of Films She Wants To Direct One Day, And I’m Already Grabbing My Popcorn I would like them [Morticia and Wednesday] to stop arguing and team up. We’d just been talking about women banding together, and you see that a bit in the final episode, or episodes. I think we should lean into that. It’s really exciting and refreshing to see women displayed that way. Huzzah! Just over a week before those statements went live, Ortega reunited with her TV parents Catherine Zeta-Jones and Luis Guzmán for a Netflix event, and it further proved how much better life is when the three of these celebs are having fun around each other, which isn't really the case in Wednesday proper, where a distinct imbalance hinders the mother-daughter relationship from blossoming. (Or deblossoming, as it were.) To Ortega's point, the back half of Season 2 put Morticia and Wednesday on more of the same page, thanks in part to the late Weems re-entering the story. (But not re-interring, amirite?) And hopefully they can build on that shared ground as opposed to finding new ways to spread the rift. (Image credit: Netflix) Jenna Ortega also addressed a well-established character point that hasn't come up that much, and I legitimately think Season 2 suffered from it. As she put it: I think it’s important to see Wednesday deal with the darker side of herself a little bit, too – but also never taking things too seriously. And I would like to see more death attempts between her and Pugsley. She doesn’t try to kill him enough! I want to see stuff like that. As much as I thought I would like Wednesday giving Pugsley a bigger storyline in Season 2, the character was far too vulnerable and sensitive to everything involving his zombie pet, as if he was a normal teenage boy and not someone who grew up living in constant danger of his older sister. Other versions of Pugsley would have been just fine getting electrocuted, but not this one. So if that can be blamed on Wednesday not trying to kill him enough, let's right that ship! There are plenty of ways for her to be apathetic to others while still taking pleasure in her own life. But I won't be the person to go up and ask Wednesday to smile more. Never that. I Like Jenna Ortega's Wednesday And All, But I Think I Want The Show's LEGO Sets Even More Than Season 3 One of the most binge-worthy shows on Netflix , Wednesday was renewed for Season 3 back in July, with the caveat that viewers. will likely be waiting ages for it to arrive, given how long it takes to put these episodes together. text: 'Scream 7' fans rally behind ousted actress Melissa Barrera following trailer release US TODAY’S PAPER | November 27, 2025 | EPAPER ☰ Home Latest Pakistan Business World Sports Opinion Life & Style T-Magazine Blogs Tech Videos Cartoon Home Entertainment 'Scream 7' fans rally behind ousted actress Melissa Barrera following trailer release Barrera was dismissed over comments in support of Palestine after which Jenna Ortega also exited the franchise Pop Culture & Art October 31, 2025 1 min read facebook twitter whatsup linkded email Photo: AFP/Spyglass Media While the Scream 7 trailer that released yesterday teased the long-awaited instalment in the iconic franchise, fans appeared to be less enthused about the next movie in the saga due to the absence of Melissa Barrera who was fired from the franchise almost two years prior. Viewers flooded social media about Barrera's dismissal over her comments on the Gaza genocide and the “atrocities being committed against Palestinians,” as well as Jenna Ortega‘s subsequent exit. One fan wrote, “This is missing two very important women…” referring to the two stars. Another said, “Where the scream franchise ended for me,” under an image from Scream VI . Others tried to divert attention toward Barrera's other projects including The Copenhagen Test which stars the actress alongside Simu Liu and premiere's on December 27. Additionally, the Palestinian-led Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions Movement (BDS ) has begun a movement against the sequel, which is joined by 22 arts and advocacy organizations. After Barrera's comments in November 2023, Spyglass Media released a statement about “zero tolerance for antisemitism or the incitement of hate in any form, including false references to genocide, ethnic cleansing, Holocaust distortion or anything that flagrantly crosses the line into hate speech.” Soon after, Ortega left the franchise, noting that the sequel “was all kind of falling apart” without Barrera to play its new ‘final girl’ Sam Carpenter. Apart from Ortega and Barrera, Scream 7 features returning cast members Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox, David Arquette, Scott Foley, Matthew Lillard, Jasmin Savoy Brown and Mason Gooding. Newcomers include Joel McHale, Isabel May, Celeste O’Connor, Asa Germann, Mckenna Grace, Sam Rechner, Michelle Randolph, Jimmy Tatro, Anna Camp, Mark Consuelos and Ethan Embry. Directed by Kevin Williamson, Scream 7 is set to hit theaters on February 27, 2026. facebook twitter whatsup linkded email COMMENTS Replying to X Saved ! The 62-year-old took to Instagram to share her support for the Dodgers in a branded blue T-shirt, and added stacked necklaces and aviator sunglasses to complete the casual look. She tagged Dodgers player Freddie Freeman in the photo, as well as his team, who won the game against their Canadian rivals on October 28. Helen's fans rushed to the comment section to praise her laid-back look, with one writing, "Oh still so beautiful," while another added, "So raw, so real. Unusual for Hollywood." Another chimed in, "You have aged beautifully," while a fourth said, "Still drop dead gorgeous you are Helen!" The blonde beauty has been open in the past about her decision to age naturally and avoid cosmetic surgery altogether. "It felt impossible not to internalize the way you're supposed to look. And [there was] a certain amount of misery and shame around not looking exactly that way," she told Flow Space of the early days of her career. "I realized, 'This could quietly ruin your whole life.' I made a decision: I'm not playing. Not gonna [let it] take up a lot of space in my mind." The actress later shared with HuffPost Live that she had decided to not let people's opinions about her body get to her. "I had my run in the '80s about being really worried about how I looked. Everybody was more fit, or more thin, and I maxed out on worrying about it," she told the publication. "I just gave up on worrying about it. When I gave it up, my brain and body got better." You may also like Helen Hunt sports refreshing new look in unfiltered photo far from Hollywood red carpets "I was taking these exercise classes called 'abs, thighs, and buns' and I was like, 'I'm going to be dead one day – do I really want to give up an hour in this class?" Helen was a major star in the '80s and '90s, having appeared in everything from Girls Just Want To Have Fun with Sarah Jessica Parker to Twister with Jodie Foster and St. Elsewhere with Denzel Washington. © Instagram Helen shared a casual selfie with fans She also nabbed an Oscar win for her role in As Good As It Gets with Jack Nicholson. Helen is perhaps best known for starring on the smash-hit sitcom Mad About You for seven years alongside Paul Reiser. The duo played a couple living in New York City navigating their lives together. © Getty Images The actress has been open about aging in Hollywood Helen won four Emmy Awards for the show and appeared in the 12-episode 2019 revival, despite her hesitations about the reboot. "We were 100% sure we would never do a reboot. It seemed like a really cheesy thing to do, and we'd answered everything, and we looked down on them," she said during a fan expo. © NBCUniversal via Getty Images She won four Emmys for her work on Mad About You "And then I saw Will & Grace , and I was like, it's really good and it's really funny. Are we maybe stupid and should think about it?" She then signed on for the revival, which saw her character grappling with being an empty nester as the couple's daughter, Mabel, moved out. The upcoming debut marks the movie’s latest resurgence following its long-standing popularity and continued demand from audiences. Tom Hanks-led Cast Away to stream on Netflix in December An overview of Netflix’s December 2025 lineup confirms that Cast Away (2000), directed by Robert Zemeckis and starring Tom Hanks and Helen Hunt, will arrive on the platform on December 7. The survival drama follows a FedEx executive stranded on a remote island after a plane crash. The preview notes that December will include licensed films, holiday features, dramas, and major Netflix Original releases throughout the month. Cast Away premiered on December 22, 2000, and stars Hanks as Chuck Noland, a FedEx systems analyst whose plane crashes in the South Pacific. The film depicts his efforts to endure isolation and return home. It was produced by ImageMovers and Playtone with a reported budget of $90 million and grossed $429.6 million worldwide. Filming took place from January to March 1999. Production resumed from April to May 2000, using locations in Fiji, Texas, and FedEx facilities. Netflix’s December schedule includes films such as Big Mama’s House, Money Monster, Rio, Rio 2, and Brightburn. New seasons of CoComelon Lane, Grantchester, and Victoria also arrive on the platform. Major originals include The Abandons on December 4, Mean Girls (2024) on December 5, and Wake Up Dead Man: A Knives Out Mystery on December 12. Other highlights include Emily in Paris Season 5 on December 18 and Stranger Things Season 5 Volume 2 on December 25. The film earned several major accolades. Tom Hanks won Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama at the 58th Golden Globe Awards. He also received an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor. Review data lists an 88% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 73. Home media releases began in 2001, and the film later streamed on Hulu in North America. (KKTV) - In Colorado Springs, service to the country is in its DNA. Tuesday is Veterans Day, and with such a large community of past and present service members, the city is closing a number of its facilities to observe the day. (Note: These are city-run facilities; for private businesses and other entities, you’ll need to contact them directly or check their website.) The following are CLOSED Tuesday: Administrative office for Mountain Metropolitan Transit, including customer service City Administration Building City Clerk City Hall Colorado Springs Pioneers Museum Deerfield Community Center Helen Hunt Falls Visitor Center Hillside Community Center Municipal Court Parks, Recreation & Cultural Services Administration Building Rock Ledge Ranch Historic Site Sales Tax Office Sports and Therapeutic Recreation Programs Office in Memorial Park Starsmore Visitor and Nature Center The following are OPEN: Fairview and Evergreen cemeteries – gates open (offices closed) Patty Jewett Golf Course Pikes Peak Highway – free admission to active and retired military with ID on Monday, Nov. 11. Sertich Ice Center Valley Hi Golf Course There are also a number of events happening in and around Colorado Springs Tuesday: - The Classical Academy is holding a “Honoring America’s Heroes” assembly from 9:30 a.m.-10:45 a.m., open to the public. - Doherty High School is holding an assembly from 10:35-11:30 a.m. featuring “patriotic performances, student tributes, and special recognition of staff members,” also open to the public. (WMC) - Academy Award, Emmy and Golden Globe-winning actress Helen Hunt spoke to a crowd of 640 Methodist Healthcare supporters at the Peabody Hotel on Friday in Memphis. It was a homecoming of sorts for Hunt, who stayed at the Peabody while filming scenes for the Academy Award-winning film, “Cast Away,” in Memphis in early 1999 and the Spring of 2000. “I think a lot of what I shot here was [at] nighttime. So I remember, like, getting an Egg McMuffin on the way back to this hotel to go to bed. Those vampire hours that you keep on movies, but it’s, you know, you have a great city,” Hunt said in an exclusive interview with Action News 5. Action News 5 chats exclusively with Helen Hunt ahead of Methodist Healthcare Luncheon (Action News 5) The multi-hyphenate told Action News 5’s Joy Redmond that her passion for women’s health is what drove her to accept Methodist Healthcare’s invitation to speak at the foundation’s annual Cancer Center Luncheon. “I just don’t know anybody who hasn’t, I mean, anybody over a certain age who doesn’t feel the vulnerability around breast cancer, around all kinds of cancer,” Hunt said. “And then you get into the healthcare system and you suddenly realize you need more help than you have. And so this group is providing in a beautiful way.” Actress and special guest speaker Helen Hunt chats with Action News 5's Joy Redmondat the 2025 Methodist Healthcare Luncheon (Action News 5) Though Hunt’s body of award-winning work spans decades (she started in showbiz at age nine), her demeanor is more humble than “Hollywood.” “I think I was lucky because I was never on a big, successful show as a kid, so I wasn’t pegged as that girl from that show. I just got to work and learn and work and learn. And then as I got older, I got some wonderful breaks,” she said. Sign in to your ScreenRant account Summary Generate a summary of this story follow Follow followed Followed Like Like Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap After 30 years, the Screen Actors Guild Awards is being renamed. The award show debuted on NBC in 1995, with George Burns receiving the Lifetime Achievement Award, and actors like Tom Hanks, Jodie Foster, Dianne Wiest and Helen Hunt walking away as winners. The SAG Awards is presented by the Screen Actors Guild, which merged with the American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (AFTRA) in 2012. SAG-AFTRA elected Sean Astin as president in September. Thirteen years after the merging of SAG and AFTRA, the labor union has decided to downplay SAG in the name of its awards show by renaming the telecast The Actor Awards presented by SAG-AFTRA (or The Actor Awards, for short), according to Deadline . The reason for this change is so that the name not only reflects the current standing of the organization, but it also aligns with the statuette itself, which is called The Actor. In a statement, The Actor Awards showrunner Jon Brockett said that this major change is merely a reflection of the show's " evolution " while keeping the focus " entirely about actors ." Since the beginning, our statue has been called ‘The Actor’ and we’re a show that’s entirely about actors, so this new name is a perfect next step in the show’s evolution. The Actor Awards presented by SAG-AFTRA gives viewers in 190-plus countries an immediate understanding of who we are and what we’re about. Actress JoBeth Williams, who served as the SAG Foundation president and chair of the SAG Awards Committee, added that the organization wanted to make it " crystal clear to audiences " that The Actor Awards is an " actor-focused " show, not just due to the winners themselves but also the fact that the voting members are also actors. As an actor and a longtime SAG-AFTRA member and chair of the Awards Committee, I’ve always loved that our show is actor focused—actors voting for actors—because we understand innately the work that goes into a performance. The Actor Awards makes that crystal clear to audiences everywhere: when they tune in, they know they’re going to see their favorite actors celebrated by those who truly know the craft. Williams, as part of the Awards Committee, has been working with SAG-AFTRA from start to finish. They approved the new name and then ensured a smooth rollout. Speaking of which, this announcement is coming about a month before nomination voting begins on December 15. Due to this short time frame, SAG-AFTRA has decided that studio campaigns can still use the SAG Awards name when promoting its shows and stars--but only for the current awards season. Beginning with next year's voting period, studios need to start using the new moniker. After nomination voting closes on January 4, 2026, Actor Award nominations will be announced the morning of January 7. Members will vote from January 14 to February 27. Then the awards show itself will stream live on Netflix at 8 p.m. EST/5 p.m. PST on March 1, 2026. The popular streamer's partnership with the SAG Awards/Actor Awards started in 2023 when Netflix live-streamed the show on YouTube. The streaming service itself started hosting the telecast in 2024. Before that, the SAG Awards had aired on various networks, including NBC, TNT and TBS. Over the past 30 years, the awards show has only had three hosts, starting with Nobody Wants This cast member Kristen Bell in 2018; she returned in 2025. Will & Grace 's Megan Mullally hosted in 2019, and movie star Idris Elba opened the show in 2024.
