text: Malcolm in the Middle: The Best Episodes Ever, Ranked | Den of Geek Skip to main content area Menu Subscribe Den of Geek Facebook Twitter Instagram Youtube Twitch TikTok Search for: Search Close search Toggle search Movies TV Games Comics Books Collectibles Magazine Shows & Podcasts Video Newsletter Subscribe Facebook Twitter Instagram Youtube Twitch TikTok Features Malcolm in the Middle: The Best Episodes Ever, Ranked With the classic sitcom set to return for a four-part miniseries, Den of Geek selects the best of the show’s original 151 episodes. By Christian Kriticos | November 9, 2025 | Share on Facebook (opens in a new tab) Share on Twitter (opens in a new tab) Share on Linkedin (opens in a new tab) Share on email (opens in a new tab) | Comments count: 0 Photo: Fox Malcolm in the Middle premiered just days into the new millennium and it immediately defined a fresh visual language for TV comedy. Gone were the stage setups of ‘90s shows like Friends and Frasier . In came whip-pans, location shooting and elaborate set pieces. The characters were different too. The dysfunctional family had long been a sitcom staple. But we’d never seen a matriarch as powerful as Lois (Jane Kaczmarek) before, nor a father as eccentric as Hal (Bryan Cranston). And the family’s four boys (later five) brought new standards of misbehavior to network TV. Those unique elements compelled millions of viewers to tune into Malcolm in the Middle each week. And now, 25 years on, the beloved sitcom is finally returning for a four-episode revival on Disney+ . Malcolm in the Middle: Life’s Still Unfair will pick up some 20 years after the original show’s finale. All the main cast are returning, except Erik Per Sullivan, who played Dewey. (Having retired from acting, his role has been recast with doppelganger Caleb Ellsworth-Clark.) Many popular supporting characters are returning too, including Craig, Stevie, Abe, Richie and Piama. And there are sure to be more surprises when the show premieres. Ad Ad – content continues below As anticipation builds for this long-awaited reunion, Den of Geek has revisited all 151 episodes of the original show. And we’ve carefully selected the best of the bunch to help keep you occupied during the final countdown to the revival. 15. Malcolm Holds His Tongue Season 4 Episode 7 Aired on: January 5, 2003 Despite the show’s title, it was goofy dad Hal who was really in the middle. Torn between his parental duties and the chaotic instincts he shared with his sons, Hal often escaped into his own side adventures. Hal’s most inspired exploit was his race-walking obsession, seen in this classic episode. His innocent awe for the absurd sport provided a perfect outlet for actor Bryan Cranston’s physical comedy. The episode even got a mention in his autobiography, with Cranston revealing the grotesque ingredients of the protein shake he downed in the montage sequence: “raw eggs, raw ground meat, soy powder, and juice.” Alongside Hal’s side-plot, the episode also features the archetypal Malcolm story. Defined by his sarcastic tongue, Malcolm discovers his life improves dramatically when he just stops talking. It can’t last though. The episode ends with Malcolm hospitalized by a stress-related ulcer, and the vitriol runs freely again. But now we know it’s for the good of his health. 14. Thanksgiving Season 5 Episode 4 Aired on: November 23, 2003 Ad Ad – content continues below Let’s face it, the boys were screw-ups. But the show embraced a wholesome message that even the most hopeless kids have some talent to offer. For Reese, it was his extraordinary culinary ability. Introduced in season 2’s “Reese Cooks,” that special skill was reinforced here with an episode focused on his preparation of the Thanksgiving meal. Join our mailing list Get the best of Den of Geek delivered right to your inbox! Reese’s talent is counterbalanced by his characteristically devilish conduct – stealing from Hal’s wallet to fund his extravagant menu and demanding slave-like obedience from sous-chef Dewey. Inevitably, the whole thing is ruined anyway, when Malcolm (drunk for the first time) adds an unwelcome ingredient to the meal. It’s a sad ending for Reese. But it’s consistent with the show’s philosophy. “We have only one mandate we always remember when writing this show,” series creator Linwood Boomer said. “Everybody Suffers.” 13. Rollerskates Season 1 Episode 13 Aired on: April 30, 2000 Actor Frankie Muniz recently revealed this episode as his favorite of the series. It’s easy to see why. The contrast between Francis and Reese’s horrified recollection of their childhood skating lessons, versus the reality Malcolm discovers, is comedy gold. (Hal’s tutoring style consists mostly of oscillating his buttocks to disco anthem Funkytown.) The episode is also a textbook demonstration of everything that elevated Malcolm in the Middle above the three-camera, laugh-tracked sitcoms of the 90s. There’s the dramatic lighting when Hal warns Malcolm of the commitment needed to become a skater. There’s the sweeping camera work that accompanies Hal’s routine. And there’s the blockbuster soundtrack – including Queen’s “We Are the Champions” and Walter Murphy’s “A Fifth of Beethoven.” Ad Ad – content continues below The other storylines aren’t quite as memorable. (Lois throws her back out and Francis skips a survival challenge at military school.) But when the A-plot is so strong, who can quibble? 12. Pearl Harbor Season 6 Episode 4 Aired on: December 5, 2004 This episode gets its title from Hal’s storyline, which sees him build an elaborate front lawn tribute to Pearl Harbor Day. That’ll teach the arrogant neighbor who always bests him on the Christmas lights! But the heart of the episode is its second plot, in which Jessica convinces both Malcolm and Reese that the other is gay. It culminates in the show’s greatest dance sequence (and there are several to choose from) as the brothers awkwardly support each other to the rhythms of ABBA’s “Take a Chance on Me.” It’s both hilarious and heartwarming. Jessica was one of the best foils for Malcom, despite only featuring in four episodes. Actress Hayden Panettiere recently reflected on the role in an interview with Entertainment Weekly , sparking speculation that she might be returning for the revival. Nothing’s confirmed. But fans will be keeping their fingers crossed. 11. Charity Season 3 Episode 5 Aired on: December 2, 2001 Ad Ad – content continues below Across 151 episodes, it’s difficult to pinpoint the worst thing the boys ever did. But stealing donations from the church must be close to the top of the list. Dewey is the conscience of the group, as he wonders if God is watching them. Meanwhile, Malcolm suggests there’s an all-seeing, all-powerful being closer to home: Lois. He may have a point. Lois’ powers are on full display, as she coaxes Hal to come home with the boys (caught up in their scheme, he attempts to flee the state). And on their return, she cheerfully welcomes them with a homecooked meal, having donated all their possessions to charity. There are no arguments, of course. You can’t argue with God’s wrath. It’s a milestone episode for Francis too, as he arrives in Alaska. And the themes of his story mirror the A-plot, with the introduction of another all-seeing force – Lavernia, who records the shortcomings of her terrified workforce in a ledger of judgment. 10. Family Reunion Season 4 Episode 3 Aired on: November 17, 2002 During the show’s original run, actress Jane Kaczmarek objected to critics describing the family as dysfunctional. “I think it’s a hugely functional family,” she said. “There’s no passive aggression, just aggression.” This episode is a case in point. While Hal’s extended family show their disdain for Lois with snide remarks and petty exclusion, the boys take a more direct approach in their retaliation – stealing a golf buggy, then driving it over a catered dinner and into a swimming pool. Latest TV reviews Haunted Hotel Review: Netflix Series Continues Paranormal Hospitality Comedy Trend By Rendy Jones Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 3 Episode 10 Review — New Life and New Civilizations By Lacy Baugher Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 3 Episode 9 Review — Terrarium By Lacy Baugher Ad – content continues below That set piece is the highlight of the episode (and arguably the series). Some of the side plots are less successful (Hal wetting the bed after dreaming of a therapy session with Jesus is just bizarre). But everything the show stood for is captured in those last few minutes – the chaos, the violence, and the hearts of gold underneath it all. 9. Lois Strikes Back Season 7 Episode 16 Aired on: March 19, 2006 Following the previous entry, this episode proves that it’s not just the boys who will defend Lois’ honor. She will do anything to protect them too. The episode opens with Reese excitedly telling the family about a girl he’s been talking to on the phone. But when the doorbell rings for date night, Reese finds a pig in lipstick waiting for him, alongside four laughing bullies. Reese’s devastation shows that underneath his aggressive exterior, he harbors a more sensitive soul. And his penchant for violence was clearly inherited from his mother, who embarks on a spree rivaling Kill Bill to avenge her son. The episode is notable for featuring Emma Stone as one of the bullies. She would go on to win two Academy Awards. But we can all agree that the highlight of her career is here, reacting to the decapitation of her character’s doll collection. “Moppet? Baby? NOOO!!!” 8. Health Scare Season 3 Episode 6 Aired on: December 9, 2001 Ad Ad – content continues below Many of the best episodes of Malcolm in the Middle hinge on a single scene. And this instalment may be the best demonstration of that. In the background of the episode, Hal and Lois conduct hushed conversations hinting at a serious medical issue. Meanwhile, Malcolm and Reese devise a way of sneaking out to a midnight party. Those threads come together when Hal, confronted with his mortality, enters the boys’ bedroom to offer some words of wisdom while they sleep. As the balloon Reese has used to simulate his head explodes, Hal and Dewey’s screams harmonize into one of the show’s funniest moments. Although that scene takes the acclaim, the other plots are worthy too. In Alaska, Francis takes on Lavernia in a bare-knuckle bout. And Dewey cares for the class hamster, setting up the show’s most memorable recurring sight gag when he releases the animal to eternally wander in its exercise ball. 7. Traffic Ticket Season 2 Episode 16 Aired on: February 18, 2001 This is one of the show’s most controversial installments, thanks to the betrayal of the ending. For some fans, the treachery goes too far. But it also demonstrates the show’s willingness to embrace moral ambiguity. The episode centers around Lois disputing her arrest for a traffic violation. A crooked cop insists she impeded traffic. Lois is adamant she did not. When video evidence supports the cop’s account, Hal eventually convinces her to accept the verdict. Ad Ad – content continues below However, in the episode’s ingenious twist ending, we learn that Lois was actually right all along. The decision of Hal and the boys to destroy the exonerating evidence is the sticking point for some fans. Yes, it might not be the best ethical decision. But it’s the right narrative choice, allowing Lois to develop into a character who is more comprising and willing to accept her fallibility. 6. Smunday Season 1 Episode 15 Aired on: May 14, 2000 “We may be the fastest-moving show in TV history,” series creator Linwood Boomer once claimed. He was referring to the show’s quick scenes and multiple plot threads. Often, those storylines flitted back and forth, but were ultimately unconnected. However, it was always more satisfying when everything could come together in a climactic ending. “Smunday” is a prime example. When the boys take advantage of a bedridden Lois to skip school, they discover a letter that may condemn Francis to a fate worse than Marlin Academy. To take the heat off their older brother, they devise a scheme to get in more trouble than they’ve ever been in before, launching their parents’ prized possessions to destruction from the roof of the house. Meanwhile, Hal blows off work to indulge his fantasy at a Porsche dealership. But when he comes down with Lois’ flu, the car salesman drives him home in one of their luxury vehicles. As they pull into the driveway, the two storylines collide in spectacular fashion… 5. Graduation Season 7 Episode 22 Aired on: May 14, 2006 Ad Ad – content continues below Some of the best sitcoms limp over the finish line ( Seinfeld ). And some middling shows are redeemed by brilliant endings ( The Good Place ). But Malcolm in the Middle is the best of both worlds – a great series capped off by a great finale. The heart of the episode is Lois’ speech to Malcolm, in which she outlines her ambition for him to become President. It’s a far-fetched idea and could easily have come off as silly. But it draws on seven seasons of Malcolm in the Middle as the most economically conscious sitcom on American TV. So, when Lois tells Malcolm he needs to do it because he’d be “the only person in that position who will ever give a crap about people like us,” it really hits home. Of course, this presents a problem for the upcoming revival – because to discard Lois’ ambition for Malcolm would undermine the original ending. But to actually show Malcolm as President (or close to getting there) would take the show in a strange direction that wouldn’t do justice to the original series either. It will be a delicate balancing act. And some things may be better left unseen… 4. Bowling Season 2 Episode 20 Aired on: April 1, 2001 Bowling is widely considered the best installment of the series. On IMDb, it’s the highest ranked episode , based on user reviews. It also won Emmy Awards for directing and writing, while Frankie Muniz was nominated for his performance. Much of the acclaim centers around the episode’s split narrative, which presents two parallel universes – one where Lois takes Malcolm and Reese out for a bowling night, and another where Hal accompanies them. That may not sound so revolutionary today. But for a sitcom in 2001 it was pretty ambitious. Ad Ad – content continues below All those technical details are irrelevant, of course, if they’re not backed up by story, character and humor. Luckily, “Bowling” has all three in spades. Particular highlights are Malcolm’s failed strike and Hal’s increasingly absurd ritual as he attempts to bowl the perfect game. However, the unsung hero of the episode is Dewey. Left at home, he mentally dominates Hal in one universe and drives Lois to a stalemate in the other. The latter may not be a win. But it’s better than any of his brothers ever managed. 3. If Boys Were Girls Season 4 Episode 10 Aired on: February 9, 2003 The central storyline of Malcolm in the Middle ’s fourth season was Lois’ pregnancy. The writers milked the gender reveal for all it was worth, dragging it out until the season five premiere. The eventual revelation was always going to be an anticlimax. But at least it gave us this episode, where Lois imagines what life would be like with daughters instead of sons. Like “Bowling,” this episode is essentially based around one big gimmick. In other sitcoms these kinds of episodes can be tedious. But Malcolm in the Middle handed them incredibly well, by marrying high concepts with simple stories. In this case, it’s a family trip to the mall, where familiar scenes at the food court and bargain outlet are used to contrast Lois’ idealized vision of the female experience with the reality of her male-filled life. Eventually the illusion shatters – most memorably through a cameo from Francis (sorry, Frances) and her trailer park husband. Then reality is shown to be not so bad when the boys surprise Lois with a Valentine’s gift. It may only be a half-eaten box of chocolates. But for a pack of adolescent boys, it’s a gesture that speaks volumes. 2. Billboard Season 6 Episode 10 Aired on: February 13, 2005 Ad Ad – content continues below Political themes were part of the DNA of Malcolm in the Middle . The show tackled everything from worker’s rights to censorship to sexism in the workplace. But “Billboard” was the show’s greatest triumph in combining comedy with social commentary. When a strip club billboard appears on the outskirts of town, the boys inevitably decide to deface it. Midway through their vandalism, Lois catches them. So, Malcolm cleverly pivots to claim they are protesting the sexist image – and they won’t come down until all women get respect! As the phony demonstration attracts a crowd of supporters, the episode lampoons the overzealousness of the media and protest groups. Soon the boys are being heralded as successors to Rosa Parks and Gandhi. But the episode isn’t wholly cynical. What tips it over into greatness is Reese’s arc. He starts by mocking his feminist supporters, before gradually coming to understand their perspective. As the boys are finally brought down from the billboard, Reese delivers an impassioned speech on women’s rights. It’s characteristically inarticulate. But it has heart. And it’s powerful enough to inspire a rare moment of mercy from Lois, who can see that the most brutish of her boys has truly learned a valuable lesson. 1. Lois’ Birthday Season 2 Episode 3 Aired on: November 12, 2000 As much as political subtext was core to the show, its central theme was always family. That’s a familiar subject for many sitcoms, of course. But Malcolm in the Middle was different. When it wanted to explore familial love, it never descended into hokey sentimentality. It stayed true to the roots of its storytelling, which invariably revolved around chaos and violence. Thus, the greatest present Lois ever got from her boys was not a finger painting or a framed family photograph. It was a spontaneous street brawl, fought in her honor against a group of birthday clowns. That gesture comes after Hal forgets his wife’s birthday and the younger boys spend her gift money on candy bars. Francis makes the effort to come home, but skips Lois’ special day in favor of another party. Eventually, the hapless boys/men make amends by pulling together a half-hearted celebration at the local batting cages. It’s there that the clown fight erupts, making for a totally unexpected and completely brilliant ending to the episode. Ad Ad – content continues below That final scene is wonderfully choreographed, with each of the boys getting their moment. (Even Dewey comes into the action as an ankle-biter.) But it’s those last shots of Lois which are the most beautiful. As she watches the brutal spectacle unfold to the strains of Kenny Rogers (another example of the show’s great musical choices) her bewildered expression gradually changes to a wry smile. We know what she’s thinking: “They may be violent, degenerate animals. But they’re my boys.” Then, in the final seconds, as her eyes catch the camera, breaking the fourth wall, we get to share that thought with Lois for just a moment. “They’re our boys too,” we think. “And we love them.” Ad Share: Share on Facebook (opens in a new tab) Share on Twitter (opens in a new tab) Share on Linkedin (opens in a new tab) Share on email (opens in a new tab) | Comment: Comments count: 0 Tags: Comedy Fox Written by Christian Kriticos Read more from Christian Kriticos Ad Keep Reading... Videos 2025 Movie Releases Screenings What to Watch Originals Reviews Close Collider's Winter Preview Unveils Exclusive Casting News, Images, and Sneak Peeks From 99 Must-Watch Movies and Series Image via Jefferson Chacon By Jake Hodges & Isabella Soares Published Nov 16, 2025 Sign in to your Collider account Summary Generate a summary of this story follow Follow followed Followed Like Like Thread 4 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap After a sizzling selection of the summer's best exclusives , Collider returned with a bigger and better preview week this fall . Now, following the huge success of both events, we are back with the biggest preview event yet this winter. From a brand-new look at the likes of Wicked: For Good , The SpongeBob Movie: Search For SquarePants , and Five Nights at Freddy’s 2 , to exclusive clips from some of the most exciting new movies and shows across the world, this winter preview week has been Collider's biggest yet. With exclusives from nearly 99 titles in just six days, there has been plenty to keep up with. To make sure you haven't missed a beat, here's a full round-up of this most impressive preview event yet in this recap of every exclusive we debuted this week. 'In Your Dreams' Now streaming on Netflix For those looking for a viewing option that caters to the whole family, In Your Dreams is a go-to. The Netflix animation, directed by Alex Woo and Erik Benson, follows Stevie ( Jolie Hoang‑Rappaport ) and her brother Elliot ( Elias Janssen ), as they grapple with their parents' recent divorce. In the hopes of saving their parent's marriage, the siblings resort to the world of dreams to find The Sandman, a mysterious figure who has the power to grant wishes. Our sneak peek of the film shows Stevie and Elliot on an adventurous ride, as they fly through the clouds while hanging on to the bed frame as if their lives depended on it. Get all the details about In Your Dreams in our exclusive preview . 'Tinsel Town' Release Date: November 28, 2025 kiefer-sutherland-in-tinsel-town Image via Brainstorm Media Christmas is right around the corner, and with it comes an array of holiday titles, including this one. In Tinsel Town , Kiefer Sutherland plays Bradley Mack, a washed-up action star who heads to an English village after securing a role in an idiosyncratic Christmas pageant. While there, he not only bonds with a strong-willed choreographer ( Rebel Wilson ), but sees an opportunity to repair his relationship with his daughter. Our exclusive look at the holiday film shows Bradley on stage holding a massive snowman in one hand and a mic in the other, likely entertaining audiences with his performance. Get all the details about Tinsel Town in our exclusive preview . 'Playdate' Now streaming on Prime Video Kevin James and Alan Ritchson plan a playdate in Prime Video's latest offering. The action comedy follows Brian (James) and Jeff (Ritchson), two parents who decide to spend an easy-going afternoon with their sons, tossing footballs and engaging in small talk. Yet, they are instead thrust into a chaotic scramble to stay alive, as ruthless mercenaries hunt them down. While Brian has no physical strength for battle, Jeff is oddly prepared to face the criminals head on. In the clip above, the main characters are being chased by Brian's ex-girlfriend, Leslie ( Isla Fisher ), and her friends. From the likes of it, Leslie is thirsty for revenge, and won't back down until she gets what she wants. Get all the details about Playdate in our exclusive preview. 'Now You See Me: Now You Don't' Release Date: In Theaters Now Right now, global theaters have been sprinkled with magic as the hotly anticipated Now You See Me: Now You Don’t begins its box office run. Earlier this week, as part of Collider's Winter Preview Event, we debuted four exclusive images from the threequel, available to view above. Jesse Eisenberg , Woody Harrelson , Dave Franco , and Isla Fisher all reprise their roles as the original Horsemen, joined by a new batch of budding magicians, played by Justice Smith , Dominic Sessa, and Ariana Greenblatt . Directed by Ruben Fleischer , the movie promises plenty of twists and turns as the Horsemen face their most ambitious adventure yet. Get all the details about Now You See Me: Now You Don't in our exclusive look . 'A Merry Little Ex-Mas' Release Date: On Netflix Now Alicia Silverstone in Merry Little Ex-Mas Christmas came early in Collider's Winter Preview Event, with a brand-new image of Netflix's latest holiday-themed rom-com, A Merry Little Ex-Mas . Starring Alicia Silverstone , fresh off her role in Yorgos Lanthimos 's latest movie, Bugonia , and Oliver Hudson as exes getting together for one final family celebration before they split up forever, the movie promises to usher in the festive season on the world's biggest streamer. Directed by Steve Carr and penned by Holly Hester , the film is the latest in a long line of similar Netflix Christmas movies, with the platform continuing its bid to be known as the go-to festive streamer. Get all the details about A Merry Little Ex-Mas in our exclusive look . 'Bat-Fam' Now Streaming on Prime Video Image via Prime Video A new Batman animated series has arrived on streaming, and it functions as a spin-off to the 2023 hit holiday film, Merry Little Batman . Bat-Fam is centered on Bruce Wayne ( Luke Wilson ), Damian Wayne ( Yonas Kibreab ), and Alfred Pennyworth ( James Cromwell ), as they welcome three new residents to Wayne Manor. The series will explore how this family of misfits (pictured in the image above) navigate the fun and chaos of Gotham City, as they work together to protect civilians from luring threats. Balancing both comedy and action, this animation, developed by Mike Roth & Jase Ricci , will surely fill the DC superhero void since the releases of Superman and Peacemaker Season 2. Get all the details about Bat-Fam in our exclusive preview. 'Champagne Problems' Release Date: November 19, 2025 minka-kelly-champagne-problems-netflix Directed and written by Mark Steven Johnson , Champagne Problems is set to be your next rom-com obsession as it makes its debut on November 19. Starring Ransom Canyon favorite Minka Kelly as a huge moment in her professional career is interrupted by the arrival of Slow Horses alum Tom Wozniczka , with an unlikely romance blossoming. As part of Collider's Winter Preview Event, we debuted an exclusive image of the pair getting cozy and surrounded by the magic of Christmas as love begins to simmer. Alongside Kelly and Wozniczka, the movie also stars All Quiet on the Western Front 's Thibault de Montalemert , Sean Amsing, Flula Borg, Astrid Whettnall, Xavier Samuel, Mitchell Mullen , and Maeve Courtier-Lilley . Get all the details about Champagne Problems in our exclusive look . 'Jingle Bell Heist' Release Date: November 26, 2025 jingle-bell-heist-netflix If you're a fan of Christmas movies but want something with a bit of an edge, Netflix has you covered as Jingle Bell Heist debuts later this month on November 26. Blending the heart of holiday-themed rom-coms with heist movie thrills , Jingle Bell Heist follows Olivia Holt and Connor Swindells as two people down on their luck who seek to take their small-time thieving to new heights as they plan to steal from London's most notorious department store. As part of Collider's winter Preview Event, we debuted an image of Holt and Swindells dressed in the finery of expert con artists. The movie is directed by Michael Fimognari , best known for helming the two sequels to the hit teen flick To All the Boys I've Loved Before . Get all the details about Jingle Bell Heist in our exclusive look . ‘My Secret Santa’ Release Date: December 3, 2025 my-secret-santa-netflix The Christmas exclusives just kept on coming in Collider’s Winter Preview Event, as we teamed up with Netflix to bring a brand-new look at another of their stacked upcoming festive line-up. In the exclusive image of the upcoming My Secret Santa , scheduled to debut on December 3, fans are treated to Cross star Ryan Eggold as Matthew and Sister, Sister ’s Tia Mowry as Natascha in conversation outside a luxury ski resort. Directed by Mike Rohl of The Princess Switch fame and penned by the duo of Carley Smale and Ron Oliver , My Secret Santa also stars Alexandra Breckenridge , Madison MacIsaac, and Diana Maria Riva. Get all the details about My Secret Santa in our exclusive look . 'Murder at the Embassy' Release Date: In Theaters Now Whilst you wait for the next Knives Out movie (more on that later), there's an enticing crime waiting to be solved in theaters and on digital platforms. That mystery is the heart of Murder at the Embassy , a film that follows the Agatha Christie -loving Miranda Green, played by The O.C. star Mischa Barton , as she is called to investigate a murder at the British Embassy. However, she soon starts unraveling a second crime that could have catastrophic global consequences. As part of Collider's Exclusive Winter Preview Event, we debuted the image above, showcasing Barton's crime-solver surrounded by ancient Egyptian relics. A sequel to 2023's Invitation to a Murder , the movie is directed by Stephen Shimek and penned by Mark Brennan. Get all the details about Murder at the Embassy in our exclusive look . 'Last Samurai Standing' Now streaming on Netflix last-samarai-standing-netflix Netflix's latest series, Last Samurai Standing , is set during the end of an era, as fallen samurais are warped into a violent game called Kodoku. What draws them into this competition is the opportunity to win a cash prize that could be their key to overcoming poverty and surviving a cholera outbreak. However, the catch is that only one samurai will make it out alive, and based on the exclusive picture above, we have our theories on who that might be. With a premise reminiscent to that of Squid Game , Last Samurai Standing is an action-packed, Japanese production that will leave you on edge. Get all the details about Last Samurai Standing in our exclusive preview . 'Thing With Feathers' Release Date: November 28, 2025 the-thing-with-feathers-benedict-cumberbatch Grief can come in various shapes and forms, and Thing With Feathers displays that full well. Based on Max Porter ’s novella, the film follows Dad ( Benedict Cumberbatch ) as he strives to keep it together for his young boys after his wife's death. One of the ways he copes with grief, is by getting even more focused on his work as a graphic novelist. In turn, one of his creations, a gigantic crow (voiced by David Thewlis ), leaves the page and becomes an ever-present figure in Dad's daily life. This unhinged and unwanted house guest turns out to be exactly what the protagonist needs to move forward. In addition to sharing an exclusive look at Cumberbatch's character alongside his two sons, we are sharing a new trailer. Get all the details about Thing With Feathers in our exclusive preview . ‘The King of Color’ Release Date: December 2025 It isn’t just fiction films and shows that get their place in Collider’s Winter Preview Event, as documentary fans are also treated to exclusives from the best and newest from the world of non-fiction. As part of our week of exclusives, we have debuted the above image from the upcoming documentary The King of Color , scheduled for release in December 2025. Directed by Patrick Creadon , this inspiring documentary looks at the life of Larry Herbert , the inventor of the Pantone Matching System, and uncovers the way in which he changed the universal language of color forever. The synopsis for the doc reads: “At 96 years old, Larry Herbert, known as THE KING OF COLOR, is a visionary whose revolutionary idea to standardize color remains largely unrecognized. Growing up in Depression-era Brooklyn, Larry entered the print and manufacturing trade during a time when color was a chaotic and subjective experience. He channeled his unique vision into creating the Pantone Matching System—a groundbreaking invention that established a universal language for color, profoundly enhancing artistic expression and commercial production across all industries.” Get all the details about The King of Color in our exclusive look . 'The Things You Kill' Now in theaters This Turkish thriller explores the aftermath of revenge, when guilt and darkness take over. The Things You Kill follows Ali ( Ekin Koç ), a progressive university professor who is torn between academic work in Ankara and staying in a small town caring for his mother who is ill. As he wrestles between both options, his mother suspiciously dies, unlocking in Ali an inner rage he has been harboring against his father. This drives him toward revenge, recruiting his gardener to do the dirty work for him. The sneak peek above shows the moment in which Ali regrets what he did, and must live with the consequences. Get all the details about The Things You Kill in our exclusive look . 'Bunny' Now in select theaters and VOD Ben Jacobson might've been featured in High Fidelity and Blink Twice , but he is now ready to make his debut behind the camera. His film, Bunny , follows a hustler ( Mo Stark ) on a quick job until everything goes sideways. Unsure what to do, he requests the help of his best friend, Dino (Jacobson), and together they come up with an elaborate scheme to get rid of a dead body. With the police on the watch-out, Bunny's ultimate goal is to make it through the night without getting caught, or worse, killed. As chaos reigns and the clock ticks, the duo must rely on each other to carry on with their plan. Get all the details about Bunny in our exclusive preview. 'Riot Women' Release Date: January 14, 2026 It's not always that we get to see elderly women rocking the stage, but Riot Women proves that there are menopausal women who are still edgy. The series by Sally Wainwright , follows five women who create a punk-rock band to sign up for a local talent show. Yet, as they begin to work on music of their own, they notice that they have much more to say than they initially thought. With each of them undergoing their own struggles with romantic and familial relationships, the band becomes a catalyst for everything that they are going through. The sneak peek above marks a significant moment in the band's conception, giving U.S. audiences a taste of what they can anticipate from the series. Get all the details about Riot Women in our exclusive preview . 'The Housemaid' Release Date: December 19, 2025 Sydney Sweeney and Amanda Seyfried are two of the best-known actors working today, so a team-up between the two is sure to demand attention. This December 19, you can catch Sweeney and Seyfried in the upcoming thriller, The Housemaid , an adaptation of Freida McFadden​​​​​' s book, directed by Paul Feig , with this story tonally similar to his previous work on A Simple Favor and its sequel, Another Simple Favor . Also starring 1923 's Brandon Sklenar , Michele Morrone, and Elizabeth Perkins , the film follows a woman escaping her past who finds security in a new position as a live-in housemaid, only for a seductive scandal to unleash chaos. Ahead of the movie's arrival, Collider debuted the above image of Sweeney and Seyfried as housemaid Millie and the wealthy Nina, as part of our Winter Preview Event. Get all the details about The Housemaid in our exclusive look . ‘Come See Me in the Good Light’ Release Date: Available Now ComeSeeMeInTheGoodLight_Film_F10636F_APPLETV Apple TV might be home to some of the best fiction on television, but the streamer also plays host to a selection of fantastic and often life-changing documentaries. Released this past Friday, Ryan White ’s Come See Me in the Good Light “is a poignant and unexpectedly funny love story about poets Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley facing an incurable cancer diagnosis with joy, wit and an unshakable partnership.” In the face of tragedy, this heartwarming partnership proves utterly life-affirming in a documentary you won’t want to miss. As part of Collider’s Exclusive Winter Preview Event, we debuted a brand-new image from the doc showcasing this loving partnership looking beyond. Get all the details about Come See Me in the Good Light and read an interview with the director in our exclusive look . ‘The Hunt’ Release Date: December 3, 2025 the-hunt-traques-season-1-episode-2-apple-tv Apple TV have produced some of 2025’s finest content, with their new series Pluribus yet another string to their acclaimed bow. This December, they will widen their impressive collection of enticing international content with The Hunt ( Traqués ) , the upcoming French-language thriller from the César-nominated Cédric Anger ( Next Time I’ll Aim for the Heart ). Videos 2025 Movie Releases Screenings What to Watch Originals Reviews Close Collider's Winter Preview Unveils Exclusive Casting News, Images, and Sneak Peeks From 99 Must-Watch Movies and Series Image via Jefferson Chacon By Jake Hodges & Isabella Soares Published Nov 16, 2025 Sign in to your Collider account Summary Generate a summary of this story follow Follow followed Followed Like Like Thread 4 Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap After a sizzling selection of the summer's best exclusives , Collider returned with a bigger and better preview week this fall. Now, following the huge success of both events, we are back with the biggest preview event yet this winter. From a brand-new look at the likes of Wicked: For Good , The SpongeBob Movie: Search For SquarePants , and Five Nights at Freddy’s 2 , to exclusive clips from some of the most exciting new movies and shows across the world, this winter preview week has been Collider's biggest yet. With exclusives from nearly 99 titles in just six days, there has been plenty to keep up with. To make sure you haven't missed a beat, here's a full round-up of this most impressive preview event yet in this recap of every exclusive we debuted this week. 'In Your Dreams' Now streaming on Netflix For those looking for a viewing option that caters to the whole family, In Your Dreams is a go-to. The Netflix animation, directed by Alex Woo and Erik Benson, follows Stevie ( Jolie Hoang‑Rappaport ) and her brother Elliot ( Elias Janssen ), as they grapple with their parents' recent divorce. In the hopes of saving their parent's marriage, the siblings resort to the world of dreams to find The Sandman, a mysterious figure who has the power to grant wishes. Our sneak peek of the film shows Stevie and Elliot on an adventurous ride, as they fly through the clouds while hanging on to the bed frame as if their lives depended on it. Get all the details about In Your Dreams in our exclusive preview. 'Tinsel Town' Release Date: November 28, 2025 kiefer-sutherland-in-tinsel-town Image via Brainstorm Media Christmas is right around the corner, and with it comes an array of holiday titles, including this one. In Tinsel Town , Kiefer Sutherland plays Bradley Mack, a washed-up action star who heads to an English village after securing a role in an idiosyncratic Christmas pageant. While there, he not only bonds with a strong-willed choreographer ( Rebel Wilson ), but sees an opportunity to repair his relationship with his daughter. Our exclusive look at the holiday film shows Bradley on stage holding a massive snowman in one hand and a mic in the other, likely entertaining audiences with his performance. Get all the details about Tinsel Town in our exclusive preview. 'Playdate' Now streaming on Prime Video Kevin James and Alan Ritchson plan a playdate in Prime Video's latest offering. The action comedy follows Brian (James) and Jeff (Ritchson), two parents who decide to spend an easy-going afternoon with their sons, tossing footballs and engaging in small talk. Yet, they are instead thrust into a chaotic scramble to stay alive, as ruthless mercenaries hunt them down. While Brian has no physical strength for battle, Jeff is oddly prepared to face the criminals head on. In the clip above, the main characters are being chased by Brian's ex-girlfriend, Leslie ( Isla Fisher ), and her friends. From the likes of it, Leslie is thirsty for revenge, and won't back down until she gets what she wants. Get all the details about Playdate in our exclusive preview. 'Now You See Me: Now You Don't' Release Date: In Theaters Now Right now, global theaters have been sprinkled with magic as the hotly anticipated Now You See Me: Now You Don’t begins its box office run. Earlier this week, as part of Collider's Winter Preview Event, we debuted four exclusive images from the threequel, available to view above. Jesse Eisenberg , Woody Harrelson , Dave Franco , and Isla Fisher all reprise their roles as the original Horsemen, joined by a new batch of budding magicians, played by Justice Smith , Dominic Sessa, and Ariana Greenblatt. Directed by Ruben Fleischer , the movie promises plenty of twists and turns as the Horsemen face their most ambitious adventure yet. Get all the details about Now You See Me: Now You Don't in our exclusive look. 'A Merry Little Ex-Mas' Release Date: On Netflix Now Alicia Silverstone in Merry Little Ex-Mas Christmas came early in Collider's Winter Preview Event, with a brand-new image of Netflix's latest holiday-themed rom-com, A Merry Little Ex-Mas. Starring Alicia Silverstone , fresh off her role in Yorgos Lanthimos 's latest movie, Bugonia , and Oliver Hudson as exes getting together for one final family celebration before they split up forever, the movie promises to usher in the festive season on the world's biggest streamer. Directed by Steve Carr and penned by Holly Hester , the film is the latest in a long line of similar Netflix Christmas movies, with the platform continuing its bid to be known as the go-to festive streamer. Get all the details about A Merry Little Ex-Mas in our exclusive look. 'Bat-Fam' Now Streaming on Prime Video Image via Prime Video A new Batman animated series has arrived on streaming, and it functions as a spin-off to the 2023 hit holiday film, Merry Little Batman. Bat-Fam is centered on Bruce Wayne ( Luke Wilson ), Damian Wayne ( Yonas Kibreab ), and Alfred Pennyworth ( James Cromwell ), as they welcome three new residents to Wayne Manor. The series will explore how this family of misfits (pictured in the image above) navigate the fun and chaos of Gotham City, as they work together to protect civilians from luring threats. Balancing both comedy and action, this animation, developed by Mike Roth & Jase Ricci , will surely fill the DC superhero void since the releases of Superman and Peacemaker Season 2. Get all the details about Bat-Fam in our exclusive preview. 'Champagne Problems' Release Date: November 19, 2025 minka-kelly-champagne-problems-netflix Directed and written by Mark Steven Johnson , Champagne Problems is set to be your next rom-com obsession as it makes its debut on November 19. Starring Ransom Canyon favorite Minka Kelly as a huge moment in her professional career is interrupted by the arrival of Slow Horses alum Tom Wozniczka , with an unlikely romance blossoming. As part of Collider's Winter Preview Event, we debuted an exclusive image of the pair getting cozy and surrounded by the magic of Christmas as love begins to simmer. Alongside Kelly and Wozniczka, the movie also stars All Quiet on the Western Front 's Thibault de Montalemert , Sean Amsing, Flula Borg, Astrid Whettnall, Xavier Samuel, Mitchell Mullen , and Maeve Courtier-Lilley. Get all the details about Champagne Problems in our exclusive look. 'Jingle Bell Heist' Release Date: November 26, 2025 jingle-bell-heist-netflix If you're a fan of Christmas movies but want something with a bit of an edge, Netflix has you covered as Jingle Bell Heist debuts later this month on November 26. Blending the heart of holiday-themed rom-coms with heist movie thrills , Jingle Bell Heist follows Olivia Holt and Connor Swindells as two people down on their luck who seek to take their small-time thieving to new heights as they plan to steal from London's most notorious department store. As part of Collider's winter Preview Event, we debuted an image of Holt and Swindells dressed in the finery of expert con artists. The movie is directed by Michael Fimognari , best known for helming the two sequels to the hit teen flick To All the Boys I've Loved Before. Get all the details about Jingle Bell Heist in our exclusive look. ‘My Secret Santa’ Release Date: December 3, 2025 my-secret-santa-netflix The Christmas exclusives just kept on coming in Collider’s Winter Preview Event, as we teamed up with Netflix to bring a brand-new look at another of their stacked upcoming festive line-up. In the exclusive image of the upcoming My Secret Santa , scheduled to debut on December 3, fans are treated to Cross star Ryan Eggold as Matthew and Sister, Sister ’s Tia Mowry as Natascha in conversation outside a luxury ski resort. Directed by Mike Rohl of The Princess Switch fame and penned by the duo of Carley Smale and Ron Oliver , My Secret Santa also stars Alexandra Breckenridge , Madison MacIsaac, and Diana Maria Riva. Get all the details about My Secret Santa in our exclusive look. 'Murder at the Embassy' Release Date: In Theaters Now Whilst you wait for the next Knives Out movie (more on that later), there's an enticing crime waiting to be solved in theaters and on digital platforms. That mystery is the heart of Murder at the Embassy , a film that follows the Agatha Christie -loving Miranda Green, played by The O. star Mischa Barton , as she is called to investigate a murder at the British Embassy. However, she soon starts unraveling a second crime that could have catastrophic global consequences. As part of Collider's Exclusive Winter Preview Event, we debuted the image above, showcasing Barton's crime-solver surrounded by ancient Egyptian relics. A sequel to 2023's Invitation to a Murder , the movie is directed by Stephen Shimek and penned by Mark Brennan. Get all the details about Murder at the Embassy in our exclusive look. 'Last Samurai Standing' Now streaming on Netflix last-samarai-standing-netflix Netflix's latest series, Last Samurai Standing , is set during the end of an era, as fallen samurais are warped into a violent game called Kodoku. What draws them into this competition is the opportunity to win a cash prize that could be their key to overcoming poverty and surviving a cholera outbreak. However, the catch is that only one samurai will make it out alive, and based on the exclusive picture above, we have our theories on who that might be. With a premise reminiscent to that of Squid Game , Last Samurai Standing is an action-packed, Japanese production that will leave you on edge. Get all the details about Last Samurai Standing in our exclusive preview. 'Thing With Feathers' Release Date: November 28, 2025 the-thing-with-feathers-benedict-cumberbatch Grief can come in various shapes and forms, and Thing With Feathers displays that full well. Based on Max Porter ’s novella, the film follows Dad ( Benedict Cumberbatch ) as he strives to keep it together for his young boys after his wife's death. One of the ways he copes with grief, is by getting even more focused on his work as a graphic novelist. In turn, one of his creations, a gigantic crow (voiced by David Thewlis ), leaves the page and becomes an ever-present figure in Dad's daily life. This unhinged and unwanted house guest turns out to be exactly what the protagonist needs to move forward. In addition to sharing an exclusive look at Cumberbatch's character alongside his two sons, we are sharing a new trailer. Get all the details about Thing With Feathers in our exclusive preview. ‘The King of Color’ Release Date: December 2025 It isn’t just fiction films and shows that get their place in Collider’s Winter Preview Event, as documentary fans are also treated to exclusives from the best and newest from the world of non-fiction. As part of our week of exclusives, we have debuted the above image from the upcoming documentary The King of Color , scheduled for release in December 2025. Directed by Patrick Creadon , this inspiring documentary looks at the life of Larry Herbert , the inventor of the Pantone Matching System, and uncovers the way in which he changed the universal language of color forever. The synopsis for the doc reads: “At 96 years old, Larry Herbert, known as THE KING OF COLOR, is a visionary whose revolutionary idea to standardize color remains largely unrecognized. Growing up in Depression-era Brooklyn, Larry entered the print and manufacturing trade during a time when color was a chaotic and subjective experience. He channeled his unique vision into creating the Pantone Matching System—a groundbreaking invention that established a universal language for color, profoundly enhancing artistic expression and commercial production across all industries. ” Get all the details about The King of Color in our exclusive look. 'The Things You Kill' Now in theaters This Turkish thriller explores the aftermath of revenge, when guilt and darkness take over. The Things You Kill follows Ali ( Ekin Koç ), a progressive university professor who is torn between academic work in Ankara and staying in a small town caring for his mother who is ill. As he wrestles between both options, his mother suspiciously dies, unlocking in Ali an inner rage he has been harboring against his father. This drives him toward revenge, recruiting his gardener to do the dirty work for him. The sneak peek above shows the moment in which Ali regrets what he did, and must live with the consequences. Get all the details about The Things You Kill in our exclusive look. 'Bunny' Now in select theaters and VOD Ben Jacobson might've been featured in High Fidelity and Blink Twice , but he is now ready to make his debut behind the camera. His film, Bunny , follows a hustler ( Mo Stark ) on a quick job until everything goes sideways. Unsure what to do, he requests the help of his best friend, Dino (Jacobson), and together they come up with an elaborate scheme to get rid of a dead body. With the police on the watch-out, Bunny's ultimate goal is to make it through the night without getting caught, or worse, killed. As chaos reigns and the clock ticks, the duo must rely on each other to carry on with their plan. Get all the details about Bunny in our exclusive preview. 'Riot Women' Release Date: January 14, 2026 It's not always that we get to see elderly women rocking the stage, but Riot Women proves that there are menopausal women who are still edgy. The series by Sally Wainwright , follows five women who create a punk-rock band to sign up for a local talent show. Yet, as they begin to work on music of their own, they notice that they have much more to say than they initially thought. With each of them undergoing their own struggles with romantic and familial relationships, the band becomes a catalyst for everything that they are going through. The sneak peek above marks a significant moment in the band's conception, giving U. audiences a taste of what they can anticipate from the series. Get all the details about Riot Women in our exclusive preview. 'The Housemaid' Release Date: December 19, 2025 Sydney Sweeney and Amanda Seyfried are two of the best-known actors working today, so a team-up between the two is sure to demand attention. This December 19, you can catch Sweeney and Seyfried in the upcoming thriller, The Housemaid , an adaptation of Freida McFadden​​​​​' s book, directed by Paul Feig , with this story tonally similar to his previous work on A Simple Favor and its sequel, Another Simple Favor. Also starring 1923 's Brandon Sklenar , Michele Morrone, and Elizabeth Perkins , the film follows a woman escaping her past who finds security in a new position as a live-in housemaid, only for a seductive scandal to unleash chaos. Ahead of the movie's arrival, Collider debuted the above image of Sweeney and Seyfried as housemaid Millie and the wealthy Nina, as part of our Winter Preview Event. Get all the details about The Housemaid in our exclusive look. ‘Come See Me in the Good Light’ Release Date: Available Now ComeSeeMeInTheGoodLight_Film_F10636F_APPLETV Apple TV might be home to some of the best fiction on television, but the streamer also plays host to a selection of fantastic and often life-changing documentaries. Released this past Friday, Ryan White ’s Come See Me in the Good Light “is a poignant and unexpectedly funny love story about poets Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley facing an incurable cancer diagnosis with joy, wit and an unshakable partnership. ” In the face of tragedy, this heartwarming partnership proves utterly life-affirming in a documentary you won’t want to miss. As part of Collider’s Exclusive Winter Preview Event, we debuted a brand-new image from the doc showcasing this loving partnership looking beyond. Get all the details about Come See Me in the Good Light and read an interview with the director in our exclusive look. ‘The Hunt’ Release Date: December 3, 2025 the-hunt-traques-season-1-episode-2-apple-tv Apple TV have produced some of 2025’s finest content, with their new series Pluribus yet another string to their acclaimed bow. This December, they will widen their impressive collection of enticing international content with The Hunt ( Traqués ) , the upcoming French-language thriller from the César-nominated Cédric Anger ( Next Time I’ll Aim for the Heart ). Ahead of the show’s December 3 premiere, with two episodes dropping at once on the streamer, Collider teamed with Apple TV to bring this exclusive image from the series as part of our Exclusive Winter Preview Event. The image features four of the series’ stars, Manuel Guillot , Frédéric Maranber , Cédric Appietto , and Damien Bonnard. Get all the details about The Hunt in our exclusive look. 'Rental Family' Release Date: November 21, 2025 Three years after winning his first Oscar for Best Actor in Darren Aronofsky 's The Whale , the beloved Brendan Fraser is back with Rental Family , a heartwarming comedy-drama from 37 Seconds and Beef director Hikari. Following Fraser as Phillip Vandarploeug, an American man in Tokyo searching for meaning and finding it in the most unlikely of places, Rental Family originally premiered at this year's Toronto International Film Festival, with Collider's Ross Bonaime calling it "a gentle, pleasant story that will surprise you with its affecting narrative. " Ahead of the movie's release on November 21, we debuted an exclusive clip, available to view above, as part of our Winter Preview Event. Get all the details about Rental Family in our exclusive look. 'GOAT' Release Date: February 13, 2026 goat-animated-movie It wasn't going to be long before the basketball 'G. T' debate was to be turned into an animated animal adventure. Scheduled for release on February 13, 2026, Sony Pictures Animation, the team behind Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse , brings to the big screen the story of a young goat, Will (voiced by Stranger Things alum Caleb McLaughlin ), who dreams of becoming a professional roarball player. However, all the best roarball players come from the bigger and faster animals in the kingdom, with Will having to overcome the odds to achieve his dream. Ahead of the movie's release, Collider has released the above image as part of our Exclusive Winter Preview Event. Get all the details about GOAT in our exclusive look. 'Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die' Release Date: February 13, 2026 What if the only way to combat AI is to enlist ordinary people to come to the rescue? That is what Sam Rockwell 's character does in Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die. In the film, he plays a mysterious man who claims to be from a future devastated by an evil AI. In order to stop it from causing further harm, he recruits late-night diner strangers to help him save the world. The exclusive image above shows Rockwell in a circle alongside the strangers he has allied with. Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die is the latest directorial effort by Gore Verbinski , the same mind behind the nerve-wracking horror film, A Cure for Wellness. Get all the details about Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die in our exclusive preview. ‘No Other Choice’ Release Date: December 25, 2025 One of the hottest movies leaving this year’s Toronto International Film Festival , No Other Choice is the latest project from acclaimed filmmaker Park Chan-wook. The man behind Oldboy and Decision to Leave is bringing thrills and comedic spills to a limited theatrical release this Christmas Day, with No Other Choice , the film selected as the South Korean entry for the Best International Feature Film at the upcoming 98th Academy Awards. Ahead of the movie’s release, Collider can exclusively debut the clip above as part of our Winter Preview Event. In a previous review of the film , Ross Bonaime called it “a contender for best comedy of the year,” and awarded it 9/10. Get all the details about No Other Choice in our exclusive look. 'Song Sung Blue' Release Date: December 25, 2025 hugh-jackman-kate-hudson-song-sung-blue Musical biopic fans are in for a real festive treat this Christmas Day, as Song Sung Blue premieres in theaters. Starring the ever-brilliant duo of Hugh Jackman and Kate Hudson , the film follows a pair of down-on-their-luck musicians who chase their dreams and form Lightning and Thunder , a tribute band to the great Neil Diamond ​​​​. Also starring the likes of Michael Imperioli , Ella Anderson , King Princess , Mustafa Shakir , Hudson Hensley , Fisher Stevens , and more, the film promises a heartwarming sing-along you won't want to miss. Ahead of its Christmas Day release, Collider debuted the joyous image above as part of our Exclusive Winter Preview Event. Get all the details about Song Sung Blue in our exclusive look. 'The Abandons' Release Date: December 4, 2025 lena-headey-abandons-netflix Set in 1854, The Abandons follows two matriarchs from two very distinct families trying to make their way in the untamed Washington Territory. Fiona Nolan's ( Lena Headey ) found family is bound by love and necessity, whereas Constance Van Ness' ( Gillian Anderson ) family is bound by wealth and privilege passed on from one generation to the next. In spite of their differences, their fate is linked by two crimes, an awful secret, a star-crossed love, and a piece of land with silver underneath. The exclusive image above shows Fiona and her family of outcasts riding their horses and seemingly fighting for justice. Get all the details about The Abandons in our exclusive preview. 'Nouvelle Vague' Now streaming on Netflix NOUVELLE_VAGUE_netflix Richard Linklater 's tribute to French cinema is finally available to stream, after garnering praise throughout its festival run. Nouvelle Vague reimagines the making of Jean-Luc Godard 's Breathless , showing how the critic-turned-director (played by Guillaume Marbeck ) became the pioneer of the French New Wave. It follows Godard's partnership with actors Jean-Paul Belmondo ( Aubry Dullin ) and Jean Seberg ( Zoey Deutch ), as together they made a film that at first glance seemed amateurish, but later became a testament to artistic freedom. In the image above, you can see the trio bonding during the creative process. Get all the details about Nouvelle Vague in our exclusive preview. 'Sleepwalker' Release Date: January 9, 2026 Hayden Panettiere will make her scream queen comeback with Sleepwalker , a psychological thriller directed by Brandon Auman. In it, she'll play Sarah, a talented artist who has been tormented by nightmares and visions ever since a car accident led her daughter to die and her abusive husband to be hospitalized. With her vivid dreams impacting her sense of reality, including fooling her into thinking that her husband is out of a coma, Sarah must come to terms with her mind playing tricks on her. In our sneak peek of the film, Panettiere is seen in a protective posture, determined to do whatever it takes to care for herself and her loved ones. Get all the details about Sleepwalker in our exclusive preview. 'Percy Jackson and the Olympians' Season 2 Release Date: December 10, 2025 Percy-Jackson-and-the-Olympians-Season-2 The young demigods are taken to the sea in Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 2. Drawing from the second novel of Rick Riordan 's best-selling book series, the new batch of episodes will introduce new monsters and have even more action-packed sequences, the latter being hinted at through the exclusive image above. This time around, Percy ( Walker Scobell ), Annabeth ( Leah Sava Jeffries ) and Clarisse ( Dior Goodjohn ) will go on a quest to save Camp Half-Blood, after its protective border has been breached. They also head to the Sea of Monsters to rescue their friend Grover ( Aryan Simhadri ) and retrieve the legendary Golden Fleece. Get all the details about Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 2 in our exclusive preview. ‘Dust Bunny’ Release Date: December 12, 2025 dust-bunny-movie After writing and producing plenty of acclaimed projects, from Pushing Daisies to Hannibal , Bryan Fuller is finally making his long-awaited directorial debut with Dust Bunny. A horror/thriller that reunites Fuller with Hannibal’s Mads Mikkelsen , who stars alongside Sigourney Weaver ( Alien ), David Dastmalchian ( The Life of Chuck ), and Sophie Sloan ( Chemistry of Death ), Dust Bunny promises to be one of the most enticing theatrical releases this December, with a tale of a monster under a young girl’s bed that eats her entire family. Ahead of the movie’s release, Collider can bring you the above exclusive image from Dust Bunny as part of our Winter Preview Event. In Collider’s previous review of the movie from TIFF 2025, Ross Bonaime wrote: “With a flair for the surreal and fantastical, it’s easy to see how Fuller’s feature debut could become a cult favorite just like his shows have. ” Get all the details about Dust Bunny in our exclusive look. ‘Rosemead’ Release Date: December 5, 2025 lucy-liu-in-rosemead Whilst preparing for her confirmed role in the upcoming sequel to The Devil Wears Prada , the ever-brilliant Lucy Liu is receiving plenty of critical acclaim for her latest starring role in directorial debutant Eric Lin ’s Rosemead. Following the film’s successful premiere at the 2025 Tribeca Festival, this emotionally affecting story, inspired by true events, is scheduled to hit US theaters this December 5. Ahead of the movie’s arrival, Collider has exclusively debuted the above image from the movie, featuring a worried Liu as Irene, a mother “who takes drastic measures to protect her troubled teenage son ( Lawrence Shou ),” after discovering his obsession with mass shootings. Get all the details about Rosemead in our exclusive look. 'Not Without Hope' Release Date: December 12, 2025 Based on a true story, Not Without Hope follows Nick Schuyler ( Zachary Levi ) and his three friends on a fishing trip off the coast of Florida, and get stranded in the sea after their boat capsizes. With a massive storm approaching, the group must battle hypothermia, dehydration, and rely on their limited resources for survival. The film, much like the real events that inspired it, shows that Nick was the only one who made it out alive. In bringing this project to the screen, Levi was very mindful of honoring both the character he was portraying, but also honoring those who perished at sea. In an interview with Collider, he shared the following about telling this story: "I think being able to be a part of true stories is always very powerful, and particularly ones that show incredible perseverance in the face of insurmountable odds. And, Nick's story is a powerful one, and quite literally, as is based in the name, it is not without hope. He was always just holding onto that last shred of hope in the odds that were against all of those odds. So to be able to tell a story like that is, I think that that's important in this industry. " Get all the details about Not Without Hope in our exclusive look. 'Shetland' Season 10 Release Date: January 1, 2026 ashley-jensen-shetland-season-10-episode-1 It is a major milestone when a TV show is picked up for 10 seasons, and Shetland has been one of the lucky few. The British detective series aired its premiere episode of Season 10 in the U. audiences will soon get to watch it on BritBox in the new year. According to the synopsis, Episode 1 will uncover the truth behind retired social worker Eadie Tulloch's demise, with her body found days after the incident. With another puzzling case to solve, the exclusive image above seems to indicate that DI Ruth Calder ( Ashley Jensen ) is in her element. Get all the details about Shetland in our exclusive preview. 'The Beast in Me' Now streaming on Netflix claire-danes-matthew-rhys-beast-in-me The X Files ' writer, Gabe Rotter , has concocted a Netflix thriller that will leave you on edge. It is centered on Aggie Wiggs ( Claire Danes ), an acclaimed author facing writer's block ever since her son's tragic death. That is until the house next to hers is bought by a real estate mogul who was once the prime suspect in his wife's mysterious disappearance. Intrigued by Nile Jarvis' ( Matthew Rhys ) past and eager to use her findings as inspiration for a new book, Aggie enters a quest that could easily turn deadly. Both Danes and Rhys are featured in the exclusive image above, walking side by side. Get all the details about The Beast in Me in our exclusive preview. ‘Wicked: For Good’ Release Date: November 21, 2025 cynthia-erivo-jeff-goldblum-ariana-grande-wicked-for-good One of the biggest movie events of 2024, the release of Wicked stormed to box office success and defied both gravity and general expectation by also becoming a critical darling and Oscars success. Chu , Cynthia Erivo , and Ariana Grande are back with the hotly anticipated For Good , the second half to the iconic stage musical, which sees the once-shining Emerald City turn grey as the hunt for Elphaba darkens. Ahead of the film’s November 21 release, Collider has teamed up with Wicked to debut an exclusive image of the sequel, as part of our Winter Preview Event, showcasing Elphaba and Glinda hand in hand with Jeff Goldblum ’s Wizard. Get all the details about Wicked: For Good in our exclusive look. 'The Copenhagen Test' Release Date: December 27, 2025 copenhagen-test-simu-liu-melissa-barrera A Marvel favorite will engage in a trippy espionage journey in The Copenhagen Test. The Peacock series follows Alexander Hale ( Simu Liu ), a first-generation Chinese-American intelligence analyst whose brain is hacked by an unknown assailant. With everything that he sees and heres getting directed to a stranger monitoring his everyday affairs, Alexander doesn't know who to reach out for help.
